chapters.title: Chapter 451 -451-Summoned by the Eternal Emperor
paragraphs: Just as Daniel had predicted, only a few days passed before the Eternal Emperor personally summoned Prince Dorek.
The moment Dorek received the news, he became visibly anxious and hurried to find Daniel.
"Teacher! Teacher! Father has summoned me. What should we do?"
Seeing his panicked expression, Daniel waved his hand and smiled.
"Relax. There is no need to panic."
"Since your father has chosen to summon you, it means the Inspector handled everything according to procedure and has already spoken favorably of you."
"Simply follow our original plan."
Dorek immediately felt much more reassured.
"Understood, Teacher. I’ll go meet Father now."
He soon boarded a carriage reserved specifically for passage into the imperial palace and departed in a hurry.
However, although Dorek left quickly, he returned even sooner.
After all, this was ultimately only a summons.
The Emperor had merely exchanged a few inconsequential words with him. At most, it could be considered a formal procedure.
Yet that procedure was extraordinarily important, especially during the current struggle among the seven princes.
Although it brought no immediate benefits, the influence it created might eventually alter the fate of the entire universe.
During this brief period, Daniel had remained patiently within the residence.
The moment he sensed Dorek’s aura returning, he immediately prepared to meet him.
However, when Dorek appeared, Daniel’s pupils suddenly contracted.
Within his field of vision, numerous strange specks of tribulation ash clung to Dorek’s body and drifted downward with each movement.
Because of their unusual nature, the ashes disappeared without a trace the moment they touched the ground, as though they had never existed.
"So that is tribulation ash?"
Daniel’s thoughts stirred when he saw it.
"I didn’t expect the Eternal Emperor’s tribulation-ash corruption to have already reached such a severe level."
"Dorek merely met him briefly, yet so much tribulation ash attached itself to his body."
"I wonder how much longer the Eternal Emperor can endure."
From this minor detail alone, Daniel gained a clearer understanding of the Eternal Empire’s current condition.
While he was still thinking, Dorek entered and immediately bowed.
"Teacher, I have returned."
When he raised his head and noticed Daniel’s gaze, he immediately understood what Daniel had seen.
Yet instead of worry, delight appeared on his face.
"Teacher, you noticed it as well, didn’t you?"
"Father’s tribulation-ash corruption has already become extremely severe."
"I did not even see him in person. I only spoke with him through a barrier."
"He asked me many questions, but I answered exactly as you instructed and maintained the appearance of an honest, straightforward prince."
"After hearing my answers, Father clearly began trusting me far more!"
"He even proposed conducting a deeper examination of me, but I refused in advance, just as you instructed."
Daniel nodded.
"Good."
"From now on, you need only wait patiently for the right opportunity."
Several more days passed.
A massive disturbance suddenly erupted within the Heavenly River Starfield.
Large numbers of Tribulation-Ash Monsters appeared and began invading the surrounding territories with terrifying ferocity.
Nearly the entire universe within the starfield was devastated by them.
Worse still, the monsters showed signs of spreading throughout the rest of the starfield.
With the entire region on the verge of destruction, panic rapidly spread among its inhabitants.
Many had already begun considering whether they should abandon their homes and relocate elsewhere.
Daniel took advantage of the chaos and activated several spies he had planted within the Holy See.
After a period of careful manipulation, events unfolded exactly as he had planned.
The Holy See issued another summons for Prince Dorek.
This was already the second time Dorek had been called before the Emperor.
Compared with his first visit, he was now far more familiar with the process and soon returned.
During the first summons, he had met privately with the Eternal Emperor and exchanged a few words.
This time, however, Dorek had attended a formal court assembly, where he met both the Emperor and numerous officials of the Holy See.
When Dorek returned, an even greater amount of tribulation ash clung to his body.
Daniel narrowed his eyes.
"Interesting."
"I didn’t expect even the officials attending court to have begun suffering from tribulation-ash corruption."
With that thought, he looked toward Dorek.
"Tell me. Did everything proceed according to plan?"
Dorek now looked at Daniel with undisguised admiration.
"Teacher, your foresight is truly divine."
"Even though you have never personally entered the imperial court, you understand its internal situation perfectly."
"I am deeply impressed."
"Just as you predicted, our agent directly recommended me during the assembly."
"Afterward, I mentioned your name before the court and recommended you as well."
"Father has now decided to appoint you as a military official and send you to the Heavenly River Starfield to eliminate the Tribulation-Ash Monsters."
"Your official appointment should be issued very soon."
A smile finally appeared on Daniel’s face.
Sure enough, only a few minutes later, envoys from the Holy See arrived at Dorek’s residence to formally announce Daniel’s appointment.
Daniel accepted the decree according to procedure and learned his new identity.
He had been appointed Supreme Commander of the Heavenly River Starfield.
His duty was to eliminate every Tribulation-Ash Monster within the region.
It did not matter whether he destroyed them, suppressed them, or sealed them away.
As long as he prevented them from spreading into other starfields, his mission would be considered complete.
Without exception, these monsters had been born from the corpses of deceased native experts.
New souls had emerged within the abandoned bodies, effectively seizing possession of their former vessels.
Their sole purpose was to destroy the entire universe and transform it into an environment suitable for Tribulation-Ash Monsters.
It was worth noting that Daniel’s position as Supreme Commander of the Heavenly River Starfield was a special appointment.
It possessed no formal bureaucratic grade.
However, it granted him considerable authority, since he was permitted to mobilize imperial armies.
Daniel’s eyes flickered, but he showed no disappointment.
"This is most likely a test from the Holy See."
"If I complete this mission perfectly, they will probably grant me a proper official position afterward."
"Teacher, you should not go personally."
"The moment you leave my residence, the other princes may immediately move against you."
"They have already set their sights on you."
"Once you depart and lose the protection of the Oracle-grade experts stationed here, they will no longer have any reason to restrain themselves."
"They will undoubtedly use every possible method to eliminate you!"
The moment Dorek heard that Daniel intended to leave and deal with the Tribulation-Ash Monsters personally, he became extremely worried.
"If you truly must go, why not allow me to send several Oracle-grade experts from the Fated Human Race to accompany you?"
To Dorek, Daniel was the central pillar supporting his entire faction.
If he lost Daniel’s assistance, Dorek would immediately fall into a severe disadvantage in the struggle for the throne.
Therefore, nothing could be allowed to happen to Daniel at such a critical moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 452 -452-Setting Out
paragraphs: Dorek valued Daniel’s safety even more than his own.
If anything happened to Daniel, he would lose every hope of competing for the imperial throne.
Now that Daniel was preparing to depart on his campaign, Dorek wished he could assign the T7 Oracle-grade expert of the Fated Human Race beside him to serve as Daniel’s personal guard.
However, Daniel shook his head and refused.
"There is no need."
"I alone am sufficient to deal with every enemy who comes."
"You only need to worry about yourself."
"While I am away, I expect you to avoid causing any trouble."
After hearing this, Dorek could only close his mouth and refrain from saying anything more.
He did not understand why Daniel was so confident that no outside enemy could harm him.
However, considering the unfathomable strength Daniel had displayed and the almost omniscient wisdom of his teacher, Dorek ultimately agreed to let him travel alone.
"Teacher truly possesses absolute confidence."
Dorek silently watched Daniel’s figure gradually disappear from the residence.
Daniel was naturally confident.
Ever since crossing into this world and era, he had never sensed an aura capable of making him feel genuinely threatened.
He did not even request personal guards from the Imperial City.
He truly set out alone.
Within the boundless starry sky, an Emperor-class sacred vessel sailed forward.
Suddenly—
A dazzling golden light appeared.
The dense aura of a Divine-grade treasure instantly swept across the surrounding region.
It came from a stone-like Divine-grade treasure.
The moment it appeared, every planet within ten thousand kilometers was suppressed and ceased revolving.
Even the space throughout the affected region was completely frozen, unable to move in the slightest.
Daniel, who was aboard the Emperor-class sacred vessel, immediately sensed the terrifying aura released by the suddenly appearing treasure.
His expression shifted.
"A Primordial Supreme Treasure?"
Within his perception, the aura released by the Divine-grade treasure was actually on the same level as the Riakris Shield he had encountered previously.
Both were Primordial Supreme Treasures.
"Interesting. Someone actually dares intercept me."
"Divine Spear!"
Daniel shouted softly.
The next moment, a pitch-black spear appeared.
It instantly broke through the sealing laws of the Primordial Supreme Treasure and violently struck the stone-like Divine-grade treasure.
A mere stone treasure at the Primordial Supreme Treasure level could not possibly withstand the Divine Spear’s attack.
It was instantly pierced by the black spear.
The corresponding sealing laws collapsed completely, and the surrounding space across hundreds of millions of miles resumed flowing.
"You have considerable nerve."
"You even dare touch something that belongs to me."
A ghostlike figure suddenly appeared nearby.
Had Prince Kane been present, he would have recognized the man immediately.
It was none other than the mysterious expert supporting his faction.
He had truly come to find Daniel, intending to eliminate him on Kane’s behalf.
However, the moment Daniel saw him, a cold smile appeared on his face.
In truth, he had long understood that the forces behind the other princes would never allow him to reach his post without interference.
They could not permit him to assume command smoothly.
If Daniel arrived at the Heavenly River Starfield and successfully pacified all the Tribulation-Ash Monsters, he would establish tremendous merit.
As a member of Dorek’s faction, the reputation Daniel gained would inevitably cause Prince Dorek’s Contribution Points and public prestige to soar as well.
When that happened, the chances of victory for the other princes would fall sharply.
As a result, Daniel had already become the shared target of every prince.
Only by killing him could they feel at ease.
Naturally, the high-stage Oracle-grade experts who had crossed over from various points along the River of Time would not pass up such an excellent opportunity.
In their eyes, Daniel was an anomaly.
An existence like him had to be erased as early as possible.
Daniel had not even truly left the outer territories of the Eternal Empire when he encountered his first assassination attempt.
"Die."
The mysterious expert instantly unfolded his sage-rank domain.
After an Oracle-grade expert survived their sage-rank tribulation, the domain they created could be carried with them and fused into their very being.
However, the Eternal Empire was governed by a supreme Great Dao that suppressed their cultivation Ranks.
As a result, these high-stage Oracle-grade experts who had arrived from various eras along the River of Time could display only Divine-grade cultivation within its territory.
Now, however, they had already left the central region affected by the Eternal Empire’s suppression.
Naturally, the mysterious expert could once again activate his Divine Domain.
As a high-stage Oracle-grade powerhouse, the sage-rank domain he summoned was anything but ordinary.
Although its outward pressure appeared far less astonishing than that of a supreme sage-rank domain, its density and quality were not inferior in the slightest.
After all, his original cultivation was already at high-stage Oracle-grade.
Summoning a sage-rank domain comparable to a supreme sage-rank domain was effortless for him.
At that moment, golden light suddenly erupted from Daniel’s body and rapidly expanded.
Within only a few seconds, it covered hundreds of millions of kilometers.
It was Daniel’s supreme sage-rank domain!
The moment it appeared, its overwhelming power instantly forced back the mysterious expert’s domain.

Of course, if they had completely escaped the influence of the Eternal Empire’s Great Dao suppression, Daniel’s supreme sage-rank domain would never have gained an advantage over that of the expert before him.
But because the Great Dao continued suppressing both sides, Daniel’s domain was now capable of directly contending against that of a high-stage Oracle-grade powerhouse.
The mysterious expert showed no panic upon witnessing this scene.
Instead, surprise and admiration appeared in his eyes.
"Interesting."
"I didn’t expect you to possess a supreme sage-rank domain."
"I happen to be lacking a suitable domain at the moment."
"I’ll take yours."
Daniel nearly laughed from anger.
He immediately snorted coldly.
"And what exactly are you supposed to be?"
"You think you can take it simply because you want it?"
"What makes you believe you can do anything to me?"
Almost immediately, crimson radiance erupted from Daniel’s body once again.
A halo-like object appeared behind his head, composed of multiple interlocking rings.
It carried the ultimate power of destiny and the Great Dao.
It was none other than one of his supreme treasures—
The Ring of Destiny.
The instant the Ring of Destiny appeared, reality itself condensed.
At the same time, it reached across the past, present, and future, spanning a total of 728 days.
All of Daniel’s Strength throughout those 728 days converged upon the present moment.
It was equivalent to granting the current Daniel a 728-fold enhancement!
His pressure immediately soared to an unimaginable peak.
"Celestial Convergence—
"Celestial Grasp!"
Daniel shouted softly.
The next moment, he thrust out his palm.
An incomparably enormous palm print suddenly appeared within the vault of heaven!
Even a single line upon that colossal palm contained terrifying pressure.

chapters.title: Chapter 453 -453-The Kill
paragraphs: Such terrifying might would have caused almost anyone else to faint from fear on the spot.
However, the mysterious expert merely revealed a disdainful expression as the laws around his body began circulating rapidly.
"You think a technique of this level can harm me?"
The next moment, he abruptly raised his hand.
The phantom of an incomparably enormous finger surged upward from below, stabbing directly toward Daniel’s colossal palm!
The two attacks were about to unleash a terrifying collision amid the boundless universe.
Daniel’s enormous palm carried the accumulated power of countless Star Dome Shattering strikes, raising its might to an unimaginable level.
Yet the mysterious expert’s single-finger Sacred Art was no weaker.
Although it had been launched later, it surged upward with momentum that did not lose out in the slightest.
The colossal palm and finger collided.
For a brief instant, the entire universe seemed to fall silent.
Then—
Boom!
An incomparably violent explosion erupted.
Faint cracks spread throughout the endless universe, rippling rapidly in every direction.
Rumble!
The mysterious expert’s enormous finger endured for only a moment before Daniel’s palm crushed it downward.
Beneath the colossal palm, every trace of resistance was obliterated.
However, the palm’s power was also worn down by more than half.
Even so, the remaining force continued descending toward the mysterious expert without losing its momentum.
When he saw his technique being shattered, the mysterious expert’s expression changed drastically.
"How could this happen?"
He was a peak T7 high-stage Oracle-grade expert.
Even while suppressed by the Great Dao rules, his combat strength still belonged among the strongest beings at Divine-grade.
That previous attack would have instantly killed an ordinary first-stage or second-stage Oracle-grade expert.
Yet when it encountered Daniel’s enormous palm, it had been crushed almost instantly.
He had never witnessed anything like this before.
The mysterious expert was completely stunned.
Could the man before him be a supreme T9 Oracle-grade powerhouse in disguise?
As a high-stage Oracle-grade expert himself, he knew many experts of the same level who had likewise crossed over from different eras of the future.
Among them were even numerous supreme T9 Oracle-grade experts two stages above him.
Only those T9 powerhouses stronger than himself could have shattered his technique so effortlessly and overwhelmed him head-on.
His opponent had to be either T8 or T9.
Only experts at those two Ranks could possibly accomplish such a feat.
"I underestimated him."
The mysterious expert’s expression became extremely grim.
Seeing the colossal palm drawing closer, he immediately prepared to evade.
Suddenly, terrifying law power erupted from the black spear.
A dense wave of law pressure descended upon him, freezing his body in place.
He could not move in the slightest.
At the same time, Daniel slowly raised his hand again.
"It really is troublesome to kill a fly like you while your Rank is suppressed."
In an instant—
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Countless colossal palms appeared out of thin air and struck from every corner of the starry sky.
They formed an impenetrable mass, leaving the mysterious expert no room to evade.
Upon seeing this, he finally experienced genuine fear of death.
He had never imagined that the black spear could completely immobilize his body.
To achieve such an effect, its grade had to surpass the stone treasure he had just released.
It was clearly an existence far beyond an ordinary Primordial Supreme Treasure.
"What kind of technique is this?"
The mysterious expert was horrified.
His guess was not wrong.
The black spear was the peak-grade Primordial Supreme Treasure Daniel had obtained previously.
Even among Primordial Supreme Treasures, it belonged to the absolute highest tier.
"Damn it! Am I truly going to die here?"
Faced with the countless colossal palms crashing toward him, the mysterious expert could only ignite his Origin with everything he had.
He unleashed the strongest Origin-law power and Divine-grade treasures he possessed to resist the terrifying assault.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Boom!
The instant the endless palms struck the mysterious expert, the surrounding spatial cracks expanded dramatically.
His figure was completely swallowed by clouds of ash and debris.
Within the storm, he felt as though he had been plunged into a raging tsunami.
Wave after wave of terrifying power tore apart his Origin.
Even with his vast reserves, he suffered severe injuries beneath the relentless assault.
As a former high-stage Oracle-grade expert, he still possessed defenses at the high-stage Oracle-grade level, even though the Great Dao had suppressed his cultivation to Divine-grade.
He simply could not display his full power at present, which was why he had been pinned in place and rendered unable to move.
However, Daniel’s attacks likewise surpassed the limits of Divine-grade.
Not only was there no Divine-grade expert capable of enduring such an assault, but even a high-stage Oracle-grade powerhouse would be gravely wounded by it.
Seeing that the mysterious expert was still holding on, Daniel’s gaze turned cold.
"Let me send you one step further."
The next moment, even more colossal palms emerged from every corner of the universe and surged forward like an endless tide.
At the same time, the black spear suddenly erupted with a green radiance and pierced through space.
The eerie green light around it resembled a green sun, carrying an aura capable of destroying heaven and earth.
The mysterious expert remained suppressed by the black spear.
His body was still frozen in place, unable to move.
The countless colossal palms struck him with perfect accuracy, as though he were nothing more than a stationary target.
Immediately afterward, the black spear pierced straight through his body.
After suffering one devastating blow after another, unwillingness appeared in the mysterious expert’s eyes.
But in the next instant, the Law of Destruction ground his body into countless fragments of nothingness.
He was completely annihilated beneath the assault.
A series of system notifications immediately rang in Daniel’s ears.
[Congratulations, Host. You have slain a T7 Oracle-grade expert!]
[This kill has triggered Millionfold Boost!]
[Congratulations, Host. You have obtained the peak-grade Primordial Supreme Treasures: Holy Spirit Stone, Soul Binding Mirror, and Vigilance Crystal!]
[You have also obtained 120 Divine-grade treasures!]
[Congratulations, Host. You have obtained Origin Crystals ×125,480,467,346,756!]
[Treasure Materials ×14,664,619,196,464!]
[Congratulations, Host. You have obtained 100 Realm-Crosser Points!]
[You are currently ranked first among all realm-crossers!]
A smile appeared on Daniel’s face as he listened to the notifications.
He had made an enormous profit from this battle.
"I didn’t expect that casually killing a single Oracle-grade expert would bring me so many rewards."
Extremely satisfied, he opened his inventory and began examining his gains.
The first object that entered his sight was a Spirit Stone shining with brilliant golden light.
It was none other than the peak-grade Primordial Supreme Treasure—
The Holy Spirit Stone.
Daniel focused his gaze upon it, and its information immediately appeared.
[Holy Spirit Stone]
[Quality]: Peak-grade Primordial
[Type]: All Attributes
[Effects]:
Seals the space across hundreds of millions of miles, rendering every living being within the affected area completely unable to move.
Allows the user to cross space and push their speed beyond its normal limits.
Any existence struck by this stone will suffer severe damage to both their Divine Soul and physical body. Its exact power depends upon the user’s Rank.

"You think a technique of this level can harm me?"

Daniel’s enormous palm carried the accumulated power of countless Star Dome Shattering strikes, raising its might to an unimaginable level.

chapters.title: Chapter 454 -454-An Abundant Harvest
paragraphs: After reading the description of the Holy Spirit Stone, Daniel immediately realized that he had obtained an extraordinary treasure.
Whether it was used as a concealed projectile or as a direct combat method against enemies, the stone was practically perfect.
Furthermore, its ability to immobilize an entire region of space was more than enough to demonstrate the strength of this peak-grade Primordial Supreme Treasure.
Even the Voidbound Grail Daniel had obtained previously was inferior to the Holy Spirit Stone in grade.
Its combat capabilities were also far weaker by comparison.
If the Holy Spirit Stone underwent Daniel’s Millionfold Boost, it might even reach a level comparable to some of the god-grade treasures he had previously obtained.
Of course, it would still be inferior to a true god-grade treasure.
Its effects were not as overwhelmingly complex, nor did it possess any growth attributes.
Overall, the Holy Spirit Stone could replace the Voidbound Grail’s immobilization ability and serve as Daniel’s primary method for trapping and attacking enemies.
After putting away the Holy Spirit Stone, Daniel turned his attention toward the next treasure.
[Soul Binding Mirror]
[Quality]: Peak-grade Primordial
[Type]: All Attributes
[Effects]:
Seals all of the target’s Divine Soul power, imprisoning their entire Divine Soul within their physical body and rendering them incapable of thought.
If the target’s strength is lower than the user’s, the user may directly extract the target’s soul into the mirror and refine it completely.
After refinement, the user will obtain all of the imprisoned target’s memories.

If the target possesses strength comparable to the user’s, their Divine Soul will be thrown into a state of violent instability. They will become incapable of maintaining rational thought and will display a series of illogical behaviors.
If the target’s Rank is higher than the user’s, the mirror can only exert a minor influence upon their Divine Soul and slow their thoughts.
While carrying this treasure, the user will become immune to the vast majority of Divine Soul injuries.
The exact effect depends upon the difference in Rank between the attacker and the user.
Soul Suppression: If the user obtains a portion of a divine soul, the mirror may be used to suppress and refine it.
Once the Divine Soul has been purified, the user will obtain a complete and pure divine soul that can be used to nourish their own, gradually strengthening it over time.
After reading the treasure’s description, Daniel immediately injected his True Spirit into the mirror and began refining it.
At the same time, he also refined the Holy Spirit Stone he had just obtained.
The Soul Binding Mirror possessed extremely useful effects for him.
It could even repair injuries involving the Divine Soul.
That ability alone was enough to make Daniel deeply tempted.
What Daniel currently lacked most was a treasure capable of defending against Divine Soul attacks.
If he encountered an enemy who specialized in such methods, he would have very few ways to resist.
However, the Soul Binding Mirror’s true strength lay in its third effect.
It could refine divine souls and produce a complete, purified soul.
If such a divine soul were placed on the Golden Holy Mountain’s mission board as a reward, tens of thousands of experts would probably fight over it immediately.
Even now, Oracle-grade experts had long-standing missions posted on the Golden Holy Mountain, offering enormous prices for purified divine souls.
Divine souls possessed countless uses.
The stronger they were, the greater their value.
They could be used to refine treasures.
A sufficiently high-stage divine soul could even be used to forge a peak-quality Primordial-grade treasure.
For example, the mysterious expert Daniel had just killed had originally been a high-stage Oracle-grade powerhouse.
If his complete Divine Soul were used as a refining material, it would be virtually guaranteed to produce a Primordial-grade treasure.
Apart from refining treasures, a complete divine soul could also strengthen the sage-rank domains of Divine-grade experts.
It could expand the domain’s range several times over while simultaneously increasing its quality.
There was even a possibility of refining the domain all the way to the level of a supreme Divine Domain.
In addition to those two major functions, a divine soul could indirectly strengthen one’s own Divine Soul power.
By gradually absorbing nourishment from a purified divine soul over a long period, the quality of one’s Divine Soul would inevitably rise.
After obtaining the Soul Binding Mirror, Daniel immediately refined it.
Under the power of his immense divine energy, he required less than a few moments to completely refine both treasures.
A cool and refreshing sensation immediately spread through his Divine Soul.
Clearly, the Divine Soul of the mysterious expert he had just killed had already been refined and was now nourishing Daniel’s body and soul.
Only then did he turn toward the remaining treasure.
[Vigilance Crystal]
[Quality]: Peak-grade Primordial
[Type]: All Attributes
[Effects]:
The Vigilance Crystal originates from the legendary Wuzong Secret Realm and is one of its unique products.
Only 9,999 crystals are produced whenever a cosmic epoch comes to an end.
Every crystal exists independently and cannot be replicated by another.
After they are formed, they automatically scatter across countless corners of the myriad universes.
Regardless of the universe in which it appears, this crystal is regarded as an exceptionally rare supreme treasure and crafting material.
It can be used to advance an ordinary Divine-grade treasure.
"It can advance an ordinary Divine-grade treasure?"
The instant Daniel saw this effect, his eyes lit up.
He currently possessed an enormous number of Divine-grade treasures that required sufficiently powerful materials to advance.
The Basin of Greed was one of them.
At present, it was only a Primordial Law-grade treasure.
If it advanced, it could reach Primordial-grade.
At that point, it would no longer be restricted to storing ordinary Primordial Supreme Treasures.
If Daniel advanced it further and then applied Millionfold Boost, the upgraded Basin of Greed might immediately rise by several entire levels.
If that truly happened, the Vigilance Crystal would be perfect for him.
He currently possessed far too many treasures that required advancement.
Even the Voidbound Grail needed to be upgraded.
Unfortunately, he had obtained only one crystal.
A crafting material capable of advancing Divine-grade treasures was even rarer than a Primordial Supreme Treasure such as the Soul Binding Mirror.
Daniel had no idea where the mysterious expert he had just killed had obtained such a precious material.
The man had even carried it directly on his body, seemingly unconcerned that he might lose it.
Now that the crystal had fallen into Daniel’s hands, he naturally intended to make full use of it.
After considering the matter for a moment, he decided to use his only opportunity to advance an Oracle-grade treasure on the Basin of Greed.
At present, he possessed far too many treasures that could not be placed inside it.
The Basin of Greed urgently required an advancement.
As for the Voidbound Grail, he would leave it for the future.
He could upgrade it later if another opportunity arose.
With that thought, Daniel retrieved the Basin of Greed from his inventory.
Its surface shimmered with seven-colored radiance, as though countless treasures had gathered within it.
He then took out the pink Vigilance Crystal.
"I wonder what Rank the Basin of Greed will reach after absorbing this crystal."
"And what new effects will it obtain?"
Daniel drew in a deep breath before tossing the pink crystal into the Basin of Greed.

chapters.title: Chapter 455 -455-Advancement Complete
paragraphs: [Ding! The Basin of Greed has begun advancing!]
[This advancement has triggered Millionfold Boost!]
[The Basin of Greed has advanced to Chaos Spirit Treasure-grade!]
"Chaos Spirit Treasure-grade?"
After reading the notification, Daniel drew in a deep breath.
This meant that with the Chaos Spirit Treasure-grade Basin of Greed, he could now forcibly seize even Divine-grade treasures of the same level.
The Basin of Greed’s plundering ability must have reached an extraordinarily terrifying level.
With that thought, Daniel immediately opened its detailed information panel.
[Basin of Greed]
[Quality]: Chaos Spirit Treasure
[Type]: All Attributes
[Effects]:
Ignores all rules and restrictions to forcibly seize an unlimited number of Divine-grade treasures below its own grade.
The current maximum grade it can contain is Chaos Spirit Treasure-grade.
After advancing, the Basin of Greed now contains an extremely high-stage Law of Creation.
It has a certain probability of randomly advancing one treasure by a single grade. The resulting treasure cannot exceed the grade of the Basin of Greed itself.
Cooldown: Ten thousand years.
This effect will trigger randomly once every ten thousand years. Further advancements can reduce the cooldown to one thousand years.
This effect is currently on cooldown.
When facing a sacred treasure one grade above itself, the Basin of Greed can provide a certain degree of resistance or weaken the treasure’s specific abilities.
After devouring a treasure, the Basin of Greed can produce a Divine-grade treasure whose grade does not exceed its own.
The same treasure cannot be devoured repeatedly, and treasures produced through this effect cannot receive Millionfold Boost.
Every treasure stored within the Basin of Greed will obtain the Sacred Treasure Spirit characteristic.
A Sacred Treasure Spirit can independently seize other Divine-grade treasures of the same quality or with similar effects on behalf of the owner.
Upon sensing such a treasure, it will act automatically and unleash Strength comparable to the full-force strike of a Divine-grade expert, forcibly plundering the treasure from its current owner.
After reading the Basin of Greed’s updated description, Daniel was extremely satisfied.
The first effect was especially powerful.
It had directly transformed the Basin of Greed into a treasure capable of forcibly seizing other Divine-grade treasures.
In other words, even if the current Basin of Greed encountered a peak-grade Primordial Supreme Treasure, it could forcibly take it away.
The second effect was equally useful.
It could randomly advance one high-quality Divine-grade treasure, although it still required a cooldown of ten thousand years.
The third effect had not changed much.
As for the fourth effect, it was a completely new ability that the original Basin of Greed had not possessed.
As long as it devoured a treasure, it could randomly generate another treasure of the same grade.
However, the generated treasure could not exceed the Basin of Greed’s own grade.
In principle, this meant it could produce Divine-grade treasures up to the level of peak-grade Primordial Supreme Treasures.
There were also several restrictions.
For example, it could not repeatedly devour the same kind of treasure, and the generated treasure could not receive Millionfold Boost.
Daniel did not particularly care about those limitations.
After all, even a Primordial Supreme Treasure-grade Divine-grade treasure was already extremely useful to him.
The personal Divine-grade treasures used by T7 Oracle-grade experts were generally only comparable to Primordial Supreme Treasures.
Even ordinary high-stage Oracle-grade experts might not possess a Chaos Spirit Treasure-grade Basin of Greed like the one Daniel now held.
At most, many of them would possess only a few Primordial Spirit Treasures.
The Basin of Greed’s fifth effect was equally impressive.
Every treasure devoured by it would awaken a Treasure Spirit.
A Treasure Spirit was effectively an artifact spirit capable of ensuring that a treasure’s full power was perfectly unleashed.
During battle, it could even independently release an attack comparable to the full-force strike of a Divine-grade expert.
Daniel could imagine casually releasing hundreds of sacred treasures while their Treasure Spirits controlled them on his behalf.
He would no longer need to divide his attention among them.
Of course, the more powerful a sacred treasure was, the more difficult it would normally be for an artifact spirit to awaken within it.
However, with the Basin of Greed, Daniel did not need to worry too much about that problem.
He was extremely pleased with the advanced treasure.
After putting it away, Daniel finally turned his gaze toward the shattered corpse of the mysterious expert nearby.
This was the first time Daniel had relied entirely upon his own Strength to personally kill a T7 high-stage Oracle-grade expert.
Admittedly, the man had been suppressed by the Great Dao rules and could display only Divine Sovereign-level cultivation.
Even so, his true existence had still belonged to T7 Oracle-grade.
Yet Daniel had personally killed him.
"An Oracle-grade corpse is also an excellent treasure."
"I should collect it carefully."
Daniel raised his hand and prepared to gather the shattered remains of the high-stage Oracle-grade expert.
He remembered that an Oracle-grade expert had once invited him to visit a sacred ground at some point in the future.
According to that expert, the sacred ground had gradually formed from the corpse of a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Daniel had never forgotten that secret.
Although the mysterious expert’s corpse had not reached T8, it had still belonged to a T7 existence.
"Because of the Great Dao laws, this corpse currently possesses only Divine Sovereign-level power."
"However, once it leaves this plane and returns to the future era, it will escape the Great Dao’s suppression."
"At that point, this Divine Sovereign-level corpse will naturally revert to the corpse of a T7 Oracle-grade expert."
"That alone makes it no less valuable than an entire mountain of treasures."
With that thought, Daniel raised his hand once again and attempted to gather all the fragments.
However, the moment his Divine Sense touched them, he suddenly sensed an oppressive aura originating from a Great Dao Tribulation Source.
"Something is wrong."
Daniel immediately withdrew his Divine Sense.
Only then did he remember an important detail.
Whether it was Daniel himself or the other Oracle-grade experts, every existence that crossed the River of Time and descended into this era was bound by the Great Dao rules.
The first restriction forcibly limited their cultivation to Divine-grade.
The second was that every realm-crosser had a Great Dao Tribulation Source forcibly planted within their body.
Daniel had originally assumed that the Great Dao Tribulation Source would disappear upon the death of an Oracle-grade expert.
He had never expected it to remain even after the corpse had been shattered into fragments.
This meant his plan to collect the Oracle-grade body had truly failed.
A Great Dao Tribulation Source was not something he could casually provoke.
"Hiss... What a waste!"
"This is practically destroying a priceless treasure!"
Daniel watched the fragments being scattered into the void, his heart aching terribly.
That had been the corpse of a T7 Oracle-grade expert!
"Forget it."
"Ultimately, avoiding unnecessary trouble is more important."
"I should refrain from touching the corpses of these realm-crossers in the future."
Only then did Daniel remember something else.
After killing the mysterious expert, he seemed to have obtained one hundred points.

Upon sensing such a treasure, it will act automatically and unleash Strength comparable to the full-force strike of a Divine-grade expert, forcibly plundering the treasure from its current owner.
After reading the Basin of Greed’s updated description, Daniel was extremely satisfied.
The first effect was especially powerful.
It had directly transformed the Basin of Greed into a treasure capable of forcibly seizing other Divine-grade treasures.
In other words, even if the current Basin of Greed encountered a peak-grade Primordial Supreme Treasure, it could forcibly take it away.
The second effect was equally useful.
It could randomly advance one high-quality Divine-grade treasure, although it still required a cooldown of ten thousand years.
The third effect had not changed much.
As for the fourth effect, it was a completely new ability that the original Basin of Greed had not possessed.
As long as it devoured a treasure, it could randomly generate another treasure of the same grade.
However, the generated treasure could not exceed the Basin of Greed’s own grade.
In principle, this meant it could produce Divine-grade treasures up to the level of peak-grade Primordial Supreme Treasures.
There were also several restrictions.
For example, it could not repeatedly devour the same kind of treasure, and the generated treasure could not receive Millionfold Boost.
Daniel did not particularly care about those limitations.
After all, even a Primordial Supreme Treasure-grade Divine-grade treasure was already extremely useful to him.
The personal Divine-grade treasures used by T7 Oracle-grade experts were generally only comparable to Primordial Supreme Treasures.
Even ordinary high-stage Oracle-grade experts might not possess a Chaos Spirit Treasure-grade Basin of Greed like the one Daniel now held.
At most, many of them would possess only a few Primordial Spirit Treasures.
The Basin of Greed’s fifth effect was equally impressive.
Every treasure devoured by it would awaken a Treasure Spirit.
A Treasure Spirit was effectively an artifact spirit capable of ensuring that a treasure’s full power was perfectly unleashed.
During battle, it could even independently release an attack comparable to the full-force strike of a Divine-grade expert.
Daniel could imagine casually releasing hundreds of sacred treasures while their Treasure Spirits controlled them on his behalf.
He would no longer need to divide his attention among them.
Of course, the more powerful a sacred treasure was, the more difficult it would normally be for an artifact spirit to awaken within it.
However, with the Basin of Greed, Daniel did not need to worry too much about that problem.
He was extremely pleased with the advanced treasure.
After putting it away, Daniel finally turned his gaze toward the shattered corpse of the mysterious expert nearby.
This was the first time Daniel had relied entirely upon his own Strength to personally kill a T7 high-stage Oracle-grade expert.
Admittedly, the man had been suppressed by the Great Dao rules and could display only Divine Sovereign-level cultivation.
Even so, his true existence had still belonged to T7 Oracle-grade.
Yet Daniel had personally killed him.
"An Oracle-grade corpse is also an excellent treasure."
"I should collect it carefully."
Daniel raised his hand and prepared to gather the shattered remains of the high-stage Oracle-grade expert.
He remembered that an Oracle-grade expert had once invited him to visit a sacred ground at some point in the future.
According to that expert, the sacred ground had gradually formed from the corpse of a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Daniel had never forgotten that secret.
Although the mysterious expert’s corpse had not reached T8, it had still belonged to a T7 existence.
"Because of the Great Dao laws, this corpse currently possesses only Divine Sovereign-level power."
"However, once it leaves this plane and returns to the future era, it will escape the Great Dao’s suppression."
"At that point, this Divine Sovereign-level corpse will naturally revert to the corpse of a T7 Oracle-grade expert."
"That alone makes it no less valuable than an entire mountain of treasures."
With that thought, Daniel raised his hand once again and attempted to gather all the fragments.
However, the moment his Divine Sense touched them, he suddenly sensed an oppressive aura originating from a Great Dao Tribulation Source.
"Something is wrong."
Daniel immediately withdrew his Divine Sense.
Only then did he remember an important detail.
Whether it was Daniel himself or the other Oracle-grade experts, every existence that crossed the River of Time and descended into this era was bound by the Great Dao rules.
The first restriction forcibly limited their cultivation to Divine-grade.
The second was that every realm-crosser had a Great Dao Tribulation Source forcibly planted within their body.
Daniel had originally assumed that the Great Dao Tribulation Source would disappear upon the death of an Oracle-grade expert.
He had never expected it to remain even after the corpse had been shattered into fragments.
This meant his plan to collect the Oracle-grade body had truly failed.
A Great Dao Tribulation Source was not something he could casually provoke.
"Hiss...
What a waste!"
"This is practically destroying a priceless treasure!"
Daniel watched the fragments being scattered into the void, his heart aching terribly.
That had been the corpse of a T7 Oracle-grade expert!
"Forget it."
"Ultimately, avoiding unnecessary trouble is more important."
"I should refrain from touching the corpses of these realm-crossers in the future."
Only then did Daniel remember something else.
After killing the mysterious expert, he seemed to have obtained one hundred points.

chapters.title: Chapter 456 -456-The Leaderboard
paragraphs: With that thought, Daniel immediately opened the points leaderboard.
[Points Leaderboard — Realm-Crossers Only]
[First Place]: 100 points
[Second Place]: 0 points
[Third Place]: 0 points
At present, he was the only person on the leaderboard.
Names were not displayed, either. Even if someone knew that he had obtained points, they would still have no idea who he was.
"I remember these points can be exchanged for items, right?"
Daniel recalled the matter and immediately opened the points exchange shop.
All kinds of items appeared before him.
[Crimson Moon Disk]
[Price]: 1,000 points
[Description]: The user may attach this item to any evolvable treasure. Once attached, the corresponding treasure will obtain the Crimson Moon characteristic.
Under the effects of Crimson Moon, the user’s combat power will increase by 10%.
[Afterglow of the Sun]
[Price]: 10,000 points
[Description]: The first lingering ray of light born after the appearance of the sun, containing immensely powerful solar attributes.
After using it, the user will obtain Solar Strength within their body. Every time dusk arrives, all attributes will increase by 20%.
After casually glancing through several items, Daniel closed the exchange interface.
"I didn’t expect a mere one hundred points to be completely insufficient for anything I actually want."
The treasures he had just seen remained fresh in his mind.
With only one hundred points, there was no possibility of exchanging for any truly valuable Oracle-grade treasure.
However, it was enough to purchase some relatively ordinary items.
For example, one hundred points could delay the progress of tribulation-ash corruption by one day.
A Divine Descent-grade treasure could also be exchanged for one hundred points.
In addition, one million cubic units of Origin Crystals required only one hundred points.
There was even a chance of exchanging for a Primordial Law-grade Sacred Art.
Although these ordinary goods could not compare to the two supreme items he had just seen, the available selection was still quite extensive.
"Currently, there are only two known ways to obtain points."
"The first is through official rewards issued by the Holy See. Once someone obtains a corresponding official position, they will receive a fixed amount of points every month."
Daniel fell into thought.
"The second method is to compete against the other realm-crossers."
"Killing another realm-crosser grants one hundred points."
"Points can also be obtained by trading with people who possess them, making wagers, or through similar methods."
Daniel silently considered the matter.
"As long as I complete my special mission, I should have a chance to obtain an official position."
"Once that happens, I’ll receive a fixed amount of points every month."
"More importantly, obtaining an official position may grant the entire human race a corresponding racial talent."
"As long as I am not demoted, that talent will remain permanently."
Daniel understood very well that his journey to the Tianhua Universe would inevitably be filled with assassination attempts.
The T7 Oracle-grade expert he had just killed was probably nothing more than an appetizer.
If he continued forward, there would undoubtedly be many more assassins waiting for him.
That also meant another enormous influx of points.
"As for the Great Cosmic Will Fragment, it probably needs to be exchanged with points as well."
"If it cannot be obtained through the points shop, then what method is required to acquire it?"
Daniel’s primary reason for crossing time and descending into this plane was to obtain a fragment of the Great Cosmic Will.
However, within the points exchange shop, he could only view items priced at two thousand points or less.
Everything beyond that appeared dim and inaccessible.
Presumably, he would need to accumulate enough points before he could view the complete exchange list.
"In that case, I hope the people who come to assassinate me next are at least high-stage Oracle-grade experts."
"They shouldn’t embarrass themselves."
There was not the slightest trace of fear on Daniel’s face.
Everyone in this plane was currently suppressed by its Great Dao.
So what if an enemy had originally been a high-stage Oracle-grade expert?
Under the influence of the Great Dao, they would still be suppressed to Divine Sovereign-level.
As fellow Divine-grade existences, Daniel did not fear any of them.
"Moreover, I now possess numerous hidden trump cards."
"When I fought that T7 Oracle-grade expert just now, he was so weak that he wasn’t even qualified to make me use them."
"My Banner of Destiny’s Judgment never released the full-force strike of a peak second-stage Oracle-grade expert."
"I didn’t even use my god-grade equipment."
The thought of his numerous trump cards filled Daniel with confidence.
With his current foundations, he could even face an opponent who had originally been a T9 high-stage Oracle-grade powerhouse.
As long as the enemy was suppressed to Divine-grade by the Great Dao, Daniel could bury them beneath the overwhelming number of trump cards in his possession.
His only concern was whether anyone else would still dare to come after he had killed the T7 Oracle-grade expert.
"Heh."
"If none of them come, I’ll have to question their intelligence."
Daniel chuckled and continued onward.
The previous battle between Daniel and the mysterious expert had caused an enormous disturbance.
Nearly half the universe had trembled.
No one knew how many realm-crossers had secretly observed the battle from the shadows.
Daniel was fully aware of their presence.
That was precisely why he had not revealed all of his trump cards during the fight.
Even so, the small portion he had exposed was already enough to shock countless observing powerhouses.
Within hidden corners deep inside various universes, numerous experts had watched the battle through secret techniques and divine abilities.
After witnessing the outcome, they could not help but draw in sharp breaths.
Without exception, all of them were high-stage Oracle-grade experts capable of crossing the River of Time and descending into this plane.
Every one of them had originally been at least T8, and many had reached T9.
They had all concealed their identities from one another.
None of them knew who the others truly were.
Because of this unspoken rule, they naturally had no idea who Daniel really was either.

However, when they saw the trump cards Daniel revealed during the battle—casually producing two Divine-grade treasures and using them to suppress a T7 Oracle-grade expert—they were filled with apprehension.
Even they had to admit that they could not necessarily accomplish the same feat.
"Where did this man come from?"
"It is unfortunate that all of us chose to conceal our identities and arrived from different eras of the future."
"Otherwise, by using Sacred Arts and the laws, we would certainly be able to uncover his true identity within a short period."
One expert sighed, intensely curious about Daniel’s identity.
Other experts had already begun considering retreat.
"This man’s ability in single combat is terrifying."
"Even someone like me would not dare claim that I could defeat him with certainty."
"I suggest that we surround and kill him together."
"Otherwise, if we approach him one by one, every last one of us may die by his hand."

chapters.title: Chapter 457 -457-Preparing the Ambush
paragraphs: Some experts, however, believed that their strength gave them no reason to be afraid.
They spoke with obvious indignation.
"Why should we fear someone who has merely grasped the laws of the Great Dao?"
"Admittedly, his trump cards are somewhat troublesome, but every one of us is a high-stage Oracle-grade expert. Our cultivation has merely been suppressed to Divine-grade."
"If we could display our true strength, why would we ever fear a mere Divine-grade cultivator?"
Without exception, those who spoke so confidently were ordinary experts who had not yet joined the faction of a first-tier prince.
Meanwhile, some of the experts supporting Prince Lucian and Prince Alvin—the two princes ranked among the foremost contenders—had already begun quietly considering a retreat.
The experts within these two factions were different from those supporting the other princes.
Most princes had only one, two, or perhaps three mysterious experts backing them.
Prince Lucian and Prince Alvin, however, were surrounded by an almost countless number of powerful supporters.
After all, Lucian and Alvin had always been regarded as the most competitive candidates.
On the surface, the struggle for the imperial throne had practically always been a contest between the two of them.
Naturally, their factions also concealed the greatest number of mysterious experts.
At this moment, seven or eight of those experts had already begun discussing how to join forces and intercept Daniel.
The moment they witnessed the strength Daniel had just displayed, they realized that he was absolutely not an opponent they could underestimate.
"The trump cards that man revealed make it clear that we can no longer fight him individually."
"We must surround and kill him together if we want any chance of success."
"Exactly. His strength far exceeds what any of us expected. Only by overwhelming him with numbers can we guarantee our own safety."
"That’s right. If we all attack at once, we should still have a very high chance of taking him down."
Originally, every one of these experts had planned to personally intercept and kill Daniel in order to claim the points for themselves.
After all, killing an important contributor serving one of the princes would still count as a notable achievement.
The merit might not be overwhelming, but once Daniel died, Dorek would effectively be crippled.
He would lose all ability to compete for the throne.
Naturally, each expert wanted to monopolize the credit for the kill.
However, the trump cards and combat power Daniel had revealed made them worry that if they continued challenging him one by one, he would simply kill them all individually.
Before long, one of the experts suggested that they work together to eliminate Daniel.
As for the distribution of merit afterward, it would be divided according to each person’s actual contribution during the battle.
It did not take long for the experts to negotiate the necessary conditions.
They soon reached an agreement and prepared to jointly intercept Daniel.
Within Prince Lucian’s faction, four experts intended to participate in the ambush.
Prince Alvin’s faction, meanwhile, had three experts preparing to remain hidden and attack only when the right opportunity appeared.
After all, the two factions were natural rivals.
Only experts belonging to the same faction could openly cooperate with one another.
It was impossible for the experts of both camps to launch a coordinated attack together.
At this moment, Daniel was still piloting his Emperor-class sacred vessel forward.
He had no idea that several powerful experts were already lying in ambush ahead.
Even if he had known, he would not have cared.
With his current strength, he was usually the one hunting others.
Others rarely had the qualifications to hunt him.
Of course, Daniel still maintained a measure of vigilance while traveling through unexplored territory.
Sure enough, he had not traveled much farther when numerous Divine-grade treasures suddenly appeared ahead of him.
Daniel focused his gaze.
There were several dozen Divine-grade treasures in total, and every one of them was astonishingly high in quality.
Even the weakest among them had reached Primordial Law-grade.
In the next instant, the treasures surged toward him like a tidal wave, carrying an immensely dense aura of laws.
At the same time, all kinds of Divine-grade techniques erupted.
Their power was so overwhelming that the universe itself began trembling.
Even an ordinary Oracle-grade expert would probably be unable to endure such a terrifying combined assault.
One mysterious expert after another revealed themselves.
They had finally launched their attack against Daniel.
Countless Divine-grade treasures descended upon him with overwhelming momentum.
Vast quantities of law power and Divine-grade techniques followed closely behind, all carrying astonishing killing intent.
Daniel’s expression did not change.
He merely called out indifferently.
"Divine Spear."
In an instant, a completely black spear appeared and positioned itself directly before the incoming Sacred Arts and law power.
With a single thought from Daniel, the Divine Spear expanded violently.
It grew like a pillar supporting the heavens, reaching a length of millions of miles in an instant.
Like an invincible spear guarding the gates of heaven, it stood before Daniel’s Emperor-class sacred vessel and blocked the incoming assault.
At the same time, Daniel raised his hand.
The recently advanced Basin of Greed appeared in his palm.
The moment it emerged, the Basin of Greed released a strange fluctuation.
Unlike before, it did not immediately unleash vast clouds of multicolored radiance.
Instead, it began mobilizing the laws contained within itself.
The surrounding space rippled like the surface of a lake.
Invisible waves spread outward at astonishing speed, as though a stone had been dropped into perfectly still water.
Within only a few seconds, the invisible ripples had enveloped a large portion of the incoming Divine-grade treasures.
Without exception, every treasure covered by the Basin of Greed’s fluctuations instantly lost the ability to attack.
Their momentum vanished.
One after another, they came to a halt and hovered silently in the void.
The next moment, their owners discovered that the connection between themselves and their treasures had disappeared.
They were shocked and terrified.
They hurriedly attempted to recall their treasures, only to discover that the artifacts had seemingly betrayed them completely.
The treasures actually began flying toward the seemingly ordinary Basin of Greed of their own accord.
Like fish returning to the sea, dozens of high-quality Divine-grade treasures rushed directly into the Basin of Greed.
The Oracle-grade experts were horrified.
None of them understood how such a thing could possibly have happened.
The scene before them was as though their most precious possessions had suddenly escaped their control and willingly submitted to someone else.
The humiliation and extreme fury instantly swept away every trace of their rationality.
The mysterious experts temporarily abandoned their attacks on Daniel.
One after another, they activated secret techniques in an attempt to summon their Divine-grade treasures back.
Yet without exception, the connections between them and their treasures had already been forcibly severed.
No matter how desperately they called out, the treasures showed no response whatsoever.
The experts could only watch helplessly as their Divine-grade treasures fell into Daniel’s Basin of Greed.
All contact was completely lost.
Such an enormous loss immediately drove them into a frenzy.
Their hearts burned with anger and panic.
If this mission failed, their losses would be utterly devastating.

chapters.title: Chapter 458 -458-Plundering Treasures Without Restraint
paragraphs: Watching Daniel seize their treasures single-handedly, the experts were so anxious that they nearly coughed up blood.
More than ninety percent of those treasures had been specially prepared to help them survive the Final Tribulation.
Every god-grade treasure they had preserved until now was a priceless trump card passed down through generations.
Each one was also perfectly compatible with its owner.
Refining or finding another comparable treasure was practically impossible.
Losing these treasures would cut their chances of surviving the tribulation by at least half.
How could they possibly remain calm?
"Damn it!"
"Give me back my treasure!"
The experts finally lost control.
They stopped concealing themselves and directly revealed their true forms.
Three experts were the first to appear, completely abandoning any attempt to remain hidden.
They raised their hands simultaneously.
Countless terrifying law-based Sacred Arts instantly bombarded the Divine Spear!
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The vast, ocean-like wave of attacks was effortlessly blocked by the spear.
When the smoke and dust dispersed, not even the faintest mark could be seen upon its shaft.
The Divine Spear seemed to be looking down upon the experts as it spoke in a mocking voice.
"All of you made such a tremendous commotion, yet you couldn’t even leave a scratch on me."
"Are you trying to tickle me?"
The current Divine Spear possessed the terrifying characteristic of being impervious to all laws.
Meanwhile, those so-called powerhouses could presently display only Divine-grade cultivation.
Furthermore, all of their powerful Divine-grade treasures had already been effortlessly seized by Daniel’s Basin of Greed.
There was nothing they could do against the spear.
They might have exhausted their methods, but Daniel still possessed numerous trump cards.
"Clones."
Following Daniel’s quiet command, countless clones instantly appeared outside the Emperor-class sacred vessel.
A glorious battle banner materialized above the head of every clone.
They were all projections of the Banner of Destiny’s Judgment.
"Summon the Human Forefather."
"Souls of Destiny, gather around me."
"Star Dome Shattering."
"Celestial Grasp."
One terrifying Sacred Art after another erupted from Daniel’s clones.
The Human Forefather was summoned first.
The moment he appeared, he possessed the strength of a second-stage Oracle-grade expert.
He was completely unaffected by the suppression of the Great Dao rules.
The summoned Human Forefather immediately locked onto the three mysterious experts before him.
His eyes widened with fury as he released an enraged roar.
Then, his figure charged forward like a violent gale.
"Impossible!"
"How can that thing possess Oracle-grade strength?"
"How many trump cards does this bastard have?"
"Damn it! He concealed himself far too deeply!"
"Don’t panic! I still have an Oracle-grade treasure!"
"Hahaha! I happen to have one as well!"
The experts panicked for only a moment before regaining their composure.
They prepared to take out their Oracle-grade treasures and counterattack.
However, countless enormous palms suddenly appeared from every corner of the universe.
Once Celestial Grasp was activated, the endless palm strikes surged forward like a boundless river of stars, rapidly closing in on them.
"Get out of my way!"
One expert shouted and activated his Oracle-grade treasure.
These people had originally been high-stage Oracle-grade experts.
It was perfectly normal for them to possess several treasures of that level.
The mysterious T7 expert Daniel had killed earlier had failed to use his Oracle-grade treasures only because he had underestimated Daniel.
Before he had the opportunity to take them out, Daniel had already killed him.
A T6 Oracle-grade treasure was more than enough to deal with the attacks before them.
An enormous fist suddenly appeared within the depths of the universe.
In a single instant, it shattered the projection of the Human Forefather, which possessed second-stage Oracle-grade strength.
The colossal fist continued forward without losing momentum and slammed into the countless palm strikes that resembled a river of stars.
However, Daniel’s endless waves of Celestial Grasp had already stacked their power to a level even he could no longer accurately estimate.
As the enormous fist collided with the endless palms, deafening humming noises spread throughout the battlefield.
Even so, the fist forcibly tore through layer after layer of palm strikes.
It eventually reached Daniel’s Emperor-class sacred vessel.
The vessel’s defensive formation activated instantly.
Just as the enormous fist approached, the formation blocked it completely.
Daniel had always enjoyed using Oracle-grade treasures to suppress and crush Oracle-grade enemies.
Now, he was finally experiencing what it felt like to be surrounded and bombarded by Oracle-grade treasures.
Yet he showed no fear whatsoever.
Instead, a cold smile appeared on his lips.
"You want to compete with me in the number of Oracle-grade treasures you possess?"
"What a group of naïve fools."
Suddenly, numerous Oracle-grade treasures began appearing across the battlefield.
There were five or six of them in total!
The instant the surrounding experts sensed their auras, their expressions changed drastically.
Several Oracle-grade treasure auras had suddenly emerged in the void.
The experts were horrified.
They felt as though they had just watched an inconspicuous beggar casually take out the ownership certificates for ten priceless luxury estates.
Meanwhile, they themselves could barely afford a bathroom.
The enormous disparity caused their faces to turn deathly pale.
Oracle-grade treasures were incomparably valuable even to them.
Many of them were single-use consumable items.
Even high-stage Oracle-grade experts like themselves would require hundreds of years to refine one.
Yet Daniel had casually produced five or six of them.
Their jealousy immediately reached its peak.
Rumble!
The Oracle-grade treasures launched their attacks simultaneously.
Daniel was treating every one of them as a disposable weapon.
The treasures came in various shapes and forms.
Although they were merely low-level Oracle-grade treasures, they were already more than sufficient to deal with the suppressed experts before him.
Under normal circumstances, the mysterious experts would never have taken such ordinary Oracle-grade treasures seriously.
A treasure of that level could have been erased with nothing more than a glance from them.
However, the Great Dao rules currently suppressed their strength to Divine-grade.
The ordinary Oracle-grade treasures they would normally have dismissed had now become terrifying weapons capable of taking their lives.
"Do you truly think we have no more trump cards?"
One expert suddenly sneered.
The next moment, he took out another T7 Oracle-grade treasure.
As soon as the T7 treasure appeared, it relied upon its overwhelming superiority in grade to destroy the five or six Oracle-grade treasures Daniel had summoned.
It shattered them one after another without giving them any opportunity to react.
But immediately afterward, dozens of brilliant lights appeared within the Emperor-class sacred vessel.
Even more Oracle-grade treasures emerged!
This time, every one of them belonged to the high-stage Oracle-grade level.
The weakest among them was T6.
There were even several T7 Oracle-grade treasures mixed among them.
Daniel had taken out dozens of high-stage Oracle-grade treasures at once.
Even he could not help but feel a trace of heartache.

chapters.title: Chapter 459 -459-Crushing Them All
paragraphs: After all, Oracle-grade treasures of this level were not things one could obtain casually.
They were part of the accumulated foundations of the Golden Holy Mountain, deposited there one by one by countless high-stage Oracle-grade experts over the ages.
Daniel had spent more than one hundred billion points merely to exchange for treasures of this level.
Converted into Origin Crystals, their value would have exceeded several trillion.
However, once they were unleashed, the effect was undeniable.
The mysterious experts were completely dumbfounded when they saw so many high-stage Oracle-grade treasures.
What exactly was going on?
Shouldn’t treasures of this level normally be kept hidden as ultimate trump cards?
Who would casually throw out an entire handful of them like cheap goods from a roadside stall?
What era had this powerhouse come from?
How could he possess such astonishing wealth?
The situation was utterly absurd.
However, the most important thing for them now was preserving their lives.
Without exception, these Oracle-grade treasures were ultimate weapons once owned by high-stage Oracle-grade experts.
Unlike the first batch of Oracle-grade treasures Daniel had released, this new wave was fully capable of killing them.
The experts immediately summoned their own Oracle-grade treasures.
The pain they felt was a hundred, a thousand, even ten thousand times greater than Daniel’s.
After all, unlike Daniel, they could not obtain Oracle-grade treasures in bulk as though they were roadside merchandise.
Two groups of Oracle-grade treasures now filled the battlefield.
All kinds of treasures began clashing against one another, competing in raw power and accumulated foundations.
The terrifying shock waves would have caused even a native high-stage Oracle-grade expert of this plane to tremble in fear.
This entire region had already transformed into a slaughterhouse for Oracle-grade power.
The strangest part was that this terrifying battlefield had been created by a group of experts who could currently display only Divine-grade cultivation.
What none of the mysterious experts knew was that Daniel’s true Rank was genuinely only Divine-grade.
They still believed that he was like them—a high-stage Oracle-grade existence whose cultivation had been suppressed to Divine-grade by the Great Dao.
After clashing for some time, they soon discovered that their high-stage Oracle-grade treasures could not compete with Daniel’s in either quantity or quality.
Daniel’s treasures had been accumulated by the Golden Holy Mountain throughout countless ages.
Every one of them was an exceptional treasure.
These high-stage Oracle-grade experts naturally could not possess nearly as many treasures of comparable quality.
As the battle continued, they gradually fell into a disadvantage.
"Damn it! We can’t defeat him. What should we do?"
"What else can we do? Run!"
"If we don’t escape now, we’ll die here!"
Realizing that the situation had turned against them, the experts immediately prepared to withdraw.
However, when they abruptly turned around, they discovered that Daniel had already established a spatial sealing barrier around them at some unknown point.
It was none other than the Voidbound Grail.
The moment Daniel summoned it, the treasure completely sealed the surrounding space.
"Heh. You want to escape?"
"There’s nowhere for any of you to go."
Daniel flicked his finger.
A flash of light appeared.
It was the Holy Spirit Stone, another Divine-grade treasure he had obtained not long ago.
The moment it emerged, the Holy Spirit Stone vanished from its original position.
When it reappeared, it had already pierced directly through the chest of one of the mysterious experts.
The man stared at the sudden hole in his chest with horrified disbelief.
His Origin had suffered a devastating injury in an instant.
"It’s over. I can’t escape."
Sure enough, the next moment, the black Divine Spear suddenly appeared.
Like a venomous serpent, it stabbed toward his back at astonishing speed.
Within only a few breaths, the mysterious expert’s body was shattered into fragments.
On this battlefield, even the life of an Oracle-grade powerhouse was as worthless as a blade of grass.
At the same time, the numerous Oracle-grade treasures truly began their massacre.
Two more mysterious experts found themselves with nowhere to escape and were completely surrounded and killed by the Oracle-grade treasures.
Furthermore, Daniel had already forced them to consume one round of their Oracle-grade treasures earlier.
As a result, only a small number of the remaining experts could still produce Oracle-grade treasures to defend themselves.
Daniel’s attacks never stopped.
They continued without the slightest sign of exhaustion.
His terrifying supreme sage-rank domain unfolded once again, covering tens of thousands of kilometers.
At the same time, projections of shattered stars appeared one after another.
Countless colossal slashing forces emerged from every corner of the sage-rank domain.
The Holy Spirit Stone and black Divine Spear relentlessly pursued the mysterious experts.
One high-stage Oracle-grade powerhouse after another fell on the spot.
Only a few minutes later, a single expert remained.
Every method and trump card he possessed had already been exhausted.
He could only watch helplessly as the black spear drew closer and closer.
Filled with unwillingness, he was blasted into fragments on the spot.
Daniel was simply that powerful.

No matter how high the original Ranks of these so-called high-stage Oracle-grade experts had been, the moment they were weakened to Divine-grade, the battle became a clash between opponents of the same realm.
Among those of the same Rank, Daniel could not possibly encounter a worthy opponent.
Dealing with these enemies was easier than drinking water.
[Ding! You have slain four mysterious experts!]
[This kill has triggered Millionfold Boost!]
[You have obtained Origin Crystals ×4,894,676,943,734,645!]
[Ding! Congratulations, Player. You have obtained six Primordial Supreme Treasures, twelve peak-grade rare Primordial treasures, and 182,838,373 Divine-grade treasures!]
Daniel listened to the continuous stream of notifications, and the corners of his mouth curled upward.
These people were far too weak to oppose him.
His figure flashed as he returned to the sacred vessel.
He then set its course and allowed it to continue forward automatically.
Only then did Daniel begin counting all of his spoils and placing them into the Basin of Greed.
Like an enormous mouth, the Basin of Greed rapidly swallowed every Divine-grade treasure.
Gemlike lights flickered from within it.
A seven-colored radiance faintly surged upward, while numerous astonishing auras began gestating inside the Basin of Greed.
After only a short while, all movement within the treasure disappeared.
As the gemlike radiance faded, Daniel extended his senses into the Basin of Greed.
"Did it succeed?"
This was the first time he had used the devouring characteristic of the advanced Basin of Greed.
According to its earlier description, every treasure it devoured could be transformed into an upgraded treasure.
Daniel simply did not know what grade the resulting treasures would reach.
At that moment, a system notification rang in his ears.
[Ding! This devouring has triggered Millionfold Boost!]
[Congratulations, Player. You have obtained Nameless Omnipotent Treasures at Primordial Supreme Treasure-grade ×20!]
"Nameless Omnipotent Treasures?"
"What kind of ridiculous thing is that?"
Hearing such a strange name, Daniel immediately reached into the Basin of Greed with curiosity and took out one of the newly upgraded treasures.
