chapters.title: Chapter 475 -475-The Struggle for the Throne Begins
paragraphs: Daniel looked at Dorek calmly.

"Do you believe Alvin is not already doing exactly that? He is using civil authority to recruit officials, purchase loyalty, and place his supporters throughout the Holy See. That is why you must complete your own arrangements immediately and without hesitation. Once the decisive moment arrives, we must be the side holding the initiative."
Dorek lowered his head in complete admiration.
"Teacher’s wisdom is beyond anything this student can match."
He truly meant it.

Daniel’s ruthlessness and absolute confidence had impressed Dorek from the beginning. If such a person had stood on the opposing side, Dorek suspected that no amount of personal effort would have allowed him to win.
Fortunately, Daniel was his teacher rather than his enemy.

Military orders began leaving Dorek’s residence one after another. Each carried the authority granted directly by the Eternal Emperor. Command tokens flashed through spacetime toward the imperial legions stationed across the universe.
As the orders were dispatched, Dorek raised another concern.
"Teacher, what happens if the Tribulation-Ash Monsters launch a major invasion while the legions are moving?"

The primary responsibility of the imperial military was to suppress Tribulation-Ash outbreaks and prevent the monsters from entering the empire’s populated territories. If the legions abandoned their defensive regions, many planes might fall.
The question concerned the future of countless lives, so Dorek could not ignore it.
Daniel’s answer was cold.

"At this stage, we do not need to consider it. The universe is approaching extinction. Tribulation-ash corruption has become irreversible. Continued resistance can delay the collapse, but it cannot prevent it."
He looked directly at Dorek.

"Our immediate objective is to seize supreme authority. Everything else can be sacrificed. Without the throne, you will possess neither the legitimacy nor the resources required to organize an evacuation from the dying universe."
Dorek fell into thought.

He understood the severity of tribulation-ash corruption better than most princes, but he had not realized that Daniel believed the entire universe was beyond salvation. The struggle was no longer about preserving every imperial territory. It was about gaining enough authority to choose what could still be saved.
Dorek released a long sigh.
"Even if I ascend the throne, the road ahead will remain this difficult. Teacher, I understand."
He had finally awakened to the scale of the problem.

The next ruler would inherit a crisis even greater than the one faced by the Eternal Emperor. The throne was not merely the highest reward in the empire. It was the command position of a civilization standing before extinction.
Dorek’s orders continued spreading.

Because he had been personally appointed to manage all military affairs, even legions currently engaged against Tribulation-Ash Monsters were required to suspend or reduce their campaigns and redeploy according to his commands.
Across the empire, ancient factions suddenly saw imperial armies arriving at their borders.

The powers behind the various princes were all guarded by high-stage Oracle-grade experts. Under normal circumstances, they feared no local authority. Yet every imperial legion also possessed high-stage Oracle-grade commanders, many of whom were stronger than the private experts of noble factions.
The legions did not merely pass through.
They established camps directly within the territories of the major powers. Fortresses appeared. Warships filled the skies. Formation towers rose around critical cities and transport gates.
The factions felt a chill.
Everyone knew that Dorek now controlled military deployments.
Why had he suddenly surrounded their territories?
Was he preparing to destroy every faction that refused to submit?

Panic spread quickly. The powers contacted the princes and representatives they maintained inside the Holy See, demanding information about Dorek’s intentions. At the same time, they issued formal protests, accusing him of abandoning regions threatened by tribulation ash and misusing the imperial legions for political coercion.
Inside the Holy See, Prince Alvin had already moved aggressively.

He recruited influential experts, removed officials unwilling to cooperate, and placed trusted subordinates in control of major departments. The institution responsible for the empire’s civil government was rapidly becoming his personal territory.
Dorek’s military movements caused immediate alarm.
"Your Highness, this matter is extremely serious," an elderly statesman said. "You must summon Dorek to the Holy See."
His face was grave.

"The imperial legions exist to suppress Tribulation-Ash Monsters throughout the empire. Now they are leaving their assigned regions and effectively abandoning those territories. Dorek’s objective is clearly enormous."
The elder leaned forward.

"If the legions can occupy the territories of the major factions today, they can enter the Imperial City tomorrow. What does Dorek intend? His ambition is already obvious. He plans to use the army to launch an uprising."
Alvin frowned. His gaze flickered as he considered the report. He had always been reserved, rarely revealing his thoughts, but he possessed strong opinions of his own.
Other Holy See experts quickly agreed with the elder.
"Dorek is undoubtedly preparing a military revolt. We cannot allow him to succeed."
"I have a strategy," another old minister said. "Use the military redeployment as a reason to summon Dorek for a formal meeting. We can arrange powerful experts on both sides of the chamber..."
He allowed the sentence to remain unfinished.
Everyone understood.

The Holy See was Alvin’s territory. If Dorek entered under the pretense of attending a meeting, they could surround and kill him before the legions reacted. Once Dorek died, Alvin would remain the only recognized heir in the Eternal Empire.
Alvin’s eyes shifted.
The first elder continued.

"Your Highness, the plan is entirely reasonable. Two crown princes cannot coexist forever. Dorek controls military affairs, while you control the civil government. This is the final test left by the Emperor. Only one of you can survive."
His expression became ruthless.
"Since conflict is inevitable, we must strike first."
Alvin drew in a slow breath.
"Explain exactly what we should do."
The elder smiled darkly.

"For now, show no hostility. On the contrary, reward Dorek generously. Praise his effective deployment of the legions. Raise his reputation and make him believe that the Holy See accepts his authority."
He lowered his voice.
"Once he relaxes, invite him to the palace for a meeting. The moment he enters the Holy See, we win."
Alvin frowned.
"What if he refuses to come?"

"Then we wait," the elder replied. "He may reject an ordinary meeting, but he cannot avoid the next ceremony at the Imperial Ancestral Temple. If Dorek intends to claim the throne, he must participate in the rites honoring the imperial ancestors."
The elder’s smile widened.
"We will arrange the ambush there instead. The result will be the same."
Alvin listened to the advisers around him. Gradually, a smile appeared on his face.
"The plan does sound reliable. Very well. Issue the order immediately. Send an envoy to reward Dorek for his successful military deployments."
He stood.
"We will raise him higher and higher, just as you suggested. When he finally lowers his guard, we will deliver the fatal strike."
Outside the Holy See, military fleets continued moving toward the Imperial City.
Inside it, Alvin’s faction prepared a trap.
The contest between the two heirs had passed beyond negotiation.
The struggle for the throne had truly begun.

chapters.title: Chapter 476 -476-Reaching the Summit
paragraphs: At that very moment, inside Prince Dorek’s residence, the envoy from the Holy See had only just departed.
The halls were still filled with the treasures and ceremonial rewards that had been delivered in the emperor’s name.
Crates of rare materials, sacred medicines, and exquisitely forged artifacts stood in ordered rows beneath the light of the palace lamps.
By any ordinary measure, it was a reward grand enough to make an ambitious prince rejoice.
Dorek, however, looked unusually gloomy.
He stared at the treasures in silence for a long time. There was no excitement in his eyes, only suspicion and unease. Finally, he turned toward Daniel.
"Teacher, what exactly does Prince Alvin mean by this? Why would he suddenly reward me at a time like this? Is he truly preparing to move against me?"
Daniel nodded, a faint smile appearing on his face.

"That is precisely what is happening, Your Highness. Alvin has finally realized that your existence threatens everything he has built. In his eyes, you have become one of the greatest dangers to his position."
Daniel leaned back calmly, as though he were discussing someone else’s fate rather than the final struggle for control of the Eternal Empire.

"You must remember what you currently command. The most elite military forces in the empire are gradually falling under your influence. You already possess enough raw Strength to destroy the forces behind the other princes by direct military action. If they do nothing now, they may never have another opportunity to reverse the situation."
Dorek’s expression grew heavier.

Daniel continued, "Alvin’s public reward is only a disguise. Wait and see. Barring an unexpected change, an envoy from the Holy See will arrive no later than tomorrow. They will invite you to a celebration, a private audience, or a meeting with some important official. The excuse will sound honorable, and the conditions may appear generous. But once you enter the Holy See under their arrangements, there is a very real chance that you will never return."
Dorek drew in a sharp breath.
"Then no matter how attractive their invitation sounds, I must refuse. Going there would be no different from delivering myself to my executioners."
"No." Daniel shook his head. "You are still thinking too simply."
His eyes narrowed slightly as he patiently explained the true danger.

"In several days, the imperial ancestral temple ceremony will be held. This is one of the most important rites of the Eternal Empire. You are a prince, and more importantly, you are already regarded by many as a possible successor to the throne. You must attend. If you refuse, your enemies will accuse you of disrespecting the imperial ancestors, rejecting the traditions of the empire, and lacking the virtue required of an emperor."
Daniel tapped one finger against the table.
"Once we begin from that fact, the location of their trap becomes obvious. They do not need to force you into the Holy See. They only need to wait for you at the imperial temple."
Dorek’s face changed again.

Daniel gave a slight nod. "If I were in Alvin’s position, I would make the same choice. The imperial temple is sacred ground. No ordinary legion is permitted to set foot there. No matter how numerous or elite your forces are, protocol will prevent them from entering with you. The moment you arrive without an army at your back, you will be entirely at their mercy."
The image of entering the imperial temple and being surrounded by Alvin’s people flashed through Dorek’s mind. Fear appeared in his eyes.
"Teacher, please save me."
Daniel could not help feeling somewhat helpless when he saw Dorek’s panic.

"Dorek, have you forgotten what I taught you? Never lose your composure when facing a crisis. More importantly, I instructed you long ago to begin moving the legions toward the Imperial City. Those forces are already assembling. We possess the advantage, and the path to victory is clear. The people who should be panicking are not us. They are the ones trapped by the changing situation. As long as everything proceeds according to plan, we have no reason to lose."
Dorek slowly steadied his breathing. The fear in his heart faded, replaced by renewed confidence.
Daniel smiled.

"In truth, the situation has already become much simpler. We only need to deal with the factions that continue to waver and refuse to cooperate. Those who have approached us voluntarily must be held firmly in our hands. As for the supposedly neutral powers, neutrality is merely indecision dressed in respectable clothing. We can pressure them, threaten their interests, and force them to choose. Once they understand the cost of remaining outside our camp, the entire situation will fall under our control."
Daniel placed his palm lightly upon the table.
His expression remained calm, but the words that followed carried unmistakable killing intent.
"Now we must give the other princes a warning they will never forget. The Duobao Starfield, the maternal power supporting Prince Kane, must be completely destroyed."
Dorek’s eyes widened.

Daniel continued without hesitation. "Its destruction will intimidate every faction in the empire. The wavering powers will understand that supporting you offers survival, while standing with Alvin or the other princes may bring annihilation. Fear is not enough to build a lasting empire, but at this stage, fear is the fastest way to end indecision."
Dorek felt his blood surge. For an instant, he wanted to issue the order immediately.
Daniel looked directly at him.

"Once Duobao Starfield is eliminated and the uncertain factions have made their choice, we can enter the Imperial City openly. We will suppress every rebellious power within the capital and prevent them from causing further trouble. When the capital, the legions, and the imperial institutions are all in our hands, the rest of the universe will naturally submit."
Dorek nodded firmly.
"Teacher, I understand. From this moment onward, everything will proceed according to your plan."
At the same time, within Duobao Starfield, the territory behind Prince Kane’s faction, rows of powerful imperial warriors advanced like an unstoppable iron train.

They smashed through checkpoints and charged directly toward the starfield’s headquarters. Along the way, disciples and local defenders rushed forward, attempting to stop the imperial army that had entered without warning.

"Where did you people come from?" a Divine-grade expert shouted as he blocked the legion’s path. "Do you possess an official deployment order? How dare you force your way into Duobao Starfield! Do you even know which prince our starfield supports? We are the power of Prince Kane’s maternal clan. Do you truly dare provoke us?"
The legion commander did not retreat by so much as half a step.

"Have you never heard that everything beneath the heavens belongs to the Eternal Empire? Duobao Starfield lies within imperial territory. Why would an imperial legion require your permission to inspect imperial land?"
The Divine-grade defender nearly blacked out from anger.

"Your duty is to suppress Tribulation-Ash disasters, not to invade loyal imperial territory and act without restraint. This is a blatant dereliction of duty. I will report everything that happened here to the Holy See. The Holy See will investigate your misconduct and hold every one of you responsible."
The commander sneered.

"Unfortunately for you, we came here precisely because of the Tribulation-Ash disaster. According to reliable intelligence, traces of a Tribulation-Ash Source are hidden within the headquarters of Duobao Starfield. We are required to enter, conduct a complete search, and determine whether the information is true."
"You are truly lawless."
A cold voice suddenly shook the surrounding space.
A T9 Oracle-grade powerhouse appeared above the battlefield. He was the Lord of Duobao Starfield and Prince Kane’s maternal uncle.

"Do you know who I am? Prince Kane is my nephew. I am a relative of the imperial family, and Duobao Starfield ranks among the ten greatest powers of the empire. Yet you dare trespass upon my territory, fabricate accusations, and demand a forced search. How absurd."
The legion commander remained unmoved beneath the T9 pressure.

"There is nothing absurd about it. If you obstruct an investigation into Tribulation-Ash corruption, your actions will be treated as concealment of Tribulation-Ash Monsters. If that happens, do not blame the imperial legion for acting against you personally."
The Starfield Lord frowned.
"You dare threaten me?"
The commander slowly raised the blade in his hand.
"You are about to discover exactly what we dare to do."
He turned toward the waiting army and roared,
"All troops, hear my command! Duobao Starfield is concealing a Tribulation Source. Destroy the entire starfield!"
In the next instant, countless weapons rose into the void.
The imperial legion surged forward like a steel flood, pouring into Duobao Starfield without the slightest hesitation.

Barring an unexpected change, an envoy from the Holy See will arrive no later than tomorrow.
They will invite you to a celebration, a private audience, or a meeting with some important official.
The excuse will sound honorable, and the conditions may appear generous.
But once you enter the Holy See under their arrangements, there is a very real chance that you will never return."
Dorek drew in a sharp breath.
"Then no matter how attractive their invitation sounds, I must refuse.
Going there would be no different from delivering myself to my executioners."
"No." Daniel shook his head.
"You are still thinking too simply."
His eyes narrowed slightly as he patiently explained the true danger.
"In several days, the imperial ancestral temple ceremony will be held.
This is one of the most important rites of the Eternal Empire.
You are a prince, and more importantly, you are already regarded by many as a possible successor to the throne.
You must attend.
If you refuse, your enemies will accuse you of disrespecting the imperial ancestors, rejecting the traditions of the empire, and lacking the virtue required of an emperor."
Daniel tapped one finger against the table.
"Once we begin from that fact, the location of their trap becomes obvious.
They do not need to force you into the Holy See.
They only need to wait for you at the imperial temple."
Dorek’s face changed again.
Daniel gave a slight nod.
"If I were in Alvin’s position, I would make the same choice.
The imperial temple is sacred ground.
No ordinary legion is permitted to set foot there.
No matter how numerous or elite your forces are, protocol will prevent them from entering with you.
The moment you arrive without an army at your back, you will be entirely at their mercy."
The image of entering the imperial temple and being surrounded by Alvin’s people flashed through Dorek’s mind.
Fear appeared in his eyes.
"Teacher, please save me."
Daniel could not help feeling somewhat helpless when he saw Dorek’s panic.
"Dorek, have you forgotten what I taught you?
Never lose your composure when facing a crisis.
More importantly, I instructed you long ago to begin moving the legions toward the Imperial City.
Those forces are already assembling.
We possess the advantage, and the path to victory is clear.
The people who should be panicking are not us.
They are the ones trapped by the changing situation.
As long as everything proceeds according to plan, we have no reason to lose."
Dorek slowly steadied his breathing.
The fear in his heart faded, replaced by renewed confidence.
Daniel smiled.
"In truth, the situation has already become much simpler.
We only need to deal with the factions that continue to waver and refuse to cooperate.
Those who have approached us voluntarily must be held firmly in our hands.
As for the supposedly neutral powers, neutrality is merely indecision dressed in respectable clothing.
We can pressure them, threaten their interests, and force them to choose.
Once they understand the cost of remaining outside our camp, the entire situation will fall under our control."
Daniel placed his palm lightly upon the table.
His expression remained calm, but the words that followed carried unmistakable killing intent.
"Now we must give the other princes a warning they will never forget.
The Duobao Starfield, the maternal power supporting Prince Kane, must be completely destroyed."
Dorek’s eyes widened.
Daniel continued without hesitation.
"Its destruction will intimidate every faction in the empire.
The wavering powers will understand that supporting you offers survival, while standing with Alvin or the other princes may bring annihilation.
Fear is not enough to build a lasting empire, but at this stage, fear is the fastest way to end indecision."
Dorek felt his blood surge.
For an instant, he wanted to issue the order immediately.
Daniel looked directly at him.
"Once Duobao Starfield is eliminated and the uncertain factions have made their choice, we can enter the Imperial City openly.
We will suppress every rebellious power within the capital and prevent them from causing further trouble.
When the capital, the legions, and the imperial institutions are all in our hands, the rest of the universe will naturally submit."
Dorek nodded firmly.
"Teacher, I understand.
From this moment onward, everything will proceed according to your plan."
At the same time, within Duobao Starfield, the territory behind Prince Kane’s faction, rows of powerful imperial warriors advanced like an unstoppable iron train.
They smashed through checkpoints and charged directly toward the starfield’s headquarters.
Along the way, disciples and local defenders rushed forward, attempting to stop the imperial army that had entered without warning.
"Where did you people come from?" a Divine-grade expert shouted as he blocked the legion’s path.
"Do you possess an official deployment order?
How dare you force your way into Duobao Starfield!
Do you even know which prince our starfield supports?
We are the power of Prince Kane’s maternal clan.
Do you truly dare provoke us?"
The legion commander did not retreat by so much as half a step.
"Have you never heard that everything beneath the heavens belongs to the Eternal Empire?
Duobao Starfield lies within imperial territory.
Why would an imperial legion require your permission to inspect imperial land?"
The Divine-grade defender nearly blacked out from anger.
"Your duty is to suppress Tribulation-Ash disasters, not to invade loyal imperial territory and act without restraint.
This is a blatant dereliction of duty.
I will report everything that happened here to the Holy See.
The Holy See will investigate your misconduct and hold every one of you responsible."
The commander sneered.
"Unfortunately for you, we came here precisely because of the Tribulation-Ash disaster.
According to reliable intelligence, traces of a Tribulation-Ash Source are hidden within the headquarters of Duobao Starfield.
We are required to enter, conduct a complete search, and determine whether the information is true."
"You are truly lawless."
A cold voice suddenly shook the surrounding space.
A T9 Oracle-grade powerhouse appeared above the battlefield.
He was the Lord of Duobao Starfield and Prince Kane’s maternal uncle.
"Do you know who I am?
Prince Kane is my nephew.
I am a relative of the imperial family, and Duobao Starfield ranks among the ten greatest powers of the empire.
Yet you dare trespass upon my territory, fabricate accusations, and demand a forced search.
How absurd."
The legion commander remained unmoved beneath the T9 pressure.
"There is nothing absurd about it.
If you obstruct an investigation into Tribulation-Ash corruption, your actions will be treated as concealment of Tribulation-Ash Monsters.
If that happens, do not blame the imperial legion for acting against you personally."
The Starfield Lord frowned.
"You dare threaten me?"
The commander slowly raised the blade in his hand.
"You are about to discover exactly what we dare to do."
He turned toward the waiting army and roared,
"All troops, hear my command!
Duobao Starfield is concealing a Tribulation Source.
Destroy the entire starfield!"
In the next instant, countless weapons rose into the void.
The imperial legion surged forward like a steel flood, pouring into Duobao Starfield without the slightest hesitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 477 -477-The Destruction of Treasure-Rich Starfield
paragraphs: "You have gone too far!"
The T9 Oracle-grade Lord of Treasure-Rich Starfield erupted in fury.

He had never imagined that an imperial legion would dare attack his territory so openly, much less under an accusation that everyone present understood to be a political excuse. His palm swept downward, carrying enough power to crush the advancing army in a single blow.

At his level, killing ordinary Divine-grade experts was no more difficult than trampling insects. Even a T7 Oracle-grade expert would struggle to survive a direct strike from him. Logically, no one within the imperial legion should have been capable of resisting that palm.
Yet just as the attack descended, a dazzling treasure light burst from the center of the army.
A pitch-black spear suddenly appeared.

The terrifying aura of a peak-grade Primordial Supreme Treasure spread across the starfield, causing the surrounding laws to tremble. The person controlling the spear was the strongest commander within the expeditionary force, a T8 Oracle-grade legion commander.
By relying upon cultivation alone, the commander was not the Starfield Lord’s equal. The difference between T8 and T9 could not ordinarily be crossed by courage or military experience.
However, Daniel had lent him the black Divine Spear before the operation began.
With that weapon in his hands, everything changed.

The spear thrust forward. Its point tore through the descending palm force as though piercing a thin sheet of paper. The attack capable of slaughtering an entire legion shattered instantly, while the spear continued forward without losing momentum.
"You dare attack the army of the Eternal Empire?" the commander roared. "You are courting death!"
The Divine Spear erupted with a terrifying tide of spear intent.

In an instant, countless black spear projections appeared throughout every corner of Treasure-Rich Starfield. They rose from the void, from shattered planets, from the gaps between worlds, and from the darkness beyond the defensive formations. Like an endless black tide, they surged across the entire territory.
"Impossible!"
The Starfield Lord’s face changed dramatically.

He was a T9 Oracle-grade powerhouse, yet a T8 commander had destroyed his attack in a single exchange. Even more terrifying was the aura of the black spear. The weapon carried a power that made his instincts scream in warning.
He raised his hands to defend himself.
Only then did he realize that a black spear had already pierced his chest.
Blood sprayed from his mouth.

The Starfield Lord attempted to summon his laws, but the next instant, countless spear projections converged upon him from every direction. They pierced his body until he resembled a figure covered in black thorns.
His Life Origin began to collapse.

The destructive power within the spear did not merely damage flesh. It ground away his Great Dao foundation, erased his Divine Soul, and annihilated the life imprint hidden within his Origin. Every method of revival was severed one after another.
Within moments, the T9 Oracle-grade Lord of Treasure-Rich Starfield was dead.
Not even a fragment of his Divine Soul remained.

The legion commander who had personally launched the attack stared at the empty space in astonishment. Although he had known that Daniel’s weapon was powerful, he had not expected it to kill a T9 Oracle-grade expert with such ease.
"As expected of the weapon bestowed by that lord," he murmured. "Its power is truly terrifying."
Then he raised his voice so that it echoed throughout the entire starfield.
"The Starfield Lord is dead! Those who surrender will be spared. All remaining inhabitants are to evacuate immediately. The imperial legion will conduct a complete cleansing of this territory."
The ordinary members of Treasure-Rich Starfield had already lost every trace of courage.

Their greatest protector had died before their eyes. If a T9 Oracle-grade expert could not resist the black spear, what could the rest of them accomplish? They rushed toward their vessels, activated escape formations, and fled the starfield in every direction.
The imperial legion advanced without obstruction.

Once the inhabitants had withdrawn, the soldiers began destroying every palace, fortress, treasury, cultivation ground, and defensive formation belonging to Treasure-Rich Starfield. Planets were shattered. Sacred mountains collapsed. Ancient halls that had stood for millions of years were reduced to ruins.
In less than half a day, the entire starfield had been devastated.

The once-prosperous territory became a wasteland filled with fractured worlds and drifting debris. Its spiritual veins had been severed, its headquarters erased, and its foundations destroyed so thoroughly that rebuilding was no longer realistic.
Treasure-Rich Starfield had fallen.
The news spread across the Eternal Empire like a cosmic storm.

Countless factions and powerful experts were shaken. The Lord of Treasure-Rich Starfield had been a T9 Oracle-grade powerhouse. If even he had failed to stop the imperial army, what chance did ordinary factions possess?
Those who had witnessed the battle claimed that the Starfield Lord had died without leaving behind so much as a trace of Divine Soul. His death had been absolute and horrifying.

The destruction of the territory was equally complete. Treasure-Rich Starfield was no longer suitable for habitation, much less for supporting a major power. From that day forward, there was virtually no possibility that its faction would recover.
Fear immediately spread among every independent power whose territory lay near an imperial legion.
No one knew where Dorek’s armies would strike next.
No one knew which faction would be accused of concealing Tribulation-Ash corruption, and no one wished to discover whether their own defenses could resist Daniel’s black spear.
Within the Imperial City, private discussions erupted in every noble residence.
"Prince Dorek is far more ruthless than we imagined."
"He destroyed one of the ten greatest powers without hesitation. Compared to him, the political schemes I once considered impressive now seem like children’s games."
"Who can still stop him? Who would dare oppose him openly? The moment a faction resists, its entire starfield may be erased."
"Many princes will probably abandon Alvin and secretly submit to Dorek now. At the very least, surrender may keep their maternal clans from suffering the same fate as Treasure-Rich Starfield."
Their predictions quickly became reality.
After the destruction of Treasure-Rich Starfield, numerous princes who had relied upon powerful maternal factions withdrew their support from Prince Alvin and turned toward Dorek.

Their submission was not without conditions, but the exchange greatly favored Dorek. In return for protection, he gained the unrestricted right to mobilize their resources, including high-stage Oracle-grade combat forces, military fleets, information networks, and enormous reserves of wealth.
While political tension filled the Imperial City, the western starfield legions continued obeying their deployment orders. One after another, they established camps near the capital.
Several vast armies now stood outside the city walls.
The Imperial City had fallen beneath Dorek’s military shadow. No faction dared oppose him publicly.
Inside the Holy See, the news of Treasure-Rich Starfield’s destruction and the arrival of the legions caused the hearts of many experts to sink.

The situation could no longer be misunderstood. Dorek’s armies had surrounded the capital and could enter at any moment. If the legions broke through the Holy See, none of Alvin’s supporters could expect a favorable end.
Many experts began wavering. Loyalty and promised wealth suddenly seemed far less important than survival.
A number of senior elders, however, had served Alvin too long to change sides safely. They could only attempt to calm him.

"Your Highness, we must not lose control of ourselves," one elder said solemnly. "Dorek may have destroyed Treasure-Rich Starfield and surrounded the capital, but he still does not dare order his armies directly into the Imperial City. Even if he did, entering the city is not the same as conquering the Holy See."

The elder continued, "You still hold the central administrative authority of the empire. No matter how many soldiers Dorek commands, he must consider the consequences before attacking you. We need only remain steady until the imperial temple ceremony. Once that day arrives, our arrangements will give us victory. The closer we come to the decisive moment, the more important it is to prevent Dorek from taking further reckless action."
Another elder offered a more humiliating proposal.

"Your Highness should issue an official proclamation condemning Treasure-Rich Starfield for concealing Tribulation-Ash corruption. Publicly support Dorek’s operation. If he believes we have submitted temporarily, he may refrain from striking us before the ceremony."
Prince Alvin clenched his teeth.

"I have endured enough. I have lowered my dignity again and again to satisfy that man. Now he is standing on my head, and you still tell me to endure. Tell me, exactly how much longer must I continue swallowing this humiliation?"
No one in the hall could answer him.

chapters.title: Chapter 478 -478-The Outcome Was Decided
paragraphs: Prince Alvin’s chest burned with anger.

"I have already lowered myself as far as possible to appease Dorek," he said through clenched teeth. "Tell me, how much longer am I expected to flatter him? How many more humiliations must I endure before any of you admit that retreat has become surrender?"
The elders below remained silent.

None of them possessed an answer capable of changing the situation. Every political calculation they had once relied upon had been overturned by military force. Dorek’s legions were outside the capital. Treasure-Rich Starfield had been erased. Even factions that had supported Alvin for years were secretly contacting his rival.
After a long silence, Alvin released a weary sigh.
"Very well. Issue the proclamation exactly as you suggested."
Not long afterward, an official document spread throughout the universe.

The Holy See publicly declared that Treasure-Rich Starfield had harbored Tribulation-Ash corruption and concealed dangerous traces of a Tribulation Source. Its destruction by the imperial legion was defined as a lawful act performed for the safety of the Eternal Empire.
Anyone with even the slightest political awareness understood the true meaning.
Dorek’s momentum had become unstoppable.
Even Prince Alvin, who still nominally controlled the central institutions of the empire, had been forced to lower his head and publicly justify Dorek’s actions.
Within Dorek’s residence, a very different atmosphere prevailed.
"Teacher, all western starfield legions are now in position," Dorek reported. He released a long breath and looked visibly satisfied with the situation.
Hundreds of millions of powerful warriors were stationed outside the Imperial City. If he issued a single command, they could launch an attack capable of reducing the capital to ruins.

More importantly, the Imperial City Defense Department had already shifted toward Dorek’s faction. Its commanders, guards, formations, and intelligence officers were prepared to defect whenever he gave the signal.
Dorek now controlled nearly every security system inside and outside the capital.
Only the imperial palace and the Holy See remained under Alvin’s influence.
Daniel considered the situation for a moment before speaking.

"Order the Oric Legion, commanded by Divine Emperor Audric, to enter the city. Audric is your maternal grandfather. You can trust him completely. Once the Oric Legion is inside the capital, surround the residences of every expert belonging to the Holy See. Do not allow any of them to leave the sacred district."
Daniel’s voice remained calm, but his instructions were merciless.

"In addition, place Prince Alvin under confinement. Separate him from his supporters, his officials, and his remaining military assets. The best result is to turn him into a commander without soldiers and a prince without followers."
Dorek nodded.
"And after that?"
Daniel smiled faintly.

"After that, you will bring the Holy See experts under guard and travel to the imperial temple with the Oric Legion. If you arrive accompanied by an army loyal only to you, no one will dare move against you during the ceremony. Once the ancestral rites are completed, you can begin preparations for your enthronement. By then, even your father will have little ability to stop you."
The word enthronement caused Dorek’s heart to pound.

He had waited for this moment for far too long. For years, the throne had seemed like a distant dream, something reserved for brothers with stronger clans, richer supporters, and greater favor from the court. Now, for the first time, he could almost reach it.
Orders were issued one after another.

The Oric Legion entered the Imperial City without encountering meaningful resistance. The city gates opened, the defense formations recognized the legion’s authority, and the guards stationed along the main avenues quietly withdrew.
The moment the legion entered, it surrounded the residences of every major expert associated with the Holy See.
All Holy See experts were ordered to remain within their estates. Anyone attempting to leave without authorization would be killed immediately.
Those who happened to be outside when the operation began were gathered in guarded compounds. Their communication artifacts were sealed, their movements restricted, and their subordinates disarmed.
When the elders within the Holy See received the reports, their minds went blank.

Only then did they fully understand that the rhythm of the Imperial City had fallen entirely into Dorek’s hands. Every road, military formation, gate, and administrative channel was being controlled by his faction.
No matter what plan they created, they no longer possessed the force required to execute it.
Everything they had done from the beginning now resembled the performance of clowns before an audience that had already decided the outcome.
Several elders lowered their heads in despair. They had no idea what move remained available.
In truth, everyone understood the same thing.
Dorek was about to ascend the throne.
The day was very close.

When Prince Alvin learned that his supporters had been confined and the city had fallen under military control, he finally accepted that the broader situation was lost. He dismissed the experts still gathered around him and allowed them to leave freely.
From that moment onward, Alvin became truly isolated.
He still possessed the title of prince, but no one remained willing to gamble their life upon his victory.
Several days later, the date of the imperial ancestral ceremony arrived.
As Daniel had predicted, the Holy See sent Dorek a formal invitation.

Dorek made no attempt to conceal his strength. Following Daniel’s instructions, he traveled to the secret realm of the imperial temple accompanied by the entire Oric Legion and the Holy See experts who had been placed under guard.
Within the procession, Daniel saw Divine Emperor Audric for the second time.

Their first meeting had occurred inside a secret-realm instance. At that time, Audric had been dressed in rags and covered in severe wounds. He had crossed the Time River while gravely injured and arranged for countless members of the Fated Human Race to settle within the Myriad-Race Universe.
The man before Daniel now looked completely different.

Audric stood tall in an expensive set of imperial armor. His presence was majestic, his eyes sharp, and his aura vast enough to shake the surrounding space. There was not the slightest trace of his former wretched appearance.

According to the information Daniel had received, Audric had already reached half-step Eternal Grade. He had merely concealed his true cultivation for many years, showing the outside world only the aura of a peak T9 expert.
As Dorek’s maternal grandfather, Audric naturally supported him without reservation.
He also regarded Daniel with great approval. Audric understood better than most that Dorek could never have reached this point without Daniel’s guidance.

In the beginning, Dorek had been a neglected prince with almost no one beside him except an old servant. He had not even dared remain within the Imperial City. His greatest ambition had been to flee toward the Heavenly Fate Starfield and seek the protection of the Fated Human Race.
Now, he had surpassed every competing prince, taken command of the imperial legions, and defeated Prince Alvin.
All that remained was the throne.
Every expert within Dorek’s faction, whether they had supported him from the beginning or joined only after his rise, understood Daniel’s contribution.
No one could replace Daniel’s position in Dorek’s heart.
During the procession, Daniel stood only half a step behind Dorek. No one else was permitted to stand ahead of them.

The sight filled many realm-crossers with envy. They had all crossed time and arrived in this era under similar conditions, yet Daniel had surpassed them completely and now stood above countless imperial officials.
Inside the imperial temple, the complicated ancestral rites proceeded according to ancient tradition.
The Eternal Emperor was absent, still secluded somewhere while attempting to overcome his tribulation. His absence turned the ceremony into a formal sequence performed without its previous ruler.
Once the final rite ended, the civil and military officials assembled in ordered ranks.
Before all of them, Dorek changed into the robes of the emperor.
He stepped onto the imperial platform and issued a proclamation to the entire universe.
From that moment onward, he was the new ruler of the Eternal Empire.
Dorek entered the imperial palace and immediately assumed control of every central authority. Prince Alvin was stripped of all official power, military access, and administrative privileges.
The Eternal Empire had received its new sovereign.
Emperor Dorek had ascended the throne.

Hundreds of millions of powerful warriors were stationed outside the Imperial City.
If he issued a single command, they could launch an attack capable of reducing the capital to ruins.
More importantly, the Imperial City Defense Department had already shifted toward Dorek’s faction.
Its commanders, guards, formations, and intelligence officers were prepared to defect whenever he gave the signal.
Dorek now controlled nearly every security system inside and outside the capital.
Only the imperial palace and the Holy See remained under Alvin’s influence.
Daniel considered the situation for a moment before speaking.
"Order the Oric Legion, commanded by Divine Emperor Audric, to enter the city.
Audric is your maternal grandfather.
You can trust him completely.
Once the Oric Legion is inside the capital, surround the residences of every expert belonging to the Holy See.
Do not allow any of them to leave the sacred district."
Daniel’s voice remained calm, but his instructions were merciless.
"In addition, place Prince Alvin under confinement.
Separate him from his supporters, his officials, and his remaining military assets.
The best result is to turn him into a commander without soldiers and a prince without followers."
Dorek nodded.
"And after that?"
Daniel smiled faintly.
"After that, you will bring the Holy See experts under guard and travel to the imperial temple with the Oric Legion.
If you arrive accompanied by an army loyal only to you, no one will dare move against you during the ceremony.
Once the ancestral rites are completed, you can begin preparations for your enthronement.
By then, even your father will have little ability to stop you."
The word enthronement caused Dorek’s heart to pound.
He had waited for this moment for far too long.
For years, the throne had seemed like a distant dream, something reserved for brothers with stronger clans, richer supporters, and greater favor from the court.
Now, for the first time, he could almost reach it.
Orders were issued one after another.
The Oric Legion entered the Imperial City without encountering meaningful resistance.
The city gates opened, the defense formations recognized the legion’s authority, and the guards stationed along the main avenues quietly withdrew.
The moment the legion entered, it surrounded the residences of every major expert associated with the Holy See.
All Holy See experts were ordered to remain within their estates.
Anyone attempting to leave without authorization would be killed immediately.
Those who happened to be outside when the operation began were gathered in guarded compounds.
Their communication artifacts were sealed, their movements restricted, and their subordinates disarmed.
When the elders within the Holy See received the reports, their minds went blank.
Only then did they fully understand that the rhythm of the Imperial City had fallen entirely into Dorek’s hands.
Every road, military formation, gate, and administrative channel was being controlled by his faction.
No matter what plan they created, they no longer possessed the force required to execute it.
Everything they had done from the beginning now resembled the performance of clowns before an audience that had already decided the outcome.
Several elders lowered their heads in despair.
They had no idea what move remained available.
In truth, everyone understood the same thing.
Dorek was about to ascend the throne.
The day was very close.
When Prince Alvin learned that his supporters had been confined and the city had fallen under military control, he finally accepted that the broader situation was lost.
He dismissed the experts still gathered around him and allowed them to leave freely.
From that moment onward, Alvin became truly isolated.
He still possessed the title of prince, but no one remained willing to gamble their life upon his victory.
Several days later, the date of the imperial ancestral ceremony arrived.
As Daniel had predicted, the Holy See sent Dorek a formal invitation.
Dorek made no attempt to conceal his strength.
Following Daniel’s instructions, he traveled to the secret realm of the imperial temple accompanied by the entire Oric Legion and the Holy See experts who had been placed under guard.
Within the procession, Daniel saw Divine Emperor Audric for the second time.
Their first meeting had occurred inside a secret-realm instance.
At that time, Audric had been dressed in rags and covered in severe wounds.
He had crossed the Time River while gravely injured and arranged for countless members of the Fated Human Race to settle within the Myriad-Race Universe.
The man before Daniel now looked completely different.
Audric stood tall in an expensive set of imperial armor.
His presence was majestic, his eyes sharp, and his aura vast enough to shake the surrounding space.
There was not the slightest trace of his former wretched appearance.
According to the information Daniel had received, Audric had already reached half-step Eternal Grade.
He had merely concealed his true cultivation for many years, showing the outside world only the aura of a peak T9 expert.
As Dorek’s maternal grandfather, Audric naturally supported him without reservation.
He also regarded Daniel with great approval.
Audric understood better than most that Dorek could never have reached this point without Daniel’s guidance.
In the beginning, Dorek had been a neglected prince with almost no one beside him except an old servant.
He had not even dared remain within the Imperial City.
His greatest ambition had been to flee toward the Heavenly Fate Starfield and seek the protection of the Fated Human Race.
Now, he had surpassed every competing prince, taken command of the imperial legions, and defeated Prince Alvin.
All that remained was the throne.
Every expert within Dorek’s faction, whether they had supported him from the beginning or joined only after his rise, understood Daniel’s contribution.
No one could replace Daniel’s position in Dorek’s heart.
During the procession, Daniel stood only half a step behind Dorek.
No one else was permitted to stand ahead of them.
The sight filled many realm-crossers with envy.
They had all crossed time and arrived in this era under similar conditions, yet Daniel had surpassed them completely and now stood above countless imperial officials.
Inside the imperial temple, the complicated ancestral rites proceeded according to ancient tradition.
The Eternal Emperor was absent, still secluded somewhere while attempting to overcome his tribulation.
His absence turned the ceremony into a formal sequence performed without its previous ruler.
Once the final rite ended, the civil and military officials assembled in ordered ranks.
Before all of them, Dorek changed into the robes of the emperor.
He stepped onto the imperial platform and issued a proclamation to the entire universe.
From that moment onward, he was the new ruler of the Eternal Empire.
Dorek entered the imperial palace and immediately assumed control of every central authority.
Prince Alvin was stripped of all official power, military access, and administrative privileges.
The Eternal Empire had received its new sovereign.
Emperor Dorek had ascended the throne.

chapters.title: Chapter 479 -479-The Imperial Proclamation
paragraphs: Immediately after ascending the throne, Emperor Dorek issued his first appointment.
It concerned Daniel.
An imperial herald unfolded the decree before the gathered court and read in a voice that echoed throughout the palace.

"By command of the emperor, Daniel is hereby appointed Imperial Tutor and granted authority equal to that of the Imperial Chancellor. He shall also receive the hereditary title Lion King. From this day forward, beneath the emperor, no person in the Eternal Empire may command Daniel to bow or submit."
The decree was accompanied by an astonishing quantity of rare treasures, sacred materials, medicines, artifacts, and cultivation resources.
At the same time, system notifications rang in Daniel’s ears.
[Congratulations! You have become Imperial Chancellor and Imperial Tutor, attaining a position beneath one ruler and above all other subjects. The main quest has been completed!]

The office of Imperial Chancellor represented the highest position an official could reach within the Holy See and the imperial administration. It perfectly satisfied the requirement of standing beneath only one person while ruling above countless others.
A king who did not share the imperial bloodline was already exceedingly rare. Daniel was the first minister in the history of the Eternal Empire to receive such a title through merit alone.
His status as Imperial Tutor was even more prestigious. In accordance with ceremony, even Emperor Dorek would acknowledge Daniel as his teacher and offer the formal respect of a disciple.
Apart from Dorek himself, Daniel had become the greatest victor of the succession struggle.
He now stood at the summit of political power, a minister whose authority surpassed that of every official in imperial history.
[Ding! The current reward has triggered Millionfold Boost!]
[You have obtained Divine-grade treasure embryos x10, Divine-grade cultivation methods x10, Divine-grade potions x10, Divine-grade materials x10, and Divine-grade spirit pets x10!]
[Congratulations! You have obtained 50,000,000 Realm-Crosser Points!]
[Congratulations! You have obtained a new official position. Would you like to randomly draw a new Racial Talent immediately?]
Daniel drew in a breath when he saw the enormous number of points.

Fifty million was a staggering reward. However, a Great Universal Will Fragment cost one hundred million points, which meant that even this fortune was not enough to purchase one through the exchange shop.
He soon dismissed the disappointment.

"It does not matter. I already know that a Great Universal Will Fragment is stored within the imperial treasury. If I express the slightest interest, Dorek will personally deliver it to me. There is no reason to waste one hundred million points on something I can obtain directly."
Daniel shifted his attention to the Racial Talent draw.
"Last time, I shared my War God Physique with the human race. This time, I will choose a random talent. Let us see what kind of Racial Talent my luck produces."
He made the selection with a thought.
"Randomly draw a Racial Talent."
[Random draw complete!]
[You have obtained the Racial Talent: Treasure Seeking Ability!]
Daniel’s eyes brightened.
Unlike the War God Physique, which had been copied from an ability he already possessed, a randomly obtained talent would also benefit him personally.
He immediately opened the information panel.
[Treasure Seeking Ability]
[Effect]: Every member of the race can sense all ownerless treasures within hundreds of millions of kilometers and rapidly determine their exact locations.
[Description]: This Racial Talent is shared by the entire race. It applies to every being possessing the corresponding racial bloodline, including all members born in the future.
Daniel smiled after reading the description.

The ability was extremely useful. It allowed him to detect ownerless treasures across a vast region, including artifacts concealed in secret realms or locations beyond the range of ordinary Divine Sense.
He activated it immediately, intending to test its effect.
Nothing appeared.

Daniel was still within the imperial palace and the Holy See. Every treasure in the surrounding region belonged either to the emperor, the empire, or a recognized official. Since none of them were ownerless, the talent naturally remained silent.
At the same time, within the Myriad-Race Universe, a human player was piloting a starship through the Endless Starsea.
A notification suddenly rang in his ears.
[Congratulations! You have obtained the Racial Talent: Treasure Seeking Ability!]
The player froze.
"What is happening? We received another Racial Talent?"
He clearly remembered that Daniel had shared a powerful racial ability not long ago. He had never expected a second one to arrive so quickly.
"Boss Daniel truly is incredible. He is the pride of every human player."
The player excitedly opened the talent panel. The moment he read the effect, his eyes shone.
"A treasure-detection talent? This is an unbelievable profit!"

Abilities capable of detecting hidden treasure were extraordinarily rare. Skills, bloodlines, and artifacts with similar functions were coveted across the universe. Yet every human player had now received such an ability for free.
The player immediately activated it.
In the next instant, every ownerless treasure within hundreds of millions of kilometers appeared within his perception. Their directions and approximate distances became astonishingly clear.
"It really works. There is something over there!"
He quickly realized that the signal came from a concealed secret realm filled with unclaimed artifacts.
"I am rich! This is practically a treasure vault gifted to me by Boss Daniel. Thank you, Boss Daniel!"
Unable to contain his excitement, he turned his starship and raced toward the detected location.

Across the human race, similar scenes unfolded. Countless players, settlers, and newly born members of humanity awakened the same ability. Hidden treasures that had remained undiscovered for ages began entering human hands.
Inside the Eternal Empire, Daniel’s appointment was only the beginning of the new emperor’s rewards.

The second major appointment was granted to Divine Emperor Audric, who also received a royal title. Afterward, other supporters were rewarded according to their contributions. Military commanders gained territory and authority. Civil officials obtained ranks and resources. Powerful factions received formal recognition and imperial privileges.
Once the rewards were distributed, Dorek began dealing with the defeated princes.

Prince Lucian and Prince Alvin still possessed considerable reputation and residual influence. Executing them immediately could provoke unnecessary resistance, so they were placed under permanent confinement and guarded closely.

Prince Kane received no such protection. He had directly attempted to harm Dorek, and Treasure-Rich Starfield, the power behind him, had already been destroyed. An appropriate charge was selected, judgment was passed, and Kane was executed.
Dorek also ordered the imperial legions to return gradually to their original stations and resume suppressing Tribulation-Ash outbreaks throughout the empire.
The succession struggle finally settled.
Several days later, Dorek came to Daniel with a deeply worried expression.

"Teacher, please tell me what we should do next. Only after truly taking control of the empire did I understand that everything you warned me about was real. This universe is approaching destruction, and the advance of Tribulation-Ash corruption cannot be reversed. Please tell me how I can save the empire."
Although he was now emperor, Dorek remained as humble before Daniel as he had been when he was only a desperate prince.
Daniel answered slowly.

"At present, you have only two possible paths. The first is to accept that Tribulation-Ash corruption cannot be stopped and wait for the previous Eternal Emperor to survive his tribulation. If he successfully enters the Eternal Realm, he may possess a method capable of extending the life of this universe."
Daniel paused before adding the truth.
"Unfortunately, that hope is extremely small. Advancing into the Eternal Realm is never easy, even for someone who once ruled the entire empire."

chapters.title: Chapter 480 -480-A Path to Survival
paragraphs: "There is, of course, a second path," Daniel continued. "You can search for an entirely new universe and turn it into the future homeland of the Eternal Empire."
His tone was calm, but the proposal was vast enough to determine the fate of countless lives.

"Many supreme factions still exist throughout the Eternal Universe. Have you considered bringing them all under imperial control? They possess immense reserves of resources, terrifying military forces, and territories that are practically independent kingdoms. They resemble regional lords who acknowledge the empire only when it benefits them."
Daniel’s voice grew colder.

"Rather than allow those forces to remain idle while the universe approaches destruction, assemble them into a single expeditionary legion. Send that force deep into the Endless Starsea and make it search for a young, newly born universe that can become your people’s next home."
Dorek fell into thought.

He did not reject the proposal, but he immediately saw the political difficulty. The great factions had obeyed him only because his legions had surrounded the capital and destroyed Treasure-Rich Starfield. Would they truly surrender their elite experts and accumulated wealth to a newly enthroned emperor?
"Teacher," Dorek said honestly, "what should I do if those powers refuse my order?"
Daniel answered without hesitation.

"There is no need to worry. Begin by ordering the Fated Human Race to contribute part of its forces. Once the Fated Human Race publicly obeys, the remaining factions will lose their best excuse for resisting. Anyone who still refuses an imperial command can be treated as a rebel and suppressed by force."

He continued, "The Oracle Hall must also provide manpower. Its Oracle-grade experts have enjoyed the resources and offerings of the empire for countless years. It would be unreasonable for them to refuse service when the entire universe faces extinction."
Daniel looked directly at Dorek.

"Issue the order immediately. Gather experts from the Fated Human Race, the Oracle Hall, and every major faction. Reorganize them into an expeditionary legion and send them into the Endless Starsea to search for information concerning new universes. The sooner they depart, the greater the chance that the empire will survive."
Dorek carefully considered every part of the plan.

At present, there truly was no better alternative. Waiting for the previous Eternal Emperor to complete his breakthrough was little more than gambling the lives of an entire universe upon an almost impossible success. Searching for a new home was difficult, but it at least placed the future in their own hands.
Dorek issued several imperial decrees in rapid succession.

The Fated Human Race and the Oracle Hall were ordered to provide experts for a newly formed expeditionary force. Every other supreme faction within the empire was required to contribute warriors, vessels, resources, scouts, and navigators. The expedition would enter the Endless Starsea and search for a suitable universe before Tribulation-Ash corruption consumed their current home.
The Fated Human Race responded immediately and dispatched its people without complaint.
The other factions began delaying.
"What is the new emperor trying to do? He has only just taken the throne, yet he is already conscripting our experts."
"The empire already possesses enormous legions. Why create another force unless he intends to weaken the foundations of our families?"
"I cannot tolerate this new emperor. Should we unite and resist?"
"Resist? Have you forgotten what happened to Treasure-Rich Starfield? Its Lord was a T9 Oracle-grade expert, and the entire territory was still erased in half a day."
"The Fated Human Race has already sent an army. We cannot claim that the burden is unfairly placed upon us."
"We have all seen how ruthless the new emperor can be. For now, obedience is the only safe choice."
"Then we will obey in appearance and wait for a chance to regain control later."
The factions complained in private, but none dared issue an open refusal.
Inside the Holy See, Dorek looked at Daniel with surprise.
"Teacher, you said that the opportunity you seek is inside the imperial treasury. Is that true?"
Daniel had personally asked him for a treasure only moments earlier. It was the first time Dorek could remember his teacher requesting any direct reward.
Dorek did not hesitate.
"Everything inside the treasury is yours. Take whatever you require. Even if you emptied the entire place, I would not object."

The final sentence contained a trace of humor. The Eternal Empire had ruled its universe for immeasurable ages, and its treasury contained foundations far beyond those of ordinary factions. If Daniel truly removed everything, even Dorek would suffer a considerable headache.
Still, the offer revealed his sincerity.
Daniel understood the meaning behind it and smiled faintly.
"There is no need to empty the treasury. I require only one item."
"Then take it, Teacher. I will open every necessary authorization."
Dorek immediately granted Daniel unrestricted selection rights.
Not long afterward, a treasury archivist led Daniel into an underground palace built for the storage of imperial treasures.
"Imperial Tutor, what kind of artifact do you require? If you provide its designation, I will retrieve it immediately."

The rules of the imperial treasury were extremely strict. Even Daniel could not simply walk among the treasures. He was permitted to extend his Divine Sense through the sealed catalog, identify the object he wanted, and request it by number.
Daniel nodded and allowed his Divine Sense to spread into the depths of the treasury.
His only goal was the Great Universal Will Fragment.

Purchasing the fragment from the points shop required one hundred million Realm-Crosser Points. Daniel had no intention of wasting so many points when he now possessed legal access to the imperial treasury.
His perception soon locked upon the fragment.
The object was hidden inside layers of spatial seals and protected by laws far stronger than those surrounding ordinary artifacts. Daniel memorized its identification number.
The archivist immediately entered the restricted storage region.
When he returned with the treasure, even his disciplined hands trembled.
"My lord, the object you selected is one of the greatest treasures in the entire imperial treasury."

The archivist had expected Daniel to choose something valuable, but he had not imagined that the Imperial Tutor would select the unique supreme-grade treasure whose quality surpassed every other item in storage.
Nevertheless, the decision was not his to question. His duty was to retrieve the designated object, record the transaction, and report the complete process to the emperor.
He respectfully placed the Great Universal Will Fragment in Daniel’s hands.
Daniel left the treasury without looking at anything else.
Upon returning to his residence, he immediately activated the fragment.
[Ding! Please choose how to use the Great Universal Will Fragment.]
[Option One: Fuse the fragment directly.]
[Option Two: Use the fragment to advance a spacetime-law Sacred Art.]
Daniel made his choice the instant the notification appeared.
"Advance the Sacred Art."
[Ding! Advancement successful!]
[Your spacetime-law Sacred Art has evolved into Absolute Spacetime. Its grade has increased to mid-grade!]
Daniel released a long breath.
His spacetime Sacred Art had finally completed its long-awaited advancement.

He was permitted to extend his Divine Sense through the sealed catalog, identify the object he wanted, and request it by number.
Daniel nodded and allowed his Divine Sense to spread into the depths of the treasury.
His only goal was the Great Universal Will Fragment.
Purchasing the fragment from the points shop required one hundred million Realm-Crosser Points.
Daniel had no intention of wasting so many points when he now possessed legal access to the imperial treasury.
His perception soon locked upon the fragment.
The object was hidden inside layers of spatial seals and protected by laws far stronger than those surrounding ordinary artifacts.
Daniel memorized its identification number.
The archivist immediately entered the restricted storage region.
When he returned with the treasure, even his disciplined hands trembled.
"My lord, the object you selected is one of the greatest treasures in the entire imperial treasury."

The archivist had expected Daniel to choose something valuable, but he had not imagined that the Imperial Tutor would select the unique supreme-grade treasure whose quality surpassed every other item in storage.
Nevertheless, the decision was not his to question.
His duty was to retrieve the designated object, record the transaction, and report the complete process to the emperor.
He respectfully placed the Great Universal Will Fragment in Daniel’s hands.
Daniel left the treasury without looking at anything else.
Upon returning to his residence, he immediately activated the fragment.
[Ding!
Please choose how to use the Great Universal Will Fragment.]
[Option One: Fuse the fragment directly.]
[Option Two: Use the fragment to advance a spacetime-law Sacred Art.]
Daniel made his choice the instant the notification appeared.
"Advance the Sacred Art."
[Ding!
Advancement successful!]
[Your spacetime-law Sacred Art has evolved into Absolute Spacetime.
Its grade has increased to mid-grade!]
Daniel released a long breath.
His spacetime Sacred Art had finally completed its long-awaited advancement.

chapters.title: Chapter 481 -481-Advancement Complete
paragraphs: The moment Daniel obtained the Great Universal Will Fragment, he used it to advance his spacetime-law Sacred Art.
Absolute Spacetime rose directly to mid-grade.
Daniel immediately opened the new information panel.
[Absolute Spacetime]
[Grade]: Supreme Law
[Type]: Spacetime Law
[Effects]:

After activation, the user can transform a selected region within their sage-rank domain into an Absolute Spacetime Domain. Inside this domain, the user may freely manipulate the past and future of the affected area. After activation, the user can completely ignore every law-based Sacred Art below the sixth-tribulation level and become fully immune to all damage produced by treasures beneath peak-grade innate treasure level.
[Note]: This Sacred Art consumes an enormous amount of power. The user can control the past and future, but the longer the temporal distance involved, the greater the cost.
[Explanation]: Spacetime Law stands above ordinary laws. Possessing any true spacetime-law Sacred Art greatly increases resistance to enemy techniques involving time and space.
Spacetime Law can influence every other law unless the opposing law has reached the transcendent, ultimate, or terminal stage.
[Current State]: The user’s spacetime comprehension has reached the terminal stage. It can presently affect all targets below T6. Further advancement remains possible.
[Description]: Within the range of your sage-rank domain, no equal-Rank opponent can challenge your authority. You are the sole ruler of spacetime.
Daniel’s excitement rose as he read the description.

He had advanced Absolute Spacetime only once, yet it already made him effectively invincible against anything below T6. The ability to ignore lower-level Sacred Arts and freeze or rewrite events inside his own domain was far beyond an ordinary improvement.
The cost, however, was also immense.

As the grade of the technique increased, the amount of divine power required to support it would grow accordingly. To activate the law freely and sustain its strongest effects in continuous battle, Daniel estimated that he would need to reach Oracle-grade.
At present, he remained at Divine-grade.
"I still need one more law," Daniel murmured.

He had deliberately remained at his current Rank for so long because he wanted to accumulate an overwhelming foundation before facing the Great Dao Tribulation. Every additional transcendent law would increase his chance of passing the tribulation and would also determine how strong he became after advancing.

"My foundations are still slightly insufficient. If I can raise one more law to the transcendent stage, I will have enough. Then I will no longer need to remain trapped at Divine-grade. I can overcome the tribulation and enter Oracle-grade directly."
Daniel had already selected the final law he intended to cultivate.
"The Law of Destruction is the most suitable."
His gaze fell upon the black Divine Spear.

The weapon itself contained immense destructive power. Among the countless laws of the universe, Destruction possessed one of the highest offensive potentials. Once cultivated to a sufficiently high level, it could erase matter, Divine Souls, laws, Origins, and even the foundations of worlds.
For Oracle-grade experts, a law represented the road they walked, while Sacred Arts represented the methods through which they expressed that road.

A cultivator with comprehension but no suitable Sacred Art could not display their full Strength. A cultivator possessing powerful techniques without a stable law foundation could never progress indefinitely.
Daniel had comprehended dozens of laws, but only the Law of Causality and the Law of Reincarnation had reached the transcendent stage.
Those two laws were already enough to make him unmatched at Divine-grade.
If he wished to remain invincible after advancing to Oracle-grade, he needed a third transcendent law.
"Absolute Spacetime."
Daniel activated the Sacred Art with a thought.
The space around him began to flow like liquid. Irregular ripples spread outward, and the passage of time accelerated violently from his position.
The old buildings surrounding his residence began to change.

Cracked stone became smooth. Weathered walls regained their original brilliance. Faded carvings appeared newly cut. Figures emerged one after another, at first transparent and indistinct, then increasingly solid until they became living people drawn from an earlier moment in history.
The resurrected figures looked around in confusion.

Memories belonging to the reconstructed period flooded into their minds. They recognized familiar faces, ancient halls, and scenes they had already experienced. Fear gradually appeared when they realized that they were standing inside a time that had long since passed.
Before any of them could stabilize their emotions, the flow of spacetime changed again.
Every reconstructed figure vanished.
The buildings returned to their present condition, and silence filled the residence.
This was the terrifying authority of Spacetime Law.
It did not merely create an illusion. It could reach into the past, reproduce what had existed, and then erase the reconstruction by returning the region to the present.
Daniel slowly clenched his fist and smiled.
He was extremely satisfied with the Strength of Absolute Spacetime.
Elsewhere within the Myriad-Race Universe, two figures appeared from nothingness.
One was old, and the other was young.
The elder had white hair, a youthful face, and healthy red skin. At first glance, he seemed completely ordinary.

However, any Eternal Grade expert would immediately recognize the truth. The elder appeared to stand in one location, but his existence had already transcended that point. No Time River could leave a mark upon him. Past, present, and future flowed around his body without binding it.
He was an Eternal Grade powerhouse who had escaped the restraints of the Time River.
The young man beside him also possessed an unremarkable face.

His skin, however, was clear and radiant like divine crystal. Spiritual light flickered in his eyes, and law-based Sacred Arts moved around him with every gesture. His comprehension of the Great Dao had already reached an astonishing level.
"Kru," the elder asked with a smile, "what did you think of Narevis?"
The young man answered respectfully.

"Master, Narevis, whom some called Levis, was known as the Son of Eternity. His strength was naturally extraordinary. But as you explained, his two failed attempts to overcome the Eternal Tribulation were not accidents."
Kru’s voice remained calm and confident.

"You taught me that beneath the Endless Starfield, there is no tribulation that cannot be overcome. A cultivator merely needs to become stronger than the disaster placed before him. Narevis reached the peak of T9 in two separate lives, but his vision remained limited. No matter how powerful he became, he never broke through his own ultimate boundary. Without reaching the extreme summit, surviving the Eternal Tribulation was impossible. His final death was therefore inevitable."
The elder nodded.

"I have taken you through the Endless Starfield and across countless eras. You have challenged exceptional geniuses in every region. Among all of them, Narevis is one of the very few who earned such a detailed evaluation from you."
Kru smiled with absolute confidence.

"He was powerful, but not the strongest. At the very least, I am stronger. If Master removes the seals upon my cultivation and allows me to return to my original T7 Oracle-grade Rank, facing Narevis at his peak would not be difficult."
