chapters.title: Chapter 482 -482-Kru
paragraphs: At his strongest, Narevis had been a peak half-step Eternal expert.
The elder smiled faintly after hearing Kru’s confident declaration.
"Do you know why I brought you to this particular era?"
Kru answered without hesitation.

"There is little need to guess. Master must know that an exceptional genius stronger than Narevis exists in this timeline. You once told me that somewhere within the Myriad-Race Universe, I would encounter the final opponent of my long journey. This should be that place."
The elder nodded.
"Your deduction is correct. A great event will soon occur in this era. The Eternal Tribulation has reached its conclusion, and an age of disorder is about to descend upon this region of spacetime."
His gaze grew distant, as though he were remembering events far beyond the perception of ordinary cultivators.
"Within this era, only one person is worthy of your challenge. He is the sole existence qualified to become your opponent."
"A person?" Kru asked. "Master, are you referring to a human? What kind of supreme expert could such a race produce?"
His tone carried obvious contempt.
The elder immediately corrected him.

"Do not underestimate humanity. The human form is naturally suited to cultivation. Across the countless races of the Endless Starfield, why do so many powerful beings gradually transform into human form during the later stages of their path?"
He answered his own question.

"It is because the human body possesses one of the best balances for comprehending the Great Dao. Many non-human races must refine themselves into a human form before they can continue advancing efficiently. That truth is not an accident."
The elder paused.

"However, truly becoming human requires more than copying a body. One must understand the principle of balance contained within humanity. That balance provides tremendous potential, but it also makes reaching an absolute extreme extraordinarily difficult."
He looked at Kru.

"If one asks who might stand among the strongest beings of all ages, the answer could very well be God Daniel. I brought you here so that you may challenge the Daniel of this era, the being later revered as the God of Wisdom."
The name caused Kru’s expression to become solemn.

"Master, I remember what you taught me. Only the greatest existences at the peak of Eternal Grade are jointly honored as gods by other Eternal experts. You yourself are also one of those beings. A title such as God of Wisdom signifies a Rank infinitely close to the supreme sacred limit."
Kru’s eyes burned with battle intent.

"An Eternal Grade expert can create a universe. A supreme existence above ordinary Eternal Grade can open an entirely new Endless Starfield. If Daniel will one day reach that level, then he is indeed worthy of my challenge. When may I fight him?"
The elder gave a small nod.
"Do not be impatient. The most important task at present is observation. This timeline is about to enter a period of violent change. We will watch the situation before deciding when you should act."
"Understood, Master," Kru replied.
At the far end of the chaotic deep sea within the Endless Starfield stood a region pursued by countless high-stage Oracle-grade experts and even stronger beings.
It was known as the Sea at the End of Dao Realms.
Every Great Dao appeared to reach its limit there. Countless laws converged upon that region, gathering like rivers entering a boundless ocean.
The sea contained innumerable Dao Realms.

Each Dao Realm represented the foundation of an Eternal Grade expert. A Dao Realm was the ultimate evolution of a secret realm, and its quality exceeded that of an ordinary life universe by an unimaginable degree.
Eternal Grade experts cultivated, fought, and sometimes died within those domains.
Not every Dao Realm possessed a living master. The number of realms left behind across the endless ages far exceeded the number of Eternal experts still present to govern them.
Inside one such realm, an Eternal Grade expert was delivering a lecture upon the Great Dao.
Spacetime laws revolved around his body. No temporal current could restrain him, and the passage of years could not erode his existence.
Countless laws manifested through his aura and descended upon the audience below.
None of the listeners were ordinary. The weakest among them had reached T7 Oracle-grade, while T9 Oracle-grade experts were numerous.
They listened in complete fascination.
Without warning, the Eternal expert stopped speaking.
His disciples remained immersed in the lingering comprehension and failed to notice the silence.
The expert raised one finger and tapped the void several times, deducing changes that ordinary perception could never detect.
After a moment, he frowned.
"Strange. Why has the Eternal Tribulation ended so suddenly?"
He had survived the previous calamity through extraordinary luck. Whether he could endure the next was uncertain.
The opportunity that allowed him to avoid destruction had been granted by another mysterious existence. Since he had now survived, he could no longer delay fulfilling the promise he once made.
"I only hope that existence has also survived this calamity."
With that thought, the Eternal expert flicked his finger.
A thread of light shot from his hand and left the Dao Realm.
The light passed through the outer boundary, illuminating every ancient stone monument before the entrance.
Mistmoon Dao Realm.
It did not pause.
The radiance crossed the entire Chaos Starsea in an instant, entered the Time River, and raced directly toward the Myriad-Race Universe.
The light appeared inside the Myriad-Race Universe and silently spread across the entire cosmos.
Almost every region of spacetime was affected.
The speed of time began increasing violently. Countless high-stage Oracle-grade experts sensed that something had changed, although few understood the cause.
Within Golden Holy Mountain, an elder suddenly entered a hidden secret realm.
Only the current leader of Golden Holy Mountain possessed the authority to access this place.
A single temple stood within the realm.
Inside the temple was a statue of Golden Holy Mountain’s founder. Before the statue burned a Life-Soul Lamp connected to the founder’s existence.
The elder entered hurriedly and immediately attempted to contact the founder, an Eternal Grade Oracle who had left this timeline after completing his breakthrough.
When the founder first established Golden Holy Mountain, he had not yet reached Eternal Grade. Only after advancing did he depart for the greater reaches beyond the universe.
The elder lit soul incense, bowed deeply, and sent out an urgent prayer.

"Ancestor, return immediately! An Eternal Grade expert has acted against the Myriad-Race Universe. The flow of time has accelerated by dozens of times. Our universe was already approaching the end of its natural lifespan. If this continues, Great Dao Tribulation Clouds will soon appear throughout the cosmos."
His voice trembled.
"Once that happens, Tribulation-Ash Seeds will form inside every Oracle-grade expert. None of us will have much time left."

chapters.title: Chapter 483 -483-A Cosmic Mutation
paragraphs: The mysterious radiance had spread through the Myriad-Race Universe without sound or warning.

The overwhelming majority of living beings noticed nothing at first. Even T8 Oracle-grade experts failed to detect the initial disturbance. Only beings at T9 or above sensed an obscure change passing through spacetime.
That concealment would not last for long.
As the flow of time continued accelerating, the entire universe would soon feel the consequences.

The Myriad-Race Universe had existed for immeasurable ages. Compared with the young Chaosverse, it resembled an old man approaching the final moments of life, while the Chaosverse was still an infant newly born into the world.
Now the aging universe had been targeted by an Eternal Grade expert.

Its temporal flow had been forcibly accelerated, as though someone had pressed a fast-forward command upon a mortal who already possessed only a short life remaining. At this rate, the universe would reach its end far sooner than nature intended.
The clearest sign of a universe exhausting its lifespan was the birth of Great Dao Tribulation Clouds.
Those clouds would spread Tribulation-Ash corruption throughout the cosmos.

If the inhabitants failed to evacuate in time, Tribulation-Ash Seeds would appear inside every sufficiently powerful being. As time passed, those seeds would grow, and all matter, life, laws, and civilization would gradually be covered by tribulation ash.
Under its natural temporal flow, the Myriad-Race Universe should have survived for tens of millions of additional years.
That amount of time would have allowed every supreme faction to prepare an orderly evacuation, search for new territories, and preserve its inheritances.
No one had expected an Eternal Grade expert to shorten the process so violently.
The universe might now possess only a few thousand years.
Golden Holy Mountain naturally refused to wait passively for destruction.
Its leader had urgently attempted to contact the founder. Only an Eternal Grade Oracle could resist another Eternal Grade existence and reverse a method acting upon an entire universe.
Yet no matter how desperately the elder prayed, the founder’s statue produced no response.
At last, his gaze shifted toward the Life-Soul Lamp standing before the statue.
He stared at it for a long time.
A terrible possibility entered his mind.
Could the founder of Golden Holy Mountain already be dead?
Only death could explain the complete lack of response.
The elder’s legs weakened, and he collapsed onto the floor. His face became pale and rigid with fear.
The Eternal Grade ancestor of Golden Holy Mountain had almost certainly fallen.

"The Eternal Tribulation," he whispered. "It must have been the Eternal Tribulation that killed the ancestor. Why was he dragged into that calamity? If so many Eternal experts have become involved, the Endless Starfield is about to fall into complete chaos."
He closed his eyes in grief and unwillingness.
Similar scenes unfolded among the supreme factions of the Chaosverse and nearby universes.
Every organization whose foundations included an Eternal Grade ancestor attempted to contact that powerhouse.
The matter concerned the survival of entire life universes, and no faction dared delay.
Yet none of the Eternal experts responded.
Their Life-Soul Lamps extinguished almost simultaneously.
One Eternal Grade powerhouse after another had fallen.
The beings who once stood at the summit of the Great Dao appeared to have been wiped out together, with almost no survivors.
The high-stage Oracle-grade experts who witnessed the extinguished lamps trembled.
Every faction reached the same terrifying conclusion.
"It can only be the Eternal Tribulation. The Eternal Tribulation has descended."
Nothing else could cause so many Eternal Grade beings to perish in the same period.
Killing even one Eternal expert was unimaginably difficult. The death of a single such existence would normally shake entire networks of universes and alert powerful beings across distant eras.
Now, however, large numbers of Eternal experts had fallen at once.
Only a calamity directed at Eternal Grade itself could produce such an outcome.
Some younger Oracle-grade experts did not understand the term.
"What exactly is the Eternal Tribulation?"
A high-stage Oracle answered solemnly.

"It is a great calamity among Eternal experts. Reaching Eternal Grade allows a cultivator to escape the direct restraints of the Time River, but it does not mean that they have transcended the Great Dao itself."
The expert continued explaining.

"An Eternal being approaches the Origin of the Great Dao. Once the Great Dao senses a threat to its own authority, it naturally attempts to suppress those beings. Across endless timelines and countless rivers of history, the Great Dao secretly cultivates chosen geniuses and grants them extraordinary opportunities, treasures, inheritances, and resources."

"The destinies of those chosen children are controlled. Their purpose is to create conflict among Eternal experts and force them to kill one another. This is one of the Great Dao’s methods for reducing the number of beings capable of challenging it."
The listeners grew increasingly pale.

"Many so-called peerless geniuses are therefore puppets. Their fate, cultivation, opportunities, personalities, thoughts, and even the people they love or hate are shaped gradually by the Great Dao. Countless threads of causality are planted throughout their lives. When the Great Dao ignites all those threads at once, the Eternal Tribulation begins."
The high-stage Oracle’s voice became heavy.

"Your birth, your parents, every encounter, every sentence spoken to you, every enemy and benefactor, and even the final tribulation you face may all follow a path prepared by the Great Dao. Even if you successfully enter Eternal Grade, it may be because the Great Dao deliberately allowed you to pass."

"Many Eternal experts never realize that they are puppets. Their life paths were fixed long before their supposed rise. Even if the Great Dao stops interfering directly, the inertia of their cultivated personalities and causality will cause them to continue along the predetermined road."
"The endpoint of that road is the Eternal Tribulation."
"The Great Dao’s true targets are the beings who possess the potential to surpass Eternal Grade and enter the supreme realm beyond its control."
The Oracle-grade experts listening to the explanation felt their minds shake.
They had never imagined that the Great Dao’s arrangement could extend so deeply into life and history.
The Eternal Tribulation was not merely a natural disaster. It was a war among Eternal beings, engineered by the laws governing existence itself.

On one side stood Eternal experts cultivated directly by the Great Dao. From birth, their lives followed prepared scripts. Their thoughts and choices appeared free, yet every step strengthened an irreversible momentum of fate.
Even their advancement into Eternal Grade might be intentional.

Those puppets could possess terrifying power, but the Great Dao had placed an unbreakable limitation within them. They would never truly transcend its control. When a supreme calamity arrived, they would inevitably fail.
This was the horror of the Great Dao.
If defying heaven were simple, it would no longer deserve to be called defiance. Anyone who genuinely attempted to break free could face annihilation at every moment.
The Myriad-Race Universe could only endure the destiny descending upon it.
T9 Oracle-grade experts and half-step Eternal beings were powerless to reverse the accelerated death of the cosmos.
The Great Dao Tribulation Source would inevitably be born.

The overwhelming majority of living beings noticed nothing at first.
Even T8 Oracle-grade experts failed to detect the initial disturbance.

The clearest sign of a universe exhausting its lifespan was the birth of Great Dao Tribulation Clouds.
Those clouds would spread Tribulation-Ash corruption throughout the cosmos.

The elder’s legs weakened, and he collapsed onto the floor.
His face became pale and rigid with fear.
The Eternal Grade ancestor of Golden Holy Mountain had almost certainly fallen.

chapters.title: Chapter 484 -484-The Universe Timeline Is Sealed
paragraphs: Within the mysterious mission timeline, Daniel had successfully completed the advancement of his spacetime law.
His journey through this era had reached its end.

The rewards he had accumulated were extraordinary. He had obtained the top-tier Sacred Art known as the Sacred Seal, acquired two Racial Talents, secured a Great Universal Will Fragment, and earned fifty million Realm-Crosser Points.
The point exchange shop contained resources far more abundant than those available through Golden Holy Mountain.

Oracle-grade treasures needed by high-stage Oracle-grade experts could be exchanged in large quantities. Peak-grade innate treasures also appeared on the list, along with rare cultivation materials, secret methods, and objects that could not ordinarily be purchased with wealth alone.
Daniel glanced through the exchange interface and immediately purchased a batch of Oracle-grade treasures.
Afterward, he exchanged for one peak-grade innate treasure and one Chaos Treasure-grade Dao Seed.
The first major item appeared before him.
[Mountain of Time]
[Type]: Spacetime Treasure
[Quality]: Supreme Divine-grade
[Effects]:

While cultivating within the sacred mountain, the owner may freely adjust the flow of time. The maximum acceleration is one hundred thousand times the external rate. Once every ten million years, the Mountain of Time will produce one peak-grade innate spacetime treasure. The owner may either remove the newly formed treasure or refine it into the mountain to strengthen its foundations. Everything within the territory of the Mountain of Time is protected from the influence of causality, fate, and prophetic laws. Great Dao opportunities conceal the region, preventing outside divination and deduction.
[Description]: The functions have been stated clearly. No additional explanation is required.
Daniel examined the treasure with satisfaction before storing it carefully.

With the Mountain of Time, he would no longer need to search constantly for secret realms suitable for secluded cultivation. He could create a personal cultivation sanctuary whenever and wherever he wished.

A time acceleration of one hundred thousand times was already astonishing. Combined with the mountain’s dense energy and protection against deduction, it ranked among the greatest cultivation treasures Daniel had ever obtained.

Countless experts across the Endless Starfield encountered opportunities during their lives, but treasures of this quality stood at the highest level of fortune. Daniel had acquired one simply by spending points.
His second major exchange was a Dao Seed at Chaos Treasure-grade.

Dao Seed was both a general term and an independent category. It referred to spiritual seeds possessing an innate divine root. Ordinary legendary trees could be considered spiritual roots, but only the most exceptional among them qualified as Dao Seeds.
The one Daniel obtained was called the Universe Fruit.
[Universe Fruit]
[Type]: Chaos
[Quality]: Chaos Treasure
[Effects]:

The first fruit consumed grants one hundred million cultivation points. Each later fruit provides one-tenth of the effect of the previous consumption. The first fruit consumed extends lifespan by one hundred thousand years. Each later fruit grants one-tenth of the previous lifespan increase.

[Description]: The Universe Fruit is one of the highest-level Dao Seeds. Its tree flowers once every ten thousand years and bears fruit after another ten thousand years. Each cycle can produce forty-nine Dao Fruits. The tree requires a matching treasure land and suitable environment in order to grow successfully.
Daniel considered where to plant it.
"Would the Chaosverse be more suitable, or should I place it on Earth?"

His personal preference was Earth. The planet was the ancestral home of humanity and carried enormous symbolic importance. However, Earth possessed very few regions capable of supporting a Chaos Treasure-grade Dao Seed.
After weighing the matter, Daniel released a breath.
"If Earth lacks a suitable treasure land, I will simply exchange for one."
The points shop could provide almost anything. A treasure pool capable of nourishing the Universe Fruit was naturally included.

Daniel spent additional points and purchased a high-level spiritual pool. He intended to place it on Earth, transform the surrounding region into a sacred cultivation land, and plant the Universe Fruit tree there.
After completing all his exchanges, Daniel had spent more than forty-five million points and retained roughly five million.
He felt no regret.

"Every point was well spent. Most of these treasures are almost impossible to encounter outside the exchange shop. Obtaining them through ordinary means would require an unimaginable price, assuming they could be found at all."
At that moment, another system notification appeared.
[The progress of the current universe timeline will now be sealed.]
[You may use points to exchange for an item that allows entry into this mission universe during a future opening.]
[The current timeline will be unsealed again after five hundred years. Prepare within twenty-four hours. You will soon be removed from the mission world.]
Daniel frowned slightly.
"The timeline can be sealed?"
He quickly understood the implication.

The next time he descended into this mission universe, the Eternal Empire would still be at the stage following Dorek’s enthronement, when the new emperor was preparing an expedition to search for another universe. The mission world would not continue progressing normally in Daniel’s absence.
The only inconvenience was the long cooldown of five hundred years.
Daniel reopened the exchange shop and found the special return item. It cost only five points.
He purchased it immediately and stored it inside his inventory.
Within the Holy See, Emperor Dorek had already learned which treasure Daniel had selected from the imperial treasury.
The Great Universal Will Fragment was unique within the Eternal Empire, yet Dorek felt no reluctance.
To him, Daniel’s value exceeded that of every treasure in the treasury.

Moreover, the empire now faced the unavoidable advance of Tribulation-Ash corruption. Tribulation-Ash Seeds were beginning to form within powerful experts throughout the universe. They hung over the population like a blade suspended above every head.
Dorek felt the pressure of countless lives resting upon his shoulders.
He entered Daniel’s residence personally.
"Teacher, I have come to see you."
Daniel understood the worry in his heart and smiled calmly.
"There is no need for despair. A path to survival still exists."

He took out an object from his storage space. It was a replica of a scroll concerning the Dao of Battle, originally gifted to him by an ancient divine expert. Daniel had ordered several copies to be made.
He handed one to Dorek.

"This scroll will help you comprehend the Dao of Battle. You must cultivate diligently and persist without allowing yourself to become careless. The throne gives you authority, but only your own Strength can ensure that you continue to hold it."
Dorek accepted the scroll with both hands.
His heart was filled with excitement, although he also wondered why Daniel had chosen this particular moment to grant him such an inheritance.

chapters.title: Chapter 485 -485-Disaster in the Myriad-Race Universe
paragraphs: Dorek could not help wondering whether Daniel’s gift represented a final acknowledgment.

"Teacher has finally accepted me as a true disciple," he thought. "But why would he give me such an inheritance now? Even if he intended to pass down a Great Dao method, there should have been no need to choose this particular moment."
He quickly bowed.
"Thank you, Teacher. I will remember every lesson you have given me. I will cultivate without the slightest negligence."
Daniel smiled when he saw Dorek’s respectful attitude.
"Very good. In that case, I will leave for now. If you encounter a problem, seek me again when the opportunity arises."
Dorek bowed deeply.
"I respectfully see Teacher off."
Daniel’s figure flashed and vanished from the Holy See.
After leaving the sacred district, he silently commanded the system to return him to his original timeline.
His body disappeared completely.

Within twenty-four hours, the spacetime of the mission universe would be formally sealed. It would not resume until Daniel returned through the special item he had purchased. When that happened, he would reappear at the same general historical stage rather than discovering that millions of years had passed.
Daniel emerged inside the Chaosverse, within Golden Holy Mountain.
The familiar scenery caused him to release a long breath.
His journey had produced a harvest far greater than he originally expected.
The instant his aura appeared, two figures sensed him and hurried over. Both wore extremely serious expressions.
Daniel examined them. Their cultivation had improved during his absence, and both had already reached a higher sage-rank level.
Durt spoke first.
"Brother Daniel, something terrible has happened."
Daniel raised an eyebrow.
"What happened?"
Durt’s face was filled with worry.

"The Myriad-Race Universe has been locked by an external power. Its flow of time has been forcibly accelerated. At the current rate, the universe may exhaust its remaining lifespan in only several thousand years."
Daniel drew in a sharp breath.
Several thousand years meant almost nothing to a complete universe. It was equivalent to a mortal discovering that only a few seconds remained before death.
More importantly, the change had been imposed from outside.
An Eternal Grade expert was almost certainly responsible.
"Have the native Eternal experts of the Myriad-Race Universe not intervened?" Daniel asked.

Every major universe had produced Eternal Grade beings. Although such experts escaped the Time River and weakened their direct ties to ordinary causality, many still retained an attachment to their home universe.
A universe was often their second homeland.
Several supreme factions within the Myriad-Race Universe had been established personally by Eternal experts. If their home faced destruction, those founders should not have remained indifferent.
"Did something happen to them?" Daniel asked.
Durt hesitated before answering.

"Yes, and the situation is worse than we first believed. You have probably heard of the Eternal Tribulation, the great calamity involving Eternal Grade experts. Beings secretly supported by the Great Dao hunt Eternal experts who possess the potential to transcend its control."
Durt sighed.
"Almost every native Eternal expert connected to the Myriad-Race Universe died during the latest Eternal Tribulation."
Daniel froze for a moment.
"All of them died?"
He had not expected the situation to become so severe in such a short period.
Durt nodded.
"The Myriad-Race Universe has fallen into complete disorder. Many regions already resemble the beginning of an apocalypse."
Daniel became silent.
Earth was located within the Myriad-Race Universe. He could not ignore the approaching destruction.

In addition, Oracle Shamir had once mentioned the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land. That place might contain the opportunity Daniel needed to comprehend the Law of Destruction and break through to Oracle-grade.

"There is no need to panic yet," Daniel said. "When the sky collapses, the tallest powers will be forced to bear the first impact. A faction as old as Golden Holy Mountain should possess emergency arrangements."
Daniel had originally intended to visit the Flying Fish Starfield, but the sudden disaster forced him to change his plans.
He needed to return to the Myriad-Race Universe immediately.
Soon, an Emperor-class sacred vessel entered the Chaos Starsea.

Daniel piloted the ship at maximum speed. Along the route, he saw countless cultivators crossing the chaotic sea. Even the weakest among them stood near the peak of Divine-grade, and Oracle-grade experts appeared everywhere.

"The situation is completely different from before," Daniel thought. "The number of powerful outsiders has increased dramatically. Most of them must have been attracted by the mutation of the Myriad-Race Universe."
The sacred vessel rapidly approached the universal barrier.
Countless starships were fleeing outward from the Myriad-Race Universe. At the same time, even more vessels were entering from outside.
Daniel immediately understood why.

The universe had entered its final years. Time acceleration was forcing countless natural treasures to mature. Forbidden lands and secret realms that normally required vast periods to open were unlocking one after another.
Opportunities appeared like plants after a storm.

Meanwhile, the supreme native factions were preoccupied with evacuation plans. Their control over territory had weakened greatly. Outside cultivators were taking advantage of the chaos to enter, seize inheritances, and search for artifacts before the universe died.
"That explains the unusual activity," Daniel murmured.
He looked at the approaching barrier.
"Once the universe truly enters the final stage of Great Dao destruction, no outsider will dare enter. By then, every treasure will be accompanied by Tribulation-Ash corruption and death."
The thought caused Daniel to inspect his own body for the Great Dao Tribulation Mark he had once carried during the mission timeline.
It had disappeared.
Daniel had always hated the sensation of being marked by a Great Dao calamity. It resembled a death talisman attached to his existence, constantly warning that corruption could begin at any moment.
"The mark probably exists only while I remain inside that specific historical timeline," he concluded.
Daniel activated his law-based Sacred Art and began tearing open the universal barrier so that the Emperor-class vessel could enter.
A final thought passed through his mind.
"Will the Myriad-Race Universe gradually become another version of the dying Eternal Empire? If so, I may need to find a new universe for my own forces as well."

The universal barrier opened beneath Daniel’s power, revealing a turbulent passage filled with ancient starlight. His vessel entered slowly rather than forcing its way through at maximum speed. He could already sense that the laws on the other side were aging at an unnatural pace. Spiritual veins that should have required thousands of years to change were shifting from one breath to the next, and distant stars released the faint aura of approaching decay.

The sight confirmed Durt’s warning. This was not merely a political crisis or a temporary disturbance in cultivation conditions. The lifespan of the entire cosmos had become a visible countdown. Daniel placed one hand upon the control formation of the sacred vessel and hardened his resolve. Whatever Eternal expert had created the temporal restraint, Daniel would eventually find a way to make that being release it.

He needed to return to the Myriad-Race Universe immediately.
Soon, an Emperor-class sacred vessel entered the Chaos Starsea.
Daniel piloted the ship at maximum speed.
Along the route, he saw countless cultivators crossing the chaotic sea.
Even the weakest among them stood near the peak of Divine-grade, and Oracle-grade experts appeared everywhere.
"The situation is completely different from before," Daniel thought.
"The number of powerful outsiders has increased dramatically.
Most of them must have been attracted by the mutation of the Myriad-Race Universe."
The sacred vessel rapidly approached the universal barrier.
Countless starships were fleeing outward from the Myriad-Race Universe.
At the same time, even more vessels were entering from outside.
Daniel immediately understood why.
The universe had entered its final years.
Time acceleration was forcing countless natural treasures to mature.
Forbidden lands and secret realms that normally required vast periods to open were unlocking one after another.
Opportunities appeared like plants after a storm.
Meanwhile, the supreme native factions were preoccupied with evacuation plans.
Their control over territory had weakened greatly.
Outside cultivators were taking advantage of the chaos to enter, seize inheritances, and search for artifacts before the universe died.
"That explains the unusual activity," Daniel murmured.
He looked at the approaching barrier.
"Once the universe truly enters the final stage of Great Dao destruction, no outsider will dare enter.
By then, every treasure will be accompanied by Tribulation-Ash corruption and death."
The thought caused Daniel to inspect his own body for the Great Dao Tribulation Mark he had once carried during the mission timeline.
It had disappeared.
Daniel had always hated the sensation of being marked by a Great Dao calamity.
It resembled a death talisman attached to his existence, constantly warning that corruption could begin at any moment.
"The mark probably exists only while I remain inside that specific historical timeline," he concluded.
Daniel activated his law-based Sacred Art and began tearing open the universal barrier so that the Emperor-class vessel could enter.
A final thought passed through his mind.
"Will the Myriad-Race Universe gradually become another version of the dying Eternal Empire?
If so, I may need to find a new universe for my own forces as well."
The universal barrier opened beneath Daniel’s power, revealing a turbulent passage filled with ancient starlight.
His vessel entered slowly rather than forcing its way through at maximum speed.
He could already sense that the laws on the other side were aging at an unnatural pace.
Spiritual veins that should have required thousands of years to change were shifting from one breath to the next, and distant stars released the faint aura of approaching decay.
The sight confirmed Durt’s warning.
This was not merely a political crisis or a temporary disturbance in cultivation conditions.
The lifespan of the entire cosmos had become a visible countdown.
Daniel placed one hand upon the control formation of the sacred vessel and hardened his resolve.
Whatever Eternal expert had created the temporal restraint, Daniel would eventually find a way to make that being release it.

chapters.title: Chapter 486 -486-A New Main Quest
paragraphs: Daniel had only just entered the Myriad-Race Universe when a system notification rang in his ears.
[Ding! You have received a new quest. Please open the quest panel to view the details.]
Daniel immediately opened the interface.
[Save the Myriad-Race Universe]
[Quest Owner]: Daniel
[Quest Type]: Special Main Quest
[Objectives]:

Advance your cultivation to Oracle-grade. After your advancement, an opponent named Kru will arrive and challenge you. Accept Kru’s challenge and defeat him. Before the final battle, persuade the mysterious Eternal Grade expert accompanying Kru to use the release of the temporal restraint upon the Myriad-Race Universe as the wager. Defeat Kru and compel the Eternal expert to remove the spacetime acceleration.

[Quest Background]: Earth is one of the ancestral homelands of humanity. Protecting Earth requires preserving the Myriad-Race Universe. God Miral has descended into this universe with his personal disciple, Kru, for the purpose of challenging you. You must defeat Kru and persuade God Miral to release the universe from the temporal restraint currently accelerating its destruction.
[Quest Reward]: Great Universal Will Fragment x1
Daniel closed the panel after reading the information.
Several questions immediately appeared in his mind.
"Who exactly is God Miral? He can appear directly in the system’s quest description and apparently possesses the power to reverse the altered flow of time throughout an entire universe."
"Why has he brought Kru to challenge me? Why does the quest require me to reach Oracle-grade before the duel can begin?"
The entire situation was extremely strange.
After thinking for a moment, Daniel forced the distracting questions aside.
Regardless of Miral’s identity, Daniel’s immediate objective was clear.
He had to reach Oracle-grade.

Now that he knew God Miral could remove the spacetime acceleration, Daniel could not allow the opportunity to pass. If Miral acted, Earth and the Myriad-Race Universe would gain enough time to survive and prepare.
The reward was equally tempting.
Another Great Universal Will Fragment could advance Absolute Spacetime again and greatly increase Daniel’s Strength.
"This quest is worth the risk," Daniel concluded. "I must complete my advancement first."
He abandoned his immediate plan to travel to Earth and changed the course of the Emperor-class sacred vessel, heading instead toward the headquarters of Golden Holy Mountain.
Oracle Shamir had previously mentioned that he also intended to enter the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
Daniel remembered the conversation.

"The forbidden land was originally supposed to open after another fifteen hundred years. But the time acceleration affecting the universe has probably destroyed that waiting period. This may be the perfect opportunity to enter."
Under Daniel’s control, the sacred vessel traveled at extraordinary speed and reached Golden Holy Mountain in a short time.
Daniel contacted Oracle Shamir and explained his purpose.
Shamir looked at him and smiled.
"You truly intend to enter that forbidden land?"

"The original restrictions around it have already weakened and collapsed. Because the entire universe is experiencing accelerated time, the forbidden land can now be entered at any moment. I have also been considering another period of cultivation there. Since your destination is the same, we can travel together."
Daniel nodded.

"I searched through many records and treasures capable of assisting with comprehension of the Law of Destruction. None of them seemed suitable for my current stage. Does Oracle Shamir know of a better resource?"
Shamir laughed.

"You asked the right person. The Sacred Origin Forbidden Land contains an environment extremely suitable for comprehending Destruction. During my previous visit, I raised my own Law of Destruction to the terminal stage there."
Daniel’s eyes immediately brightened.
He had found exactly the opportunity he needed.

Shamir continued, "The forbidden land contains innumerable inheritances and countless treasures. Once you enter, you will understand how extraordinary it is. However, many experts from other universes have already entered the Myriad-Race Universe to compete for opportunities. The region will be far more dangerous than during my previous visit. You must not become careless."
Daniel nodded.
"I saw many outsiders while crossing the Chaos Starsea. Your warning is correct."
Shamir raised one hand, and the two soon departed for the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
The forbidden land was located within the Myriad-Race Universe.
When they arrived outside, Daniel saw countless laws twisting together into chaotic currents. His vision became distorted after only a brief glance.

Laws collided, entangled, and shattered repeatedly. Around the outer edge of the forbidden land, they had formed a vast natural region of law turbulence more terrifying than ordinary chaotic currents.
The area was extraordinarily dangerous.

Even high-stage Oracle-grade experts would not dare cross it recklessly. The violent currents could tear apart bodies, Divine Souls, and treasures alike. Ordinary Oracle-grade artifacts could not withstand the continuous impact.
This was merely the outermost barrier.
Daniel became increasingly curious about what kind of power lay within the true depths of the forbidden land.
He took out a treasure and threw it into the turbulent region.
The artifact entered the law currents and was instantly torn apart. Its materials, spirit, and internal laws were reduced to nothingness.
Daniel’s expression became solemn.

Shamir explained, "Anyone below high-stage Oracle-grade will find it extremely difficult to cross this outer barrier. Only law comprehension at the level of a high-stage Oracle can reliably resist the corresponding attacks."

"There is another possibility. If your law comprehension has reached mid-grade, your foundations are stable, and you possess a continuous supply of divine power, you may endure the consumption long enough to pass."
Shamir looked at Daniel.
"At present, you should not attempt to cross alone. Follow me."
With a wave of Shamir’s hand, a powerful law barrier formed around Daniel’s body.

The barrier around Daniel felt like a complete miniature system of laws. Each power supported the others, preventing any single current from finding an opening. Daniel quietly studied the structure while Shamir prepared to enter. Even this temporary protection contained insights that an ordinary Divine-grade cultivator might spend centuries attempting to understand.

He did not feel ashamed to rely upon a stronger expert for the crossing. Recklessness was not courage, and dying against an outer barrier would accomplish nothing. His goal lay inside the forbidden land: the opportunity to perfect Destruction, advance to Oracle-grade, and gain the qualifications required to face Kru. Once those objectives were complete, Daniel believed he would be able to cross the same turbulence without anyone’s protection.

chapters.title: Chapter 487 -487-Entering the Forbidden Land
paragraphs: The Law of Causality, the Law of Destruction, the Law of Fate, elemental laws, and numerous other Great Dao powers intertwined to form Oracle Shamir’s protective barrier.
Shamir entered the chaotic law currents first, and Daniel followed closely behind.
Violent waves struck the shield from every direction. Each impact possessed enough power to tear apart an ordinary Oracle-grade treasure, yet the barrier woven by Shamir remained stable.
The two advanced without suffering any meaningful obstruction and eventually reached the entrance of the forbidden land.
Daniel focused his gaze.
"What is that?"
He extended his Divine Sense, but the power of the forbidden land greatly restricted its range. Even so, he managed to perceive the rough outline of the entrance.
It resembled the enormous open mouth of a primordial beast.
Daniel looked surprised.
"How could the entrance possess such a form?"
Shamir did not enter immediately. Instead, the Oracle patiently explained the origin of the region.

"The Sacred Origin Forbidden Land evolved from the remains of a T8 Oracle-grade expert. This location was already a peak-grade innate spiritual land. After an immeasurably long period of nurturing, the corpse, the terrain, and the surrounding laws merged into this unique forbidden region."
Shamir shattered an approaching law current and continued.
"The entrance contains many evolving law manifestations. The beast mouth before us is only one of the forms created by those transformations."

"The Sacred Origin Forbidden Land covers an enormous area, extending across billions of kilometers. Its most valuable locations are the inheritance grounds. According to legend, the complete inheritance of the fallen T8 Oracle-grade expert remains hidden somewhere inside."
Daniel listened carefully.
"The next most valuable locations are the treasuries. There are many of them, and their positions are not fixed. Some move continuously as the internal terrain changes."

"Certain treasuries are protected by profound restrictions and are almost impossible to open. Others possess no barrier at all. Their treasures may drift freely through the surrounding region or even fly out of the treasury by themselves."
Shamir’s expression became serious.
"The most valuable treasury mentioned in the ancient records has never been located with certainty."
"An inheritance and countless treasuries," Daniel thought. "This truly is an exceptional land of opportunity."
Shamir added another warning.

"The forbidden land also contains formations and restrictions arranged by the T8 Oracle-grade expert before death. Those artificial formations overlap with naturally generated law arrays. More importantly, the entire geography of the forbidden land is periodically reconstructed. Mountains, valleys, ruins, and treasure vaults can all change position."
"The scenery I saw during my last visit was completely different from what stands before us now."
Daniel could not help expressing his admiration.
"A forbidden land that rebuilds itself? The Endless Starfield truly contains wonders beyond imagination."
At that moment, several powerful figures forced their way through the outer law turbulence. They did not spare Daniel or Shamir a glance and rushed directly into the depths of the forbidden land.
Shamir looked at them briefly and then turned back to Daniel.
"Remember one more thing. No law or official order exists inside this forbidden land. There are no rules capable of restraining the people who enter. Be careful of other cultivators."
Daniel nodded.
"Without rules, everything is decided by Strength."
"Exactly," Shamir replied. "Even if you obtain a great treasure, another high-stage Oracle may ambush you on the way out. Battles and robberies occur constantly."
The lack of order had become part of the forbidden land’s cycle.

Countless powerful experts died within it. Their bodies, Divine Souls, treasures, and law foundations were absorbed by the land and became nourishment. New treasures, laws, and formations were born from those remains.

Everyone capable of entering possessed an extremely strong foundation. Most were Oracle-grade experts or exceptional geniuses whose bodies contained energy comparable to complete life worlds. To the forbidden land, each death was valuable fuel.
"Let us enter," Shamir said.
The two flew through the beast-shaped entrance.
Most visitors were Oracle-grade experts below T8. Divine-grade cultivators barely possessed the qualifications to enter and gamble upon an opportunity.
Inside, Daniel discovered an entirely different world.
He flew into the air and immediately extended his Divine Sense, yet he could not detect the boundary of the region.
The forbidden land was every bit as vast as Shamir had described.

"The Endless Starfield is truly infinite," Daniel thought. "My Divine Sense can cover a large life world with ease, even one twice the ordinary size, yet it cannot explore this entire forbidden land."
He compared life worlds to ponds scattered across a limitless ocean. Large worlds were merely larger ponds. The boundless starry region beyond them was the true sea.
Ordinary lives resembled tiny creatures floating within that ocean. Powerful Oracle-grade experts were like sharks in the deep, while weaker beings were little more than plankton.
As Daniel considered the scale of existence, a faint sensation touched his mind.
His eyes narrowed.
"Did the Treasure Seeking Ability activate?"
The perception became clearer almost immediately.
Numerous ownerless treasures appeared within his awareness. They were scattered across multiple regions, and their number was astonishing.
Daniel had only recently obtained the talent and had not yet fully adapted to it. Now he understood how extraordinary it truly was.

Ordinary Divine Sense could detect living beings, spatial disturbances, and fluctuations of law. It could not directly identify every hidden artifact. The Treasure Seeking Ability, however, allowed Daniel to sense treasures that even his Divine Sense could not discover.
He turned toward Shamir.
"Senior Shamir, I have sensed the fluctuations of several treasures nearby. They may have some connection with me. I would like to investigate alone."
Shamir looked at Daniel in surprise.
They had only just entered, yet he had already located an opportunity. Daniel’s foundations were indeed astonishing. It was almost as though he carried a supreme treasure detector within his body.
Shamir attempted to observe Daniel’s causal lines, but they resembled a fog that could not be organized or traced.
"He truly is an unusual person," Shamir thought. "Remaining near him may allow me to benefit from some of his extraordinary fortune."

Shamir did not attempt to stop him. Experts who entered the forbidden land understood that opportunities could not always be shared, and forcing oneself into another cultivator’s discovery often created unnecessary hostility. The Oracle merely gave Daniel a final warning through Divine Sense and then chose a different direction.

Daniel watched Shamir depart before turning toward the strongest treasure signal. It pulsed intermittently, sometimes clear and sometimes hidden beneath the changing laws of the forbidden land. The uncertainty only increased his interest. A treasure capable of concealing itself from ordinary Divine Sense while still triggering the Racial Talent was unlikely to be common. With the Divine Spear ready beside him and Absolute Spacetime prepared for activation, Daniel began his first independent exploration of the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.

chapters.title: Chapter 488 -488-The Sacred Land
paragraphs: Oracle Shamir considered Daniel’s request for a moment before replying.

"The forbidden land contains many dangerous formations and restrictions. You must remain cautious and avoid triggering them. Once activated, certain restrictions could kill even someone with your foundations."
Shamir’s expression became more serious.

"There are also powerful Oracle-grade experts hiding throughout the region. Some may deliberately wait near treasure sites and ambush anyone who arrives. You may explore alone, but do not lower your guard."
Even after saying this, Shamir still seemed somewhat worried.
"Opportunity and danger often appear together. No matter how valuable the treasure may be, conduct yourself carefully and keep a low profile."
Daniel smiled.
"Senior Shamir may rest assured. I have never been a person who enjoys attracting attention."
The claim would have sounded absurd to anyone familiar with Daniel’s recent achievements, but Shamir did not argue.
Daniel stopped flying beside the Oracle, offered a brief farewell, and headed toward the treasure signal detected by his Racial Talent.

Danger existed everywhere within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land. Natural formations, unstable laws, and other cultivators could become threats without warning. Even traveling normally could activate a hidden restriction.
Shamir had not dared move at full speed, and Daniel likewise advanced steadily rather than recklessly.
Not long afterward, he saw a formation ahead.
The laws within it circulated smoothly and connected with one another in precise layers. The arrangement was too deliberate to be a natural phenomenon.
Someone had entered the region and constructed the formation afterward.
Any expert capable of reaching this depth of the forbidden land was powerful. The restriction could not be underestimated.

Many cultivators left behind formations after using them. Some did not bother recovering the materials, while others intentionally abandoned traps to harm later visitors. As a result, enormous numbers of restrictions had accumulated throughout the land.
Some could be avoided.
The one blocking Daniel’s path could not.
"Divine Spear."
The pitch-black spear appeared beside him.
Laws rapidly gathered around its shaft as it shot toward the formation. In an instant, it expanded across tens of thousands of kilometers and pierced directly into the restriction.
The spear identified the core through sheer destructive force and shattered it.
A deafening explosion shook the region.
The entire formation was forcibly expanded beyond its limits and burst apart.
At that moment, two figures appeared nearby.
One of them, a Divine-grade cultivator, cried out in shock.
"What kind of treasure is that? Its aura is terrifying!"
Beside him stood a third-stage Oracle-grade expert.
The Oracle’s eyes immediately filled with greed.
"A Primordial Supreme Treasure. A treasure of that level has appeared before us!"
He stared at the black spear as though it already belonged to him.
"Junior Brother, why should we continue searching for uncertain opportunities? The Primordial Supreme Treasure before us is already an exceptional fortune."
He shifted his attention toward Daniel.
"That human is only Divine-grade. The two of us include one Divine-grade expert and one third-stage Oracle. We possess an absolute advantage."
The Oracle then attempted to persuade his companion.
"You attack first and test his methods. Once I identify an opening, I will deliver the killing blow."
The Divine-grade cultivator looked unwilling.
"Why do you not attack first? I have no intention of becoming a shield for you."

He had long disliked his senior brother’s behavior. Whenever benefits appeared, the Oracle rushed ahead to claim the largest share. Whenever danger arose, he ordered his junior brother to investigate first.
Being forced to team up with such a person inside the forbidden land had been terrible luck.
While resentment rose in the Divine-grade cultivator’s heart, Daniel sensed the hostility released by the pair.
A cold smile appeared on his face.
"Absolute Spacetime has advanced, but I have not yet tested it in a real battle. These two will serve perfectly."
Daniel summoned the Sacred Suppression Tower and the Basin of Greed, but he did not activate them immediately.
When the two strangers saw that he had prepared treasures, the Oracle shouted,
"Junior Brother, attack now!"
The Divine-grade cultivator gritted his teeth and summoned an artifact shaped like an abacus.
It flew toward Daniel with tremendous force.
At the same time, the attacker released a law-based Sacred Art. The laws formed a savage beast that roared and lunged forward, opening its jaws to tear Daniel apart.
Daniel remained completely still.
The Oracle watching from behind initially believed that Daniel had been frightened senseless.
Then a trace of suspicion entered his mind.
"Could he be concealing his true Strength? No. That is impossible. He must simply be unable to react."
The Divine-grade attacker was less confident.
His artifact and Sacred Art were powerful enough to overwhelm opponents of the same Rank. If Daniel intended to resist them directly, he should suffer severe injury even if he survived.
At that instant, Daniel spoke.
"Absolute Spacetime."
Spacetime laws spread around him in silent ripples.
The abacus artifact froze in the air.

The law beast stopped only a short distance from Daniel’s body. Its claws remained extended, its jaws open, and its aura still carried the posture of an attack, yet it could not advance by even a fraction.
The entire region of spacetime had been brought to an absolute halt.
The laws themselves became motionless.
The Divine-grade attacker and the third-stage Oracle were frozen as well.
The younger cultivator’s face still carried suspicion and fear. The Oracle’s expression preserved greed, expectation, and a trace of excitement.
Neither could move.
Their thoughts, vision, and perception had been fixed within a single instant.
Every ordinary law in the region submitted to Spacetime Law, the authority standing above them.
Daniel walked calmly toward the two motionless figures.
He examined them with satisfaction.
"A true absolute temporal stop. Their minds and senses have also been frozen."
After Absolute Spacetime reached mid-grade, enemies and Sacred Arts below fourth-stage Oracle-grade could no longer threaten Daniel inside his domain.
He did not hesitate.
Daniel forcibly opened both storage spaces and removed every treasure inside.
System notifications immediately rang in his ears.
[Ding! The current acquisition has triggered Ten-Thousandfold Boost!]
[You have obtained six peak-grade Primordial Supreme Treasures, twelve innate law treasures, eleven innate treasures, and 1,321 acquired treasures!]

The value of the plunder far exceeded what either attacker could have imagined. Their decision to rob a seemingly isolated Divine-grade human had instead delivered their accumulated wealth directly into Daniel’s hands. The third-stage Oracle had treated his junior brother as disposable bait, yet in the frozen domain, the difference between their Ranks no longer mattered.

Daniel examined the motionless pair without sympathy. Neither had attempted negotiation or offered him a chance to leave. They had seen a valuable weapon and immediately decided that its owner should die. Inside a lawless forbidden land, such intent carried its own consequence. Daniel extended Absolute Spacetime more deeply around them, preparing to ensure that neither cultivator would escape after the temporal restriction ended.

chapters.title: Chapter 489 -489-A Perfect Plunder
paragraphs: [Ding! Ten-Thousandfold Boost has been triggered!]
[You have obtained 1,321 Sacred Art manuals, 1,401 units of prophetic scripture, and 12,123 sets of treasure materials!]
Daniel looked at the enormous harvest and immediately summoned the Basin of Greed, along with the Reincarnation Grail he had obtained earlier.
The Basin of Greed released a wave of seven-colored radiance and swallowed the countless treasures.
At the same time, it erased the ownership marks left by their previous masters and replaced them with Daniel’s imprint.
The two frozen cultivators could neither resist nor perceive what was happening.
Daniel then used Absolute Spacetime to accelerate the flow of time specifically around their bodies.
Their remaining lifespans began disappearing at an astonishing rate.
Visible changes appeared within moments. Their hair lost its luster, their flesh weakened, and their bodies began collapsing beneath the passage of countless years.
Absolute Spacetime was not limited to a large regional domain. Daniel could direct its power toward specific targets and accelerate only their personal timelines.
As long as he possessed enough divine power, he could exhaust the lifespan of almost any enemy.
With the support of the Reincarnation Grail, consuming the remaining years of an ordinary Oracle-grade expert was not difficult.
Daniel eliminated both opponents without effort.
He took every artifact they possessed and caused their bodies to disappear from the secret realm. No ordinary investigator would be able to determine how they had died.
This was the terror of Absolute Spacetime.
Daniel’s eyes flickered as he considered his future.
"Once I enter Oracle-grade, even if Kru arrives immediately, I should be able to face him. If he challenges me, I can complete the quest and obtain another Great Universal Will Fragment."
That fragment could advance Absolute Spacetime again.
If the Sacred Art reached high-grade, its authority over time and space would become far more terrifying than it was now.
First, however, Daniel needed to break through.
The safest approach was to comprehend another law and raise it to the transcendent stage before attempting the Oracle-grade tribulation.
His target remained the Law of Destruction.
Oracle Shamir had said that the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land contained a region particularly suitable for cultivating Destruction.

"After collecting the treasure detected by my Racial Talent, I will search for that cultivation area. I must raise Destruction to the transcendent stage as quickly as possible and then advance to Oracle-grade."
Daniel’s plan was clear.
He looked at the formation destroyed by the Divine Spear and flew into the region beyond it.
Not long after his figure vanished, space rippled.
Two new figures appeared.
They were Eternal Sage Miral and his disciple, Kru.
Miral looked toward the direction Daniel had taken.
"Kru, did you clearly observe his battle?"
Kru remained silent for a moment. His expression had become solemn.

"Master, I saw everything. Daniel used an extremely high-level spacetime law. Comprehending a true spacetime law before reaching Oracle-grade is extraordinary. He deserves his future reputation as an Eternal god."
Kru drew in a breath.
For the first time, genuine caution appeared in his posture.

"Master, if the seals upon my cultivation were removed and I recovered my original T7 Oracle-grade Strength, I am confident that I could defeat the current Daniel. But that would be unfair. He has not yet entered Oracle-grade."
Miral smiled faintly.
"There is no need to worry. Your battle with Daniel will take place after he completes his tribulation and advances to Oracle-grade."
"Before that time, you must continue observing his abilities. Use everything you see to strengthen your own foundations."
Kru’s former arrogance had disappeared.
He bowed respectfully.
"Understood, Master. I will not neglect my cultivation."
Daniel continued forward and soon entered another hidden region.
Mist filled the entire area.
He suddenly stopped and extended his Divine Sense.
His expression changed.
"I have entered a concealed formation. Something about this place is wrong."
The moment his Divine Sense spread outward, it was swallowed as though sinking into a bottomless marsh.
White fog filled his vision. He could barely see beyond one hundred meters.
Daniel had heard of strange formations capable of trapping living beings without producing any warning. Once a person realized that they had entered, the exit had already vanished.
Such formations were usually innate arrays rather than restrictions arranged by later visitors. They formed naturally from the terrain, laws, and energy of the secret realm.
Daniel had entered one without noticing.
By the time he understood the situation, he was already trapped.
Raw Strength alone was not always enough to break an innate formation. One often needed to locate the original source that caused the natural array to form.
Daniel raised his vigilance and advanced one careful step at a time.
Innate formations varied greatly. Some caused little direct damage but possessed terrifying trapping power. Others could destroy an Oracle-grade existence in an instant.
Daniel did not know which type surrounded him.
Not far away, a third-stage Oracle-grade expert stood completely motionless.
A treasure shaped like a tortoise shell protected the expert’s entire body, yet he did not dare move.
Countless tiny law currents twisted around him, colliding unpredictably. The power occasionally released by those collisions caused cold sweat to cover his forehead.

"What terrible luck," the Oracle thought. "I was only traveling normally, yet I entered such a dangerous innate formation. These law currents can kill even Oracle-grade experts. I can only wait for a chance to escape."
Daniel continued moving with extreme caution.
Suddenly, the space before him changed violently.
Countless law currents surged forward like a bursting flood.
Daniel’s pupils contracted.
"What is happening?"
Before he could react, the terrifying current swallowed his entire body.
The laws began destroying his flesh and Divine Soul. The force within the tide was overwhelmingly violent.

The incoming force was not a single law but a violent mixture of hundreds of principles. Space folded, elements shattered, causality twisted, and destructive power occupied the gaps between them. Daniel attempted to summon Absolute Spacetime, but the innate formation reacted faster than expected. Its turbulence did not behave like an enemy technique with a clear caster and structure. It was part of the land itself.

For the first time since entering the forbidden region, Daniel felt a threat that could not be solved simply by producing a stronger treasure. The mist erased direction, the formation swallowed perception, and the law flood attacked every layer of existence at once. In the final instant before his body disappeared, Daniel understood that surviving this place would require more than ordinary defense.

chapters.title: Chapter 490 -490-The Formation Is Triggered
paragraphs: Daniel’s body was destroyed in an instant.
The violent law currents tore through flesh, blood, bones, and every particle of his physical form until nothing remained.
An ordinary cultivator struck by such a tide would have been consumed as completely as prey falling into a nest of venomous beasts.
Daniel’s body had also collapsed, but he was not dead.
His Divine Soul remained intact.
"Undying and Indestructible."
His talent activated.
A new body formed in another region, allowing Daniel to escape the law currents with his condition fully restored.

He had advanced carefully from the moment he entered the formation and had secretly left traces of his blood and hair along the route. Those fragments provided anchors through which his resurrection talent could reconstruct him after a fatal attack.
This was the power of Undying and Indestructible.
Daniel looked toward the distant current with lingering fear.
The attack had been far more dangerous than expected. Among the chaotic laws was an extremely powerful concentration of Destruction.
His fear quickly transformed into excitement.
"The Law of Destruction."
That was the very law he had entered the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land to comprehend.
Now that a true destructive current stood before him, he could not simply retreat.
Unfortunately, the turbulence possessed no stable order. The laws collided and changed continuously, making direct control impossible.
Daniel considered the danger carefully.

"I have not yet reached Oracle-grade. Destruction can erase everything, including the Divine Soul. Among offensive laws, it possesses one of the greatest killing powers. I cannot simply endure the current with my present body. The previous attack already proved what will happen."
The experience of being annihilated instantly had left him deeply uncomfortable. The sensation resembled facing a natural predator against which resistance was meaningless.

"Unless my own law power exceeds the turbulence, I cannot confront it directly. High-stage Oracle-grade experts are unafraid because their law foundations are sufficiently powerful and their sacred power appears endless. Reaching that level would solve the problem, but I cannot wait until then."
Daniel’s eyes moved as another possibility appeared.
"If my physical body becomes strong enough to ignore the law currents, I can remain inside them and comprehend Destruction gradually."
He summoned the Mountain of Time and entered it.
The internal temporal flow was adjusted to its maximum acceleration of one hundred thousand times.

Daniel had previously focused primarily upon the Divine Soul path and the development of his sage-rank domain. To withstand the destructive currents, he now needed to strengthen the path of the physical body.
Within the endless depths of cultivation, there were two broad approaches.

One centered upon the Divine Soul. Cultivators following it focused upon sage-rank domains, law control, and spiritual methods. After reaching third-stage Oracle-grade, they could even create a Divine Soul clone identical to themselves.

The second approach centered upon the physical body. Such cultivators forged their flesh until it became a weapon and fortress. Against the law turbulence outside, a body-path Oracle possessed a natural advantage. A sufficiently strong body could cross currents that would destroy an ordinary Divine Soul cultivator.
Daniel’s body had always been invincible among those of the same Rank, so he had never considered specialized body cultivation necessary.
Yet being powerful among Divine-grade experts was not enough to ignore currents dominated by the Law of Destruction.
He needed to forge his body to an entirely new level.
Daniel possessed several body-refining methods, and many more were available through the exchange system.
He spent points on a collection of exceptional manuals.
After reading through them, he decided not to follow any single method mechanically.

The best path of physical cultivation had to match the unique characteristics of the cultivator’s body. No universal method could be perfect because every powerful being possessed different bloodlines, laws, Origins, and physical conditions.
Beginners could imitate established techniques.
At higher levels, nearly every expert had to create an individual body path.
Daniel wanted a method compatible with his own Divine Soul and laws from the beginning.
He studied thousands of classical approaches, extracted their most useful principles, and then put the manuals aside.
Years passed rapidly within the Mountain of Time.
At last, Daniel stood.
"I have studied several thousand body-refining texts. I finally understand the road I should take."
He summoned the Reincarnation Grail.
The grail rotated behind his head and released countless rays of golden light.
Daniel drew the power of the Law of Reincarnation from it and guided that power into his body.
Every particle of flesh began absorbing reincarnation law.
He refined every cell, every fragment of bone, and every microscopic component of his body until the entire physical structure carried the characteristic of cyclical restoration.
Ten thousand years passed within the Mountain of Time.
By the end, every particle of Daniel’s body had been tempered by the Law of Reincarnation.
He put away the treasure mountain and returned to the formation.
The violent law currents waited ahead.
It was time to test the result.
Daniel flew forward, but the currents suddenly disappeared.
He frowned.
"Do they appear only after a restriction is triggered?"
He continued advancing.
Before long, an unknown mechanism activated. A flood of law turbulence erupted again and rushed toward him.
There was no space to evade.
The currents swallowed Daniel instantly.
This time, his body did not collapse permanently.

The destructive laws continuously damaged his flesh, but every particle carried the power of reincarnation. As soon as one part was destroyed, it returned through an internal cycle and restored itself to its previous state.
Daniel’s body was broken and rebuilt again and again within moments.
His first stage of body refinement had succeeded.

Even so, the experiment remained incomplete. Restoration allowed Daniel to survive, but every cycle consumed divine power. If he entered the currents for too long, the repeated reconstruction would eventually exhaust him. He needed to reduce the damage itself rather than merely recover after being torn apart.

Daniel stood within the turbulence and carefully observed which parts of his body failed first. Flesh protected by denser reincarnation law endured longer, while particles with weaker integration vanished immediately. The result proved that his chosen path was correct. What he lacked was depth. If he added another supreme law and sufficient body-refining resources, he might transform temporary endurance into true resistance.
With that conclusion, Daniel withdrew before the current could drain too much of his power. A second, more ambitious period of cultivation was already taking shape in his mind.

It was time to test the result.
Daniel flew forward, but the currents suddenly disappeared.
He frowned.
"Do they appear only after a restriction is triggered?"
He continued advancing.
Before long, an unknown mechanism activated.
A flood of law turbulence erupted again and rushed toward him.
There was no space to evade.
The currents swallowed Daniel instantly.
This time, his body did not collapse permanently.
The destructive laws continuously damaged his flesh, but every particle carried the power of reincarnation.
As soon as one part was destroyed, it returned through an internal cycle and restored itself to its previous state.
Daniel’s body was broken and rebuilt again and again within moments.
His first stage of body refinement had succeeded.
Even so, the experiment remained incomplete.
Restoration allowed Daniel to survive, but every cycle consumed divine power.
If he entered the currents for too long, the repeated reconstruction would eventually exhaust him.
He needed to reduce the damage itself rather than merely recover after being torn apart.
Daniel stood within the turbulence and carefully observed which parts of his body failed first.
Flesh protected by denser reincarnation law endured longer, while particles with weaker integration vanished immediately.
The result proved that his chosen path was correct.
What he lacked was depth.
If he added another supreme law and sufficient body-refining resources, he might transform temporary endurance into true resistance.
With that conclusion, Daniel withdrew before the current could drain too much of his power.
A second, more ambitious period of cultivation was already taking shape in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 491 -491-Comprehending the Law of Destruction
paragraphs: Under the continuous impact of the law currents, Daniel’s body was repeatedly damaged and restored.
The experience was completely different from the first attack.

Previously, his entire physical form had collapsed almost instantly. Now his body could barely endure the destructive turbulence by relying upon the reincarnation characteristics infused into every particle.
Daniel soon noticed the remaining weakness.
"The consumption is too great. At this rate, I can remain here for only several hundred years before exhausting my divine power."
He did not dare use the Reincarnation Grail to borrow unlimited energy from his past and future selves.

If he connected those timelines while suffering continuous law damage, the destructive force might spread toward his future body as well. That would be safe only if he could guarantee that no crisis awaited him in the future.
Even the Law of Causality could not perfectly calculate everything that had yet to occur.
For now, enduring with his present reserves was safer.
Daniel released a helpless breath.
"My body has still not reached the necessary level."
He forced open a path through the law currents and withdrew.
His body had already become strong enough to escape with relative ease.
Ordinary Oracle-grade experts would never dare resist this turbulence with flesh alone. Even specialists in body cultivation might achieve only a result similar to Daniel’s current state.
Compared with typical Oracle-grade bodies, his physical Strength was already exceptional.
Daniel remained dissatisfied because exceptional was not enough. He needed a body capable of remaining inside the currents for as long as necessary.
After reaching a safe region, he summoned the Mountain of Time once more and entered it.
"This can still be improved."
Daniel reopened the body-refining manuals and began another long period of study.
After developing a new plan, he guided the power of Spacetime Law into his body in the same manner that he had previously used the Law of Reincarnation.
Every particle was tempered again.
Reincarnation granted restoration.
Spacetime granted stability, adaptation, and the ability to return each damaged particle toward a prior intact state.
Daniel also exchanged for enormous quantities of rare body-refining resources.
System notifications appeared continuously.
[Notice: You have consumed the peak-grade innate material, Diamond Fruit.]
[Notice: You have consumed the peak-grade innate material, Quartz Grass.]
[Notice: You have consumed the peak-grade innate medicine, Empty-Yin Pill.]
One priceless material after another entered his body.

Each was comparable in value to a Primordial Supreme Treasure. Daniel was effectively consuming treasures at the level of sacred needles, divine towers, and ancient artifacts merely to improve his flesh.
His enormous point balance decreased at a visible rate.
Another ten thousand years passed within the Mountain of Time.
Daniel’s body became several levels stronger, and Spacetime Law was fully integrated into every particle.
He slowly clenched his fist.
Immense Strength moved beneath his skin.
"I have spent hundreds of billions of points. This body was practically constructed from a mountain of resources."
The cost was enormous, but the result justified it.
Daniel could clearly feel that his physical cultivation had caught up with the progress of his Divine Soul.
He now followed both paths simultaneously, and both possessed top-tier foundations.
Daniel put away the Mountain of Time.
"This should be enough."
He returned to the formation and flew forward.
As expected, the restriction activated again. Law currents surged toward him like a cosmic flood.
Daniel smiled coldly and allowed them to swallow him.
The terrifying power began tearing at his body.
His present flesh, however, was completely different.
Countless treasures had formed a vast foundation. Reincarnation Law continuously restored damage, while Spacetime Law returned particles toward their intact state almost the instant they were harmed.
His body suffered brief destruction and immediately recovered.
The process occurred faster than perception.
A creature capable of regrowing a severed limb ordinarily required time. Daniel’s body restored itself within an instant, even while the destructive force continued attacking.
The law turbulence could no longer erase him easily.
Ordinary Oracle-grade experts could not accomplish such a feat. Daniel had pushed his physical body to the limit of his current Rank.
He could finally comprehend the Law of Destruction without fearing immediate death.
Daniel immersed himself completely in the turbulence.
Within the seemingly disorderly currents, he searched for the principles that caused destruction to erase matter, energy, laws, and Divine Souls.
Not far away, the third-stage Oracle-grade expert remained trapped.
That cultivator followed the Divine Soul path and had never forged a particularly powerful body. He had survived only by relying upon his tortoise-shell treasure and law-based Sacred Arts.
The surrounding currents became increasingly violent.
The defensive artifact could no longer endure.
Law turbulence broke through and swallowed the Oracle.
A scream of pain echoed through the mist.
The expert’s body began disintegrating piece by piece, yet he possessed no method of escape. Soon the currents reached his Divine Soul.
Within moments, both body and soul were completely erased.
The unfortunate Oracle died inside the formation without anyone witnessing the final moment.
Daniel did not know that another expert had fallen nearby.
His entire mind remained focused upon Destruction.

The reason the law currents appeared capable of annihilating everything was that they contained an enormous concentration of Destruction Law. Moreover, the destructive principles here had been generated naturally by the terrain of the secret realm rather than imposed by a later cultivator.
Daniel studied them without fear.
Notifications began appearing.
[Notice: Your Law of Destruction has reached low-grade.]
[Notice: Your Law of Destruction has reached mid-grade.]
[Notice: Your Law of Destruction has reached high-grade.]
After the final notification, Daniel ended his meditation.
"I did not expect ordinary law turbulence to provide such an enormous improvement."
He understood that he had reached the limit of what this location could teach him. Continuing to remain would produce diminishing returns.
To raise the Law of Destruction to the transcendent stage, he would need a greater opportunity.
Daniel turned toward the depths of the formation and advanced directly through the terrifying currents.
Compared with the law turbulence surrounding the outer boundary of the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land, the currents inside this formation were now far too weak to stop him.

His progress through the formation became increasingly effortless. Currents that had once annihilated him now washed across his body like violent waves striking an unbreakable reef. They still caused damage, but the injuries vanished before they could accumulate.

Daniel did not become complacent. The Sacred Origin Forbidden Land contained dangers far greater than this innate array, and high-grade Destruction was still one stage below his true objective. Nevertheless, the experience had given him a new foundation. His body and Divine Soul had reached an unusual balance, while three supreme laws now supported his future path.

Beyond the thinning mist, the Treasure Seeking Ability pulsed again. The ownerless treasure he had sensed earlier remained ahead. Daniel tightened his grip upon the Divine Spear and continued toward it, prepared to discover what the forbidden land had hidden beyond the destructive formation.
