chapters.title: Chapter 492 -492-Tempering Himself
paragraphs: High-stage Oracle-grade experts could travel freely through this place. In fact, moving here was even easier for them than navigating the outer regions.
For anyone below high-stage Oracle-grade, however, every step was extraordinarily difficult.

Daniel’s physical body had already been cultivated to an advanced stage. Although it was strong enough to withstand the chaotic currents of law that filled this region, he still had to proceed with extreme caution.
After traveling for some time, Daniel finally located the core of the innate formation.
As long as he stopped the formation core from functioning, every formation and restriction throughout the area would collapse.
At that moment, he suddenly noticed an extremely small spherical bead within his field of vision.
It was none other than the formation core.
The bead was only the size of a walnut. It floated silently in midair, continuously releasing all kinds of law power and supplying an endless stream of energy to the surrounding formation.
Daniel’s figure flashed as he flew toward it.
He carefully examined the tiny bead before reaching out and grasping it in his hand.
The instant his fingers closed around it, however, the bead suddenly trembled.
It began shaking violently back and forth.
Whoosh!
Daniel felt as though he had grabbed an uncontrollable wild stallion.
The bead dragged him upward at terrifying speed, carrying him toward some unknown destination.
What was even stranger was that the scenery within the depths of the forbidden land began to change before his eyes.
The surroundings gradually transformed into the scenery of another space.
It even evolved into something resembling a living world, although it did not appear to be a complete Plane of Life.
Daniel managed to catch only a fleeting glimpse of a stone monument.
A line of words had been carved across its surface.
Celestial Academy.
Immediately afterward, the entire world began spinning violently.
Daniel completely lost control of his body.
Even his consciousness began sinking into darkness, as though he might fall unconscious at any moment.
His powerful survival instincts left only a single thought within his mind.
He had to preserve his memories.
This place was most likely an inheritance ground.
In other words, what he was witnessing was probably a surviving fragment of memory left behind by the deceased T8 Oracle-grade expert.
Boom!
An explosion suddenly thundered through Daniel’s mind.
His vision went black.
After that, he knew nothing.
Celestial Academy.
"The peach tree glows in youthful bloom, its blossoms burning bright. The maiden now departs to wed, bringing harmony to her home."
A clear, melodious voice, as pleasant as the ringing of silver bells, sounded beside Daniel’s ears.
"Sophis, do you know what those lines mean?"
Daniel immediately opened his eyes and examined the person speaking before him.
She was a beautiful young woman in the prime of her youth.
At that moment, she was staring at him with an expectant expression.
Several other cultivators of roughly the same age stood nearby, looking at him with impatient and amused expressions.
A young man beside Daniel suddenly laughed.
"Sophis is a famously obsessive martial cultivator. All he knows is training. How could he possibly understand such romantic poetry from another universe?"
"If you asked him about some complicated cultivation problem, he could probably explain it to you for hundreds or even thousands of years without repeating himself."
"Hahaha!"
"Exactly. He’s nothing like idle young men such as us."
"Sophis is the one true genius of our academy."
"Now that the academy tournament has ended, he is unquestionably the number-one student of Celestial Academy."
Countless questions immediately appeared in Daniel’s mind.
Sophis?
Who was Sophis?
Could it be that—
A flash of realization suddenly crossed his thoughts.
He remembered now.
After his physical body and Destruction Law had both achieved some initial success, he had encountered the sacred eye formed from the laws of this place.
Then he had grasped the small bead.
The bead had carried him into what seemed to be the memories of a T8 Oracle-grade expert.
In other words...
Daniel’s gaze flickered.
"I am currently inside the memories of the deceased T8 Oracle-grade expert."
"This is a classic inheritance trial."
"There is practically a one-hundred-percent chance that I will obtain the inheritance after experiencing these memories."
Daniel immediately understood his situation.
He also realized that the T8 high-stage Oracle-grade expert was most likely named Sophis.
Sophis was probably the name of the T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse who had perished within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
At present, Daniel had effectively merged with Sophis.
He was experiencing the memories of Sophis’s life from within Sophis’s own body.
Daniel returned his attention to the scene unfolding before him.
The beautiful young woman immediately stepped in front of Sophis as though protecting him.
She spoke with a serious expression.
"Stop making fun of him."
"If Sophis had not worked so hard, how could he possess such extraordinary strength and talent?"
"He has not even cultivated for very long, yet he has already reached third-stage Oracle-grade."
"Look at yourselves."
"You entered the academy much earlier than Sophis, but you are still only second-stage Oracle-grade."
"You truly do not work as hard as he does."
The surrounding students merely smiled when they saw the young woman defending him.
None of them appeared offended.
One of them laughed teasingly.
"Holly, we’re only envious of Sophis’s talent."
"We weren’t actually insulting him."
"Why are you defending him so passionately?"
"Could it be that you like him?"
"I think a young lady should be a little more reserved."
"If you behave too eagerly, others might not appreciate you."
"Ooh, look at the two of them."
"They’re displaying their affection right in front of us."
"What terrible sin did I commit to deserve this?"
"I really envy Sophis."
"He was born into a prestigious family, possesses extraordinary talent, and works harder than anyone else."
"More importantly, even the daughter of the academy’s headmaster has given him her heart."
"He is practically the winner of life that all of us dream of becoming."
"Exactly. I’m so jealous that I can barely stand it."
Only after listening to their teasing did Daniel realize that the young woman protecting Sophis was actually the daughter of Celestial Academy’s headmaster.
At that moment, Daniel suddenly felt a soft hand wrap around his arm.
Holly had directly linked her arm with his.
She raised her chin proudly and puffed out her chest.
"Are all of you trying to tell me what to do?"
The others hurriedly stuck out their tongues and shook their heads awkwardly.
"We wouldn’t dare."
"How could we possibly teach the esteemed young lady what to do?"
"As long as you’re happy, that’s all that matters."
"But could you at least consider the feelings of single people like us?"
"You’re openly behaving like this in broad daylight."
"This is simply too cruel!"
Several of the students pretended to be furious before turning around and walking away with exaggerated indignation.
Holly watched their departing backs and laughed.
Her laughter rang out like silver bells.
She then turned to look at Sophis.
At that moment, Daniel suddenly thought of someone.
Ars.
A trace of emotion appeared in his heart.
He wondered how Ars was doing now.
Just then, Holly tugged gently on his arm and spoke in a spoiled tone.
"Sophis, do you know what the poem I recited means?"
Sophis blinked.
As it happened, he had once encountered the poem in an ancient record.
According to what he had read, it originated from an extremely old civilization in another universe.
The lines surfaced within his mind once more.
The peach tree glows in youthful bloom.
Its blossoms burn with radiant light.
The maiden now departs to wed.
May she bring harmony to her household.
Sophis drew in a deep breath and explained,
"These lines come from an ancient collection of poetry."
"They describe a beautiful young woman who is about to be married."
"She leaves her family filled with joy and travels to the household of her husband."
"There, she will help maintain harmony within the family, establish a peaceful home, bear descendants, and allow the clan to flourish."

chapters.title: Chapter 493 -493-The T8 Inheritance
paragraphs: Holly’s eyes immediately widened in surprise after hearing his explanation.

She smiled and said, "I never expected you to actually understand the meaning of that poem. It seems you are not merely obsessed with martial cultivation after all. Your literary knowledge is quite impressive as well."
"Fortunately, however, you still failed to mention the most important part."
As she spoke, she could not help laughing.
Her eyes curved into delicate crescents, and a strange, glittering light seemed to shimmer within them.
She looked at Daniel expectantly, clearly hoping that he would complete the part he had deliberately left unsaid.
Daniel could not help feeling puzzled.
"The most important part?"
"Did I overlook something?"
A thought suddenly occurred to him.
Could the important part be that she wanted him to marry her?
Although Daniel had already understood what she was implying, he did not say it aloud. Instead, he deliberately pretended not to understand and asked with a smile,
"Then may I ask what the most important part is?"
Two patches of crimson immediately appeared on Holly’s cheeks.
She lowered her head, stamped her foot, and complained,
"You’re horrible! I’m not telling you!"
After saying that, she released his arm and hurried into the distance.
However, after running a short distance, she suddenly stopped.
She turned around sharply.
A radiant smile blossomed across her face, and her eyes shone brightly as she called out,
"Sophis, don’t forget our promise in April!"
Their promise in April?
A brief fragment of memory immediately surfaced within Daniel’s mind.
The peach blossom forest behind Celestial Academy in April?
Daniel blinked.
Before he could say anything else, the scene around him abruptly changed.
Within the territory of the Third Eye Clan, two Oracle-grade experts suddenly descended from the sky.
Both of them were Tier-5 Oracle-grade powerhouses.
The patriarch of the Third Eye Clan personally came out to receive them.
The moment he appeared, he bowed respectfully and asked,
"May I ask why the two honored envoys have come to our territory?"
The Third Eye Clan was one of the most powerful races in the region.
Every member of the clan possessed three eyes.
Their third eye grew at the center of the forehead.

It was said that the stronger a member of the Third Eye Clan became, the more valuable their Mystic Eye would be. Such eyes possessed countless extraordinary abilities and could be refined or used in numerous ways.
The strongest member of the clan was its patriarch, who had reached Tier-5 Oracle-grade.
The second strongest was Sophis.
Sophis had already reached Tier-3 Oracle-grade and was currently studying at Celestial Academy.
One of the two Tier-5 Oracle-grade experts cast an indifferent glance at the patriarch.
"We have come under our master’s orders."
"You are to surrender the third eyes of every member of the Third Eye Clan who has reached Divine-grade or above."
The patriarch’s face instantly turned deathly pale.
If their third eyes were taken away, the strength of the entire Third Eye Clan would fall by more than half.
A look of despair spread across his face, but he forced himself to remain standing.
"Did Grand Oracle Sirius truly issue such an order?"
"I do not believe it."
"I wish to meet Grand Oracle Sirius personally and beg him to reconsider."
One of the Tier-5 Grand Oracle-grade experts immediately frowned and shouted,
"Do you think our master is someone you may meet merely because you wish to?"
"You are nowhere near qualified!"
"I advise you not to reject the kindness we are showing you."
"If you force us to take action personally, we will not stop after removing your eyes."
"We will kill anyone who resists."
Upon hearing those words, the patriarch of the Third Eye Clan felt as though he had fallen into an abyss of ice.
A terrifying chill spread through his entire body.
At the same time, within Celestial Academy, Daniel stared at the urgent letter that had just arrived from Sophis’s family.
His entire body was trembling.
The trembling did not originate from Daniel himself.
It came from the body he currently inhabited.
It was the uncontrollable reaction of a body overwhelmed by absolute rage.
Evidently, the original Sophis had been driven into such extreme fury that even Daniel could not suppress the physical response.
He could only watch as the hands holding the letter trembled violently.
The letter clearly explained everything that had happened.
Sophis’s family had resisted the order and had already been completely exterminated.
At the same time, the third eyes of every Divine-grade or stronger member of the Third Eye Clan had been brutally torn from their foreheads.
Because the clan had resisted, it had also suffered catastrophic casualties.
Boundless grief and fury surged through Sophis’s body, nearly drowning his remaining reason.
Daniel could clearly feel the overwhelming anger and unbearable pain contained within this body.
Sophis’s entire family had been destroyed in a single night.
His people had suffered devastating losses.
Even the patriarch who had always loved him, protected him, and spent nearly all of the clan’s resources nurturing him had been mercilessly killed by those Oracle-grade experts.
The Third Eye Clan had been crippled.
It had lost its leader and fallen into chaos.
The surviving clansmen were now waiting for Sophis to return and avenge them.
At that moment, an immensely powerful obsession arose from the depths of the body.
Revenge.
Revenge.
And still more revenge.
Hatred had already seeped into every inch of Sophis’s flesh and blood.
Boom!
A terrifying aura erupted from his body.
Faint cracks began appearing throughout the surrounding space.
The entire area trembled violently beneath the pressure of his rage.
At that moment, a graceful figure suddenly appeared before him.
Holly hurried to Daniel’s side, her expression filled with worry.
She opened her mouth and called softly,
"Sophis..."
Yet halfway through speaking, she suddenly found herself unable to continue.
Should she tell him to calm down?
No one could possibly remain calm after suffering something like this.
Should she persuade him not to seek revenge?
Such a blood-soaked feud could never be ignored.
If Sophis refused to avenge his family after learning everything he had learned, he would probably live the rest of his life in grief and regret.
Asking him to survive in humiliation and endure the hatred in silence would hardly be the conduct of a true man.
If Sophis were the kind of person who would choose to hide forever after his family had been slaughtered, Holly would never have regarded him as a hero.
Therefore, she did not know what she could possibly say to comfort him.
In the end, Holly quietly sat down beside Sophis.
She said nothing.
She only hoped that when this man was suffering through the darkest and most painful moment of his life, she could remain by his side.
Several days later, the sky was clear and the clouds were light.
Sophis had already packed everything he needed.
He turned toward Holly and said,
"I am leaving."
"According to the rules of Celestial Academy, I have already completed my studies."
"I am no longer considered an ordinary student of the academy, so I am free to descend the mountain whenever I wish."
"Once I report the matter to my master, I will leave."
Holly looked at him with undisguised concern.
"Where are you going?"
"Let me come with you."
Sophis calmly shook his head.
"Although you are Master’s daughter, you are still a member of Celestial Academy."
"You must obey the academy’s rules."
"How could you violate the rules personally established by your own father?"
"I am only returning to my clan for a short visit."
"I will be back soon."
Holly stared at him.
An ominous intuition suddenly arose within her heart.
She felt strangely restless, as though something terrible was about to happen.
However, she had no way to stop him.
In the end, she could only force herself to nod.
"All right."
"Then you must come back soon."
Celestial Academy was an ancient orthodoxy founded by the Celestial Grand Oracle, a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Only students with exceptional talent and an unblemished background were qualified to enter the academy.
The Celestial Grand Oracle had personally established a rule stating that any student who reached Tier-3 Oracle-grade would be considered to have completed their studies.
Sophis happened to be a Tier-3 Oracle-grade expert.
Therefore, he was already free to enter and leave Celestial Academy whenever he wished.
Even so, he still chose to visit his master first and formally bid farewell.
Within a quiet hall, the Celestial Grand Oracle formed a series of hand seals.
He began deducing the fate of Sophis, the strongest disciple beneath his tutelage.
One scene after another appeared within his calculations.
Yet the results were all the same.
Every possible future revealed that Sophis’s fate would be unimaginably tragic.
Countless calamities awaited him.
Disaster after disaster would descend upon his path.
Most frightening of all, the probability that he would survive them was extraordinarily small.

chapters.title: Chapter 494 -494-The Avenger
paragraphs: The Celestial Grand Oracle had cultivated the Law of Fate to an extraordinarily high Rank.
Yet it was precisely because of his profound understanding of fate that he believed in allowing events to unfold naturally.
He was unwilling to forcibly alter another person’s destiny.
Even when it concerned his own direct disciple, he would not casually interfere with the threads of karma surrounding that person.
Heaven possessed its heavenly mandate, and every living being had a fate of their own.
Once the gears of destiny began to turn, they could no longer be easily stopped.
Throughout history, countless powerful beings had attempted to halt those gears.
Without exception, however, they had ultimately suffered a devastating backlash from fate itself.
After all, human destiny was the most unpredictable thing in existence.
In truth, by this point, many events had already been decided.
They could no longer be changed.
The Celestial Grand Oracle looked at the disciple standing before him and sighed inwardly.
When this child encounters his greatest calamity in the future, I will help him once.
However, that will also be the final time.
After he survives that tribulation, the karmic connection between us will be completely severed.
From that moment onward, we will no longer have anything to do with each other.
Having reached this decision, the Celestial Grand Oracle finally spoke.
"Sophis, if you wish to descend the mountain, you may do so."
"However, there is one piece of advice I must give you before you leave."
Sophis had always held profound respect for his master.
He immediately knelt respectfully and lowered his head.
"Please speak, Master."
"Your disciple will listen with complete attention."
The Celestial Grand Oracle said calmly,
"Everything is governed by fate."
"Human will can change almost none of it."
"No matter what happens, you must learn to let certain things go."
Hearing those words, Daniel silently repeated them within his mind.
Everything is governed by fate.
Human will can change almost none of it.
No matter what happens, one must learn to let certain things go.
He carefully contemplated the words and firmly engraved them into his memory.
Then he spoke gratefully.
"Your disciple will never forget Master’s teachings."
"Thank you for your guidance."
The Celestial Grand Oracle waved his hand.
He closed his eyes and released a faint sigh.
"You may leave."
Sophis bowed deeply toward the Celestial Grand Oracle.
"I understand, Master."
"Your disciple will take his leave."
In less than a day, the greatest genius of the Third Eye Clan returned to his homeland.
The first thing Sophis did upon arriving was investigate every detail of the tragedy.
He continuously questioned the survivors, demanding to know exactly what had happened.
Without exception, every survivor wept bitterly as they recounted the events.
"The Oracle-grade servants under Grand Oracle Sirius forced the patriarch to order every Divine-grade or stronger member of our clan to surrender their Mystic Eyes!"
"The patriarch refused!"
"He insisted on meeting the Grand Oracle personally so that he could question him about the order."
"However, those Oracle-grade servants would not allow it."
"They said the patriarch was not qualified to meet Grand Oracle Sirius."
"They also said that Grand Oracle Sirius needed our Mystic Eyes to cultivate a powerful Sacred Art and forge an innate supreme treasure."
"That was why they deliberately came to our clan."
"They claimed that being able to serve Grand Oracle Sirius was already the greatest honor our Third Eye Clan could ever receive!"
"Then they attacked!"
"They beat the patriarch to death right in front of us!"
"After that, they slaughtered their way into the clan and forcibly dug the Mystic Eyes out of the foreheads of our experts!"
"That’s right!"
"Many of our experts rose up and resisted, but we were far too weak."
"We were no match for those Oracle-grade servants."
"We could only watch as they slaughtered us however they pleased."
"Your brothers, sisters, and parents were also killed while resisting them."
"They died so miserably!"
One anguished accusation after another entered Sophis’s ears.
Yet at this moment, Sophis appeared extraordinarily calm.
After experiencing the initial eruption of absolute fury, he had already made his decision.
He would take revenge.
However, before seeking vengeance, he had to remain calm.
If a weakling wished to take revenge against a supreme powerhouse, he needed a flawless and comprehensive plan.
Acting recklessly would only result in meaningless death.
With that thought in mind, Sophis spoke.
"My cultivation is now the highest among all surviving members of the clan."
"The position of patriarch is currently vacant."
"Therefore, I will reluctantly assume the position of the new patriarch."
"Gather every survivor immediately."
"I have an announcement to make."
Sophis was a Tier-3 Oracle-grade expert.
Almost every high-grade Divine-grade and Oracle-grade expert within the Third Eye Clan had already been killed or severely injured.
The servants of Grand Oracle Sirius had practically slaughtered all of them.
This also demonstrated just how unyielding the Third Eye Clan had been.
They would rather die than submit.
Even when faced with certain death, they had still chosen to resist with everything they possessed.
As the only remaining true powerhouse in the clan, Sophis naturally inherited the position of patriarch.
Following his orders, the surviving clansmen rapidly gathered from every corner of their territory.
Before long, several billion members of the Third Eye Clan had assembled.
Sophis looked across the endless sea of people.
His voice spread clearly through the air and entered the ears of every clansman.
"Our Third Eye Clan has existed for countless years."
"For generation after generation, we have upheld the same tradition."
"A tooth for a tooth."
"An eye for an eye."
"Blood for blood!"
"Grand Oracle Sirius possesses neither virtue nor honor."
"For the sake of his own selfish interests, he brought a bloody calamity upon our clan and caused us to suffer catastrophic losses."
"As the newly appointed patriarch, perhaps my current strength is still insufficient."
"However, my determination will never waver!"
"I, Sophis, swear before every member of the Third Eye Clan!"
"Until this blood debt has been repaid, I will no longer consider myself a member of the Third Eye Clan!"
The moment Sophis finished speaking, the clansmen below erupted into furious roars.
Their battle intent surged into the heavens.
"We must avenge this blood feud!"
"Blood for blood!"
"An eye for an eye!"
"A tooth for a tooth!"
"Even if our entire clan is destroyed, we will still take revenge!"
"Revenge!"
"Revenge!"
"Revenge!"
Sophis raised one hand, signaling for everyone to quiet down.
As the deafening cries gradually subsided, he spoke calmly.
"I now require all of you to enter one of my treasures."
"I will carry every surviving member of our clan with me."
"Together, we will avenge all those who died!"
The moment his voice fell, a world-class treasure appeared in the air.
The internal space of the treasure was incomparably vast.
It was easily capable of holding several billion members of the Third Eye Clan.
None of the clansmen hesitated.
One after another, they flew directly into the treasure.
They understood that if they did not wish to become burdens to Sophis, they had to abandon their current territory and enter the world contained within the treasure.
They chose to forsake everything they had once possessed.
Without hesitation or regret, they entered the world-class treasure.
Sophis watched expressionlessly as clansman after clansman disappeared inside.
The flames of rage burning within his eyes had already reached their limit.
The Fate Tree was one of the inherited treasures of the Third Eye Clan.
When Sophis had first broken through to Oracle-grade, the former patriarch had personally entrusted the treasure to him.
That action had essentially confirmed that Sophis was being cultivated as the next patriarch.
The Fate Tree emerged and floated in midair.
Countless laws rapidly circulated around it.
Its form soon began to expand, transforming into an enormous tree that towered into the sky.
Its branches and roots surged with endless Strength.
Almost the instant the treasure appeared, the experts guarding this territory sensed its terrifying aura.
In the next moment, countless figures appeared.
Several experts immediately roared in fury.
"Which blind fool dares cause trouble here?"
"Have you lost your mind?"
"Do you not know that this is the territory of Grand Oracle Sirius?"
"How insolent!"
"Put away that treasure immediately and crawl over here to apologize!"
"You may leave the treasure behind as compensation!"
Among the experts who appeared, there was no shortage of Oracle-grade powerhouses.
The strongest among them had even reached Tier-2 Oracle-grade.

Its branches and roots surged with endless Strength.
Almost the instant the treasure appeared, the experts guarding this territory sensed its terrifying aura.
In the next moment, countless figures appeared.
Several experts immediately roared in fury.
"Which blind fool dares cause trouble here?"
"Have you lost your mind?"
"Do you not know that this is the territory of Grand Oracle Sirius?"
"How insolent!"
"Put away that treasure immediately and crawl over here to apologize!"
"You may leave the treasure behind as compensation!"
Among the experts who appeared, there was no shortage of Oracle-grade powerhouses.
The strongest among them had even reached Tier-2 Oracle-grade.

chapters.title: Chapter 495 -495-Schemes Within Schemes
paragraphs: Sophis regarded the gathered experts with an icy gaze.
With the overwhelming power of his treasure and his own formidable cultivation, he had no reason to fear any of them.
He let out a cold laugh.
"You worthless bastards."
"Die!"
With a single thought, the branches of the Fate Tree expanded wildly.
Countless branches lashed downward again and again, suppressing the entire region while indiscriminately destroying every building and living creature within sight.
Each branch resembled an indestructible divine whip.
A single strike shattered the nearby port.
Countless structures were reduced to dust beneath the relentless barrage.
The formations and restrictions protecting the territory were completely incapable of withstanding the branches of the Fate Tree.
They collapsed as easily as sheets of paper.
Many of the experts stationed throughout the area were directly struck by the branches.
Their bodies were pierced through before they could offer the slightest resistance.
Numerous other powerful cultivators were also sent flying by the violent strikes.
Only a small number of Oracle-grade experts managed to barely withstand the attacks of the Fate Tree and surround Sophis.
Sophis did not even bother looking at them.
He immediately activated one of his Sacred Arts.
"Law of Life and Death."
"Karmic Millstone!"
As the opposing Sacred Arts collided, countless strange lights erupted across the sky.
The surrounding space was torn apart, and long spatial fractures spread in every direction.
Although the Oracle-grade expert opposing Sophis possessed Tier-4 cultivation, one full Rank above him, Sophis’s Sacred Art did not fall into a disadvantage.
In fact, the two sides appeared evenly matched.
This was the confidence that allowed Sophis to come here alone and seek revenge.
His master was a mighty T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
As the Celestial Grand Oracle’s most outstanding disciple, Sophis had naturally mastered top-tier Sacred Arts.
He possessed the ability to suppress experts of the same Rank and even challenge opponents above his own level.
The Tier-4 Oracle-grade expert stared at Sophis and sneered.
"There is no need to defeat him immediately."
"Simply trap him here."
"Although we cannot deal with him for the moment, we only need to delay him until the other experts of our faction arrive."
"Once they get here, he will no longer have the strength to resist."
A Tier-3 Oracle-grade expert immediately replied,
"That’s right."
"I will trap him."
As soon as he finished speaking, the Tier-3 Oracle-grade expert began constructing a confinement formation.
He intended to forcibly imprison Sophis within the area.
Sophis glanced at them with disdain.
"You think trash like you is worthy of trapping me?"
The next instant, the third eye in the center of his forehead suddenly opened.
A blood-red radiance erupted from the Mystic Eye.
The moment the red light fell upon the Tier-3 Oracle-grade expert, his body was instantly frozen in place.
He could not move even a single finger.
His entire body began trembling slightly.
Even more terrifyingly, the life force within him began to slowly dissipate.
His skin rapidly withered, and his body aged at a speed visible to the naked eye.
At that moment, countless branches of the Fate Tree lashed toward him.
The branches pierced through the Tier-3 Oracle-grade expert from every direction, turning him into something resembling a pincushion.
His body was instantly torn apart.
He was killed on the spot.
When the Tier-5 Oracle-grade expert saw the Tier-3 Oracle-grade cultivator fall, he was instantly consumed by rage.
His expression turned incomparably sinister as he said coldly,
"You are dead, Sophis."
"Grand Oracle Sirius will never let you escape!"
The moment Sophis heard the name of Grand Oracle Sirius, the flames of hatred within his eyes burned even more fiercely.
However, he truly was wary of Grand Oracle Sirius and the numerous Oracle-grade servants under his command.
That is enough revenge for today.
After making his decision, Sophis immediately recalled the Fate Tree.
His body transformed into a streak of light, and he fled the area at astonishing speed.
Daniel’s consciousness had remained hidden within Sophis’s body throughout the entire battle.
When he witnessed Sophis’s escape technique, he could not help feeling surprised.
The Law of Speed?
Whenever Daniel chose not to control the body, Sophis’s original consciousness and personality would take command.
If Daniel wished to take over, he could instantly seize complete control of Sophis’s body.
However, he had no interest in doing so.
He preferred to remain an observer and experience the events of Sophis’s life from the sidelines.
As long as he witnessed the entirety of this memory, he might be able to obtain the complete inheritance of this future Grand Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Daniel had just sensed that Sophis’s speed was extraordinarily fast.
He was several times faster than an ordinary Oracle-grade expert.
Daniel silently analyzed Sophis’s abilities.
Sophis had most likely cultivated the Law of Speed, the Law of Yin and Yang, and the Law of Causality.
He had already cultivated all three laws to an extremely high Rank.
His body also contained traces of the Law of Fate and the Law of Destruction.
However, those two laws had currently only reached the transcendent stage.
Even so, Sophis’s strength was already extraordinarily formidable.
Neither the same-Rank experts he had killed nor the Tier-5 Oracle-grade expert he had confronted possessed such a large number of laws.
This was probably another reason Sophis had dared to invade Grand Oracle Sirius’s territory alone.
While Daniel was still analyzing the situation, Sophis had already activated his movement Sacred Art and escaped.
However, he had no intention of stopping his revenge.
His figure repeatedly flashed through the void as he invaded several other living worlds.
Those living worlds were also territories belonging to Grand Oracle Sirius.
Without the slightest hesitation, Sophis began massacring the forces stationed within them.
During these attacks, his extraordinary speed granted him an enormous advantage.
Even Tier-5 Oracle-grade experts were incapable of catching him.
They could only watch helplessly as he escaped, unable to do anything to stop him.
Against experts of the same Rank or a lower Rank, Sophis possessed an overwhelming advantage.
He could suppress them with ease.
Even opponents who had mastered the Law of Spacetime were still restrained by his abilities.
Sophis’s Mystic Eye talent unexpectedly possessed the ability to tear through space and escape.
He relied upon this Mystic Eye ability to survive one fatal situation after another.
Within the Sirius Secret Realm, the disturbances caused by Sophis’s revenge grew increasingly severe.
The situation continued escalating until it finally alarmed the Oracle-grade servants under Grand Oracle Sirius.
The matter was reported through multiple levels of authority before eventually reaching Grand Oracle Sirius himself.
After receiving the report, Grand Oracle Sirius did not appear particularly angry.
It seemed as though everything had occurred within his expectations.
He spoke calmly.
"Three days from now, he will appear in the Gushing Spring Plane."
"Take this treasure and talisman with you."
"With them, you will be able to suppress him."
Grand Oracle Sirius took out the Aurora Mystic Eye Treasure that he had only recently finished refining.
Alongside it was a talisman.
The treasure had been refined from the Mystic Eyes of the Third Eye Clan.
The talisman was also a newly refined Oracle-grade treasure personally created by Grand Oracle Sirius.
Sealed within it was the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sharingan Sacred Art.
Grand Oracle Sirius handed both treasures directly to one of his Oracle-grade servants.
"After suppressing Sophis, bring him back to the secret realm and imprison him."
"You are not permitted to kill him without my order."
The Oracle-grade servant could not help feeling confused.
Sophis had repeatedly attacked the territories of Grand Oracle Sirius.
He had even massacred countless living beings and Oracle-grade experts under Sirius’s command.
His actions were no different from openly trampling upon the dignity of Grand Oracle Sirius.
Yet his master still intended to spare Sophis’s life.
Since when had Grand Oracle Sirius become so merciful?
The servant could not understand his master’s intentions.
Nevertheless, he could only obey the order.
The Tier-5 Oracle-grade expert put away the two treasures and rapidly departed.
Grand Oracle Sirius watched the servant disappear into the distance.
A faint smile appeared on his face.
"Heh."
"Celestial Grand Oracle, it appears that you will owe me another favor."
Once someone reached the level of a Grand Oracle-grade expert, they could clearly unravel countless karmic connections.
With only a simple calculation, they could deduce many deeply hidden secrets.
Grand Oracle Sirius had already calculated Sophis’s next destination.
He had also deduced the method required to suppress him.
This matter would inevitably involve the Celestial Grand Oracle standing behind Sophis.
Grand Oracle Sirius had even calculated the final outcome of the entire incident.
All he needed to do now was proceed according to the plan.

chapters.title: Chapter 496 -496-In the Midst of His Trial
paragraphs: That was, of course, unless Sophis could become an exceptionally unique existence like Daniel.
No matter who attempted the deduction, they could only follow a few fragmented karmic threads and obtain some basic information about Daniel, along with scattered glimpses of events from the future.
If they tried to probe any deeper and uncover more detailed information about him, even a Grand Sage-level powerhouse would be unable to accomplish it.
Shamir was a perfect example.
Although he had attempted to divine Daniel’s fate many times, the only conclusion he could obtain was that Daniel would inevitably become an incomparably important figure in the future.
As for any more specific information, there was nothing he could do.
If a Grand Sage attempted to use the laws of causality, fate, or spacetime against Daniel, they might even suffer an unimaginably terrifying backlash.
Sophis, however, was not Daniel.
Even if someone used the laws of causality, fate, or spacetime to deal with him, they would not suffer the slightest backlash.
At the same time, within the Quanyong Plane, Sophis piloted a starship and forcibly broke through the formations and restrictions protecting the region.
This was merely one of the countless planes he had attacked over the past several days.
He immediately put away the starship and summoned the Fate Tree.
Boom!
The Fate Tree rose into the air.
Law power surged around it with terrifying intensity.
Its countless branches shimmered with specks of starlight, continuously stretching and spreading through the void.
They grew like an expanding galaxy, becoming increasingly vast and majestic.
At that moment, a Tier-5 Oracle-grade expert suddenly appeared within the plane.
When the Tier-5 Oracle-grade expert saw the scene before him, he immediately sneered.
"Sophis, I have been waiting for you for quite some time."
Sophis’s expression changed drastically upon hearing those words.
The next moment, the Tier-5 Oracle-grade expert summoned a Mystic Eye.
It was none other than the Aurora Mystic Eye.
An incomparably terrifying radiance spread from the eye.
Wherever its light shone, even the Fate Tree was completely immobilized and rendered incapable of moving.
Sophis instantly realized that his opponent had come fully prepared.
Even the environment around him began to change.
It was as though the entire surrounding space was gradually solidifying and freezing in place.
Furthermore, the Mystic Eye gave him an extremely familiar sensation.
Sophis was immediately overwhelmed by rage.
He recognized it all too clearly.
That treasure had been refined from the Mystic Eyes of members of the Third Eye Clan.
Yet now, his enemies had transformed those eyes into a supreme treasure.
Worse still, it was an exceptional offensive treasure.
The Aurora Mystic Eye might even contain the Mystic Eyes of Sophis’s own parents, brothers, or sisters.
Sophis’s eyes instantly turned blood-red.
The third eye at the center of his forehead abruptly opened, releasing a beam of crimson light.
However, the power of Sophis’s crimson eye was no match for the Aurora Mystic Eye.
Instead of overpowering it, his Mystic Eye was completely suppressed.
Sophis’s heart sank.
"This is bad."
"My abilities are being completely countered."
He immediately abandoned the idea of continuing his revenge and prepared to turn around and escape.
However, it was already too late.
The Tier-5 Oracle-grade expert chuckled softly.
In the next instant, he summoned the Oracle-grade talisman.
Without any visible flame, the talisman abruptly began burning on its own.
A newly created Sacred Art belonging to Grand Oracle Sirius instantly manifested.
The Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sharingan!
Several surrounding planes were immediately enveloped by the gigantic eye.
The eye rotated with extraordinary agility.
As it moved, the surrounding law power shifted along with it.
In only an instant, the imprisoning power of the eye locked directly onto Sophis.
Boom!
Sophis felt a deafening hum erupt inside his mind.
Everything before him began spinning violently.
Shock and anxiety filled his heart.
He knew that he had fallen into an extremely dangerous situation.
The predicament before him had already become hopeless.
The divine eye Sacred Art was simply too powerful.
Even Sophis was completely incapable of resisting it.
Only one thought remained in his mind.
Am I going to die here?
Daniel could clearly feel Sophis’s despair.
However, he remained unmoved.
Daniel knew that Sophis would eventually become a mighty T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
At present, Sophis was only Tier-3 Oracle-grade.
There was no possibility that he would die here.
Daniel was merely curious about how Sophis would escape from this seemingly hopeless situation.
What extraordinary feat would he accomplish that would allow him to survive and eventually reach T8 Oracle-grade?
Perhaps the inheritance opportunity Daniel sought was hidden within this very fragment of memory.
The Tier-5 Oracle-grade expert looked at Sophis.
After confirming that Sophis had been completely suppressed, a smile appeared on his face.
He waved his hand.
In the next instant, a rope appeared and tightly bound Sophis from head to toe.
The Tier-5 Oracle-grade expert spoke with clear dissatisfaction.
"If the master did not require your miserable life, you would already be dead."
He bound Sophis so thoroughly that the latter could not move even slightly.
Then he carried Sophis back to the Sirius Secret Realm.
Following the instructions of Grand Oracle Sirius, he imprisoned Sophis rather than killing him.
Within the Sirius Star River Secret Realm stood a heavily fortified dungeon.
Deep inside the dungeon was a space covered in countless restrictions.
Any living being imprisoned there would be completely suppressed.
They would be unable to exert even the smallest fraction of their strength.
At that moment, the dungeon gates opened.
A figure was roughly thrown inside from the outside.
Boom!
The body crashed heavily against the ground.
Immediately afterward, chains forged from unknown materials suddenly awakened like living serpents.
They rapidly wrapped around the figure, binding every part of his body.
Daniel sensed that every meridian and energy channel within his current body had been completely sealed.
The chains were also forcibly suppressing Sophis’s energy, laws, and Sacred Arts.
They were clearly no ordinary treasures.
At this moment, Sophis’s body could not release even the slightest trace of Strength.
Daniel frowned and examined his surroundings.
"So this is the dungeon?"
The corners of his mouth curved upward slightly.
Sophis had already been completely restrained.
He had no ability to resist.
Yet his captors had not killed him immediately.
It appeared that Sophis truly possessed a great opportunity and extraordinary fortune.
Otherwise, there was no way he could eventually become a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
After reaching this conclusion, Daniel stopped worrying about the situation.
The current Sophis could not possibly die here.
Suddenly, a faint buzzing sound rang out.
Daniel realized that the sound was coming from Sophis’s neck.
He felt somewhat curious.
"What is that sound?"
A chain hung around the neck of Sophis’s body.
At the center of the chain was a small lock known as the Chaos Lock.
It also appeared to be an extraordinary treasure, although Daniel did not yet know what special purpose it possessed.
At the same time, within Celestial Academy, the Chaos Lock hanging around Holly’s neck began producing a series of urgent sounds.
Beep. Beep. Beep.
The moment Holly heard the noise coming from the lock, her expression immediately darkened.
As the owner of the Chaos Lock, no one understood the meaning of that sound better than Holly.
Her heart instantly filled with anxiety.
"This is bad!"
"Sophis is in danger!"
"The Chaos Lock only produces a warning when the other bearer encounters a life-threatening crisis."
"Since I can hear it now, Sophis must already be in mortal danger."
"No."
"I have to save him!"
Holly immediately panicked.
However, she also understood that her own abilities were extremely limited.
Any place capable of placing even Sophis in such a dangerous situation had to be unimaginably perilous.
It was definitely not somewhere she could recklessly enter alone.
Furthermore, she did not even know Sophis’s current location.
She could only follow the instructions her father had given her beforehand and go to find him first.

It appeared that Sophis truly possessed a great opportunity and extraordinary fortune.
Otherwise, there was no way he could eventually become a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
After reaching this conclusion, Daniel stopped worrying about the situation.
The current Sophis could not possibly die here.
Suddenly, a faint buzzing sound rang out.
Daniel realized that the sound was coming from Sophis’s neck.
He felt somewhat curious.
"What is that sound?"
A chain hung around the neck of Sophis’s body.
At the center of the chain was a small lock known as the Chaos Lock.
It also appeared to be an extraordinary treasure, although Daniel did not yet know what special purpose it possessed.
At the same time, within Celestial Academy, the Chaos Lock hanging around Holly’s neck began producing a series of urgent sounds.
Beep.
Beep.
Beep.
The moment Holly heard the noise coming from the lock, her expression immediately darkened.
As the owner of the Chaos Lock, no one understood the meaning of that sound better than Holly.
Her heart instantly filled with anxiety.
"This is bad!"
"Sophis is in danger!"
"The Chaos Lock only produces a warning when the other bearer encounters a life-threatening crisis."
"Since I can hear it now, Sophis must already be in mortal danger."
"No."
"I have to save him!"
Holly immediately panicked.
However, she also understood that her own abilities were extremely limited.
Any place capable of placing even Sophis in such a dangerous situation had to be unimaginably perilous.
It was definitely not somewhere she could recklessly enter alone.
Furthermore, she did not even know Sophis’s current location.
She could only follow the instructions her father had given her beforehand and go to find him first.

chapters.title: Chapter 497 -497-Severing Karmic Ties
paragraphs: Holly sped through Celestial Academy, anxiously searching for the Celestial Grand Oracle.
She shouted loudly,
"Father! Sophis is in danger! Please, you have to save him!"
Her eyes were already red with tears.
Suddenly, the voice of the Celestial Grand Oracle sounded above her head.
He deliberately asked,
"How do you know that he is in danger?"
Holly was both embarrassed and frantic.
She stammered,
"I—I exchanged the Primordial Supreme Treasure you gave me for a pair of Chaos Locks."
"My Chaos Lock and Sophis’s Chaos Lock are now bound together."
"Whenever either of us encounters danger, the locks will issue a warning."
At this point, she gritted her teeth and continued,
"Moreover, if either one of us dies, the other will die as well."
"The truth is... Sophis and I secretly pledged ourselves to each other long ago."
"Father, you must save him."
"Otherwise, your daughter will die with him."
How profound was the Celestial Grand Oracle’s mastery of the Law of Fate?
How could he possibly fail to see that the destinies and karmic threads of his daughter and Sophis had already become deeply intertwined?
Under the current circumstances, however, he merely wanted his mischievous daughter to admit the truth with her own mouth.
After hearing her confession, the Celestial Grand Oracle released a long sigh.
"Ah, a grown daughter truly cannot be kept at home."
"I bestowed a treasure upon you, yet you exchanged it for the Chaos Locks."
"Since you and Sophis share such deep affection, I will help remove the restriction binding the two of you."
As soon as this thought crossed his mind, the Celestial Grand Oracle flicked his finger.
A streak of light immediately appeared and entered Holly’s body.
Holly instantly felt as though an invisible bond within her had been forcibly severed.
Her face turned deathly pale.
Why had the Celestial Grand Oracle done that?
Had he decided to abandon Sophis?
Tears immediately poured from Holly’s eyes.
She cried out,
"Father, please! You must save Sophis!"
"As long as you are willing to save him, I will obey every instruction you give me from now on!"
The Celestial Grand Oracle raised an eyebrow and smiled.
"Do you truly mean that?"
Holly was already on the verge of collapsing into tears.
"I mean it, Father!"
"As long as you save him, I will do anything!"
Seeing that he had achieved his objective, the Celestial Grand Oracle stopped teasing her.
He immediately said,
"It is not impossible for me to save him."
"However, you must swear a Cosmic Oath."
"For all eternity, you must never meet Sophis again."
"Otherwise..."
The Celestial Grand Oracle paused before continuing,
"All of your cultivation will be completely crippled."
The moment Holly heard those words, a deafening hum erupted inside her mind.
Her thoughts went completely blank.
What?
He wanted her to swear a Cosmic Oath never to meet Sophis again for all eternity?
If she violated the oath, every trace of her cultivation would be reduced to nothing.
If her cultivation were destroyed, she would become an ordinary mortal.
She would no longer be able to withstand even the hardships of the natural world, and her lifespan would become pitifully short—less than a mere hundred years.
Even more terrifyingly, she would no longer be able to preserve her youth.
By the time she reached old age, she would be forced to live on in an aged and withered body.
If she maintained her current Rank, however, she could easily live for millions of years.
Compared to her present lifespan, a hundred years would pass in little more than the blink of an eye.
For someone like Holly, the punishment for violating the oath would be incomparably cruel and severe.
Moreover, every talented cultivator possessed the desire to become stronger.
By forcing her to swear such an oath, her father was clearly certain that she would never dare violate it.
Holly drew in a sharp breath.
Her heart pounded violently.
Anxiety and anger surged within her.
He actually wants me to swear a Cosmic Oath.
The binding power of a Cosmic Oath is terrifying.
Unless I can cultivate all the way to Eternal Divine-grade, I will remain bound by it forever.
But if I swear this oath, I will never be able to see Brother Sophis again for all eternity.
How would that be any different from losing him completely?
Yet if I refuse, Sophis is currently in extreme danger.
He may die somewhere at any moment.
He cannot die.
I have to save him!
Having reached this decision, Holly gritted her teeth.
Her gaze gradually became firm.
She stared at her father and declared through clenched teeth,
"I agree to swear the oath."
"I, Holly, swear before the universe that I will never meet Sophis again for all eternity."
"If I violate this oath, may all of my cultivation be completely destroyed!"
By the time she shouted the final words, she had nearly exhausted every trace of Strength in her body.
The instant she completed the oath, her body collapsed weakly to the ground.
Tears overflowed from her eyes and blurred her vision.
At the same time, her heart shattered into countless pieces.
Now that the Cosmic Oath had been formed, she could never violate it for all eternity.
Otherwise, the punishment of the oath would immediately descend upon her.
Holly had sacrificed her own future in exchange for Sophis’s survival.
The Celestial Grand Oracle had finally achieved his goal.
He nodded expressionlessly.
"I can help you now."
He had already divined Sophis’s future.
Although the young man possessed limitless potential, far too many tribulations awaited him.
Every single one of them would be a life-or-death calamity.
If Sophis failed to survive even one, he would perish instantly.
The Celestial Grand Oracle could not allow his daughter to remain by the side of such a dangerous man.
Otherwise, she would almost certainly live the rest of her life in loneliness and suffering.
It would be better to sever her connection with Sophis now, before an even greater tragedy occurred.
Even if she never married anyone for the rest of her life, that would still be preferable.
The Celestial Grand Oracle naturally understood how deep the karmic bond between Holly and Sophis had become.
It was already so profound that it would eventually involve him as well.
Therefore, he had to save Sophis.
Only by doing so could he completely sever the karma between both sides.
At the same time, within the Sirius Secret Realm, an unremarkable-looking figure suddenly appeared.
The figure completely ignored every restriction and law within the secret realm.
All forms of suppression became ineffective in his presence.
He proceeded unobstructed until he arrived directly before Grand Oracle Sirius.
Grand Oracle Sirius appeared to have known in advance that an honored guest would arrive.
A tea table had already been prepared before him.
He gestured for the newly arrived Celestial Grand Oracle to sit down and converse over tea.
However, the Celestial Grand Oracle rejected the invitation.
He did not sit.
Instead, he spoke indifferently.
"Sirius, you have imprisoned my disciple Sophis."
"You may release him now."
The Celestial Grand Oracle was a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Grand Oracle Sirius, on the other hand, possessed only T7 Oracle-grade cultivation.
Therefore, the Celestial Grand Oracle had no need to speak politely to him.
Grand Oracle Sirius, however, showed no fear whatsoever.
Through the karmic threads of fate, he had already glimpsed certain secrets.
Those secrets were enough to ensure that he had no reason to fear anything at this moment.
Grand Oracle Sirius remained perfectly composed.
He smiled and said,
"Celestial Grand Oracle, your disciple Sophis shares an irreconcilable blood feud with me."
"The karma between us runs exceedingly deep."
"If I release him today, there is no guarantee that he will not return and cause trouble for me in the future."
"If you were in my position, would you release someone like that?"

chapters.title: Chapter 498 -498-Ten Thousand Years of Tempering
paragraphs: The Celestial Grand Oracle smiled upon hearing Sirius’s response.
He waved his hand, and in the next instant, a supreme treasure appeared on the tea table.
Brilliant treasure light radiated from it, revealing its extraordinarily high grade.
The moment Grand Oracle Sirius saw the treasure, his eyes lit up.
An exceptional Primordial Supreme Treasure.
It seems the Celestial Grand Oracle is unwilling to owe me a favor.
Very well.
It is not as though I cannot release Sophis.
The Celestial Grand Oracle observed Sirius’s reaction but said nothing.
He simply turned around and departed.
From beginning to end, he did not utter another word.
Grand Oracle Sirius watched the Celestial Grand Oracle disappear into the distance, and a faint smile appeared on his face.
For the time being, he had no desire to completely fall out with an existence as powerful as the Celestial Grand Oracle.
That was precisely why he had not immediately executed Sophis.
Now that the Celestial Grand Oracle had personally appeared and offered him a treasure as compensation, he naturally had to release Sophis.
Grand Oracle Sirius immediately put away the treasure and issued an order.
"Go to the dungeon at once."
"Release that man."
A short while later, Sophis disappeared from the dungeon.
In the next instant, he randomly appeared within an unfamiliar starfield.
All the restrictions suppressing his body had vanished.
His cultivation and Strength had completely returned to normal.
Sophis raised a hand and touched the Chaos Lock hanging around his neck.
He could sense that the law power contained within the lock had completely disappeared.
That meant the bond connecting him to the other bearer had been thoroughly severed.
A trace of sorrow appeared in Sophis’s heart.
"Holly..."
"Was it you?"
He opened his mouth but did not know what to say.
Even a fool could understand the current situation.
There was no possibility that he had escaped from the hands of his mortal enemy unharmed because Grand Oracle Sirius was merciful.
On the contrary, Grand Oracle Sirius had always been infamous for his brutality.
There was only one possible explanation for Sophis’s release.
Someone powerful enough to make Grand Oracle Sirius wary had personally intervened and forced him to compromise.
There was only one person capable of doing that.
Sophis’s master—the Celestial Grand Oracle.
Sophis understood everything as clearly as though he were looking into a mirror.
His voice became low and hoarse.
"Holly, you must have asked Master to save me."
"And the price..."
"Was it the fate that allowed you and me to meet?"
"Could it truly be that simple?"
Sophis felt as though his heart had become completely empty.
It was as if he had lost something incomparably precious.
For the first time in his life, he realized that besides hatred, another indescribable emotion had existed within him.
Yet now, that emotion was gone.
Sophis drew in a deep breath, summoned his starship, and began traveling at full speed.
When Sophis returned to Celestial Academy, he rushed through the academy grounds, frantically searching for the person he wished to see.
However, Holly was nowhere to be found.
Anxiety overwhelmed him.
He repeatedly shouted,
"Holly!"
"Where are you?"
After searching the entire academy without success, Sophis decided to seek out his master, the Celestial Grand Oracle.
However, the gates leading to the core region of Celestial Academy remained firmly closed.
His master refused to see him.
Sophis immediately understood.
Perhaps the karmic connection between him and Celestial Academy had also reached its end.
The moment the Celestial Grand Oracle intervened to save Sophis, the karma binding Sophis to Celestial Academy had been completely repaid.
At that moment, several familiar fellow disciples and experts who knew the truth approached him.
"Sophis, Holly has already sworn a Cosmic Oath."
"For all eternity, she is forbidden from meeting you again."
"If she violates the oath, all of her cultivation will be destroyed, and she will be reduced to an ordinary mortal."
"You should leave."
"Meeting her again would be harmful to both you and Holly."
"That’s right, Sophis."
"You need to go."
"Holly has already sacrificed everything for your sake."
"Do you still expect her to sacrifice even more?"
"You should consider her feelings as well."
Every word they spoke caused Sophis’s heart to ache even more.
When he heard the final sentence, his heart nearly shattered completely.
So Holly had already sworn a Cosmic Oath.
She had even been willing to use all of her cultivation as the price.
They were right.
He had already dragged her into danger once.
It was time for him to leave.
Sophis cast one final, lingering gaze at the academy before him.
He released a long sigh within his heart.
Then let us never meet again.
Sophis closed his eyes in agony.
When he opened them once more, all traces of romantic attachment had disappeared from his heart.
He drew in a deep breath.
"Only someone who has reached Eternal Grade can break a Cosmic Oath."
"As long as I cultivate to Eternal Divine-grade, I will be able to ignore the oath’s restrictions."
"My enemy is a T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse."
"Then I will first cultivate to T7 Oracle-grade."
"No."
"I will reach T8 Oracle-grade."
At this moment, Sophis’s determination to pursue the Great Dao became incomparably firm.
Without hesitation, he departed from the place where he had studied and lived for so many years.
Separation from his beloved.
The deaths of his closest relatives.
The blood feud of his entire clan.
His desire for revenge and his determination to become stronger completely transformed Sophis into a cultivation machine.
Daniel could clearly sense the terrifying desire for power burning within Sophis.
It was no longer an ordinary ambition.
It was an obsession born from the belief that if he failed to become stronger, he would die.
After leaving Celestial Academy, Sophis did not immediately attempt to take revenge again.
His previous failure had taught him many things.
As a Tier-3 Oracle-grade expert, he was as weak as an infant before a T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Grand Oracle Sirius could crush him with nothing more than the movement of a finger.
Sophis would not possess even the slightest ability to resist.
In fact, Grand Oracle Sirius had not even needed to act personally.
He had merely sent a servant, and that servant had effortlessly captured Sophis.
Only when Sophis’s strength reached a sufficiently high Rank would he possess the qualifications to speak of revenge again.
Otherwise, if he failed a second time, the Celestial Grand Oracle would not intervene to save him again.
When Sophis left Celestial Academy, he did not turn around.
He showed no hesitation and no reluctance.
He merely swore silently within his heart.
"I will return one day."
"Holly, wait for me."
Not long after his departure, Sophis decisively joined a powerful faction.
He began accepting missions from the faction without rest, completing one assignment after another to earn contribution points.
The moment he accumulated enough points, he exchanged them for all kinds of treasures and opportunities to enter forbidden lands.
Sophis had already cultivated three laws to an extraordinarily profound Rank: the Law of Speed, the Law of Yin and Yang, and the Law of Causality.
He had also cultivated the Law of Fate and the Law of Destruction, although his attainments in those two were slightly weaker.
Sophis ultimately chose to focus on breaking through with the Law of Destruction.
He ventured into countless forbidden lands, secret realms, and regions containing extraordinary opportunities.
He never wasted a single chance to comprehend the Law of Destruction.
He also attended the Dao sermons of numerous Grand Oracle-grade powerhouses.
He once witnessed an entire star river being destroyed with a casual wave of a supreme expert’s hand.
He experienced battles and massacres between Oracle-grade powerhouses.
Every trial he encountered was an incomparably dangerous life-or-death calamity.
Without exception, he survived them all.
At the same time, his strength grew at an astonishing speed.
One thousand eight hundred years later, a bolt of tribulation lightning descended.
Sophis successfully survived the tribulation and broke through to Tier-4 Oracle-grade.
Thirty-five thousand years later, he completed his cultivation at Tier-5 Oracle-grade.
Another twenty-nine thousand years later, he forged his T6 Oracle-grade foundation in a single decisive breakthrough.
After fifty-one thousand six hundred more years, he finally caught up to his mortal enemy and reached T7 Oracle-grade.
Ninety-six thousand five hundred years later, during yet another life-or-death battle, Sophis broke through in the midst of combat and ascended to T8 Oracle-grade.
At the same time, his Law of Destruction reached the mid-grade stage.
His Law of Fate also advanced to the transcendent stage.

He had merely sent a servant, and that servant had effortlessly captured Sophis.
Only when Sophis’s strength reached a sufficiently high Rank would he possess the qualifications to speak of revenge again.
Otherwise, if he failed a second time, the Celestial Grand Oracle would not intervene to save him again.
When Sophis left Celestial Academy, he did not turn around.
He showed no hesitation and no reluctance.
He merely swore silently within his heart.
"I will return one day."
"Holly, wait for me."
Not long after his departure, Sophis decisively joined a powerful faction.
He began accepting missions from the faction without rest, completing one assignment after another to earn contribution points.
The moment he accumulated enough points, he exchanged them for all kinds of treasures and opportunities to enter forbidden lands.
Sophis had already cultivated three laws to an extraordinarily profound Rank: the Law of Speed, the Law of Yin and Yang, and the Law of Causality.
He had also cultivated the Law of Fate and the Law of Destruction, although his attainments in those two were slightly weaker.
Sophis ultimately chose to focus on breaking through with the Law of Destruction.
He ventured into countless forbidden lands, secret realms, and regions containing extraordinary opportunities.
He never wasted a single chance to comprehend the Law of Destruction.
He also attended the Dao sermons of numerous Grand Oracle-grade powerhouses.
He once witnessed an entire star river being destroyed with a casual wave of a supreme expert’s hand.
He experienced battles and massacres between Oracle-grade powerhouses.
Every trial he encountered was an incomparably dangerous life-or-death calamity.
Without exception, he survived them all.
At the same time, his strength grew at an astonishing speed.
One thousand eight hundred years later, a bolt of tribulation lightning descended.
Sophis successfully survived the tribulation and broke through to Tier-4 Oracle-grade.
Thirty-five thousand years later, he completed his cultivation at Tier-5 Oracle-grade.
Another twenty-nine thousand years later, he forged his T6 Oracle-grade foundation in a single decisive breakthrough.
After fifty-one thousand six hundred more years, he finally caught up to his mortal enemy and reached T7 Oracle-grade.
Ninety-six thousand five hundred years later, during yet another life-or-death battle, Sophis broke through in the midst of combat and ascended to T8 Oracle-grade.
At the same time, his Law of Destruction reached the mid-grade stage.
His Law of Fate also advanced to the transcendent stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 499 -499-Breaking Through to T8
paragraphs: Daniel experienced everything alongside Sophis and obtained enormous benefits from the process.
Every life-or-death ordeal Sophis endured felt as though Daniel had personally experienced it himself. There was practically no difference between them.
Even the number of Divine State Points Daniel accumulated had reached more than one trillion.
Whenever Sophis comprehended and cultivated the Laws of Destruction and Fate, Daniel was effectively cultivating those same laws alongside him.
As a result, Daniel’s comprehension of the Law of Fate and the Law of Destruction improved at an extraordinarily terrifying speed.
At the same time, Daniel’s comprehension of the Law of Destruction reached the transcendent stage.
His progress in the Law of Fate was somewhat slower, reaching only the high-grade stage.

Over the course of Sophis’s experiences, Daniel had spent hundreds of thousands of years venturing through countless forbidden lands, secret realms, and dangerous treasure grounds within the Chaos Star Sea.
He had also fought blood-soaked battles against an unknown number of Oracle-grade powerhouses.
After accumulating so many insights and experiences, Daniel had finally reached a point where his foundation was ready to erupt.
He could vaguely sense signs of an impending breakthrough.
He even developed the urge to create a Sacred Art of his own.
The experience he had accumulated throughout this period was simply too profound.
Even if he casually drew upon only a portion of it, he could probably create numerous powerful Sacred Arts.
In short, the benefits Daniel had accumulated had already reached a terrifying level.
On the very first day after reaching T8 Oracle-grade, Sophis immediately descended upon the Sirius Star River.
Such a vast amount of time had changed many things.
The Third Eye Clan had once again flourished.
It had even occupied an entire constellation as its territory.
With a T8 Oracle-grade patriarch personally overseeing the clan, the Third Eye Starfield would most likely continue prospering for a very long time, barring any unexpected disaster.
However, Sophis had never forgotten the clan’s blood feud.
Throughout his incredibly long cultivation journey, he had not dared to forget it for even a single moment.
Although he had now grown into an illustrious and renowned powerhouse, there were still two matters he had never been able to put down.
The first was revenge.
He had to find Grand Oracle Sirius and repay the blood debt between them.
Hatred had granted Sophis an endless source of motivation and an unshakable desire to become stronger.
However, it had also created an extraordinarily terrifying heart demon within him.
On several occasions, Sophis had nearly failed his tribulations because of the hatred buried in his heart.
Yet hatred was not the only thing within him.
The shadow of a gentle woman had also remained deep inside his heart.
When Sophis returned to the Sirius Star River, he openly declared,
"Grand Oracle Sirius should have faced his tribulation tens of thousands of years ago."
"Yet he has never dared to attempt it."
"He must have used all kinds of treasures to delay the arrival of his cosmic tribulation."
"Even now, he remains at T7 Oracle-grade."
"But I have already reached T8 Oracle-grade."
Great Dao laws faintly circulated within Sophis’s eyes.
The radiance contained within them was incomparably terrifying.
He spoke in a low voice.
"It is time for him to repay his debt."
Within the core of the Sirius Star River, Sophis violently swept through countless star systems.
This time, he directly forced his way into the Sirius Secret Realm.
The numerous formations and restrictions before him were no different from empty air.
They were destroyed with overwhelming force, unable to delay him in the slightest.
Many powerful servants of Grand Oracle Sirius appeared.
However, none of them dared approach.
The overwhelming aura of a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse filled them with the same terror a flock of sheep would feel upon encountering a lion.
Sophis’s voice boomed like a divine bell, instantly spreading throughout the entire secret-realm world.
"Sirius!"
"Get out here!"
In the next instant, a figure appeared.
It was none other than Grand Oracle Sirius.
When Grand Oracle Sirius saw Sophis, he smiled calmly.
"Sophis, you truly did return for revenge."
"I knew from the beginning that you would eventually come back for me."
His expression was extraordinarily composed.
He did not look like a man who had just encountered a mortal enemy intending to kill him.
Instead, it was almost as though he were greeting an old friend.
Sophis was somewhat surprised by his attitude.
He asked in a low voice,
"You do not appear to regret anything."
"Do you not regret sparing me back then?"
Grand Oracle Sirius smiled.
"Regret?"
"Even if I had killed you back then, what difference would it have made?"
"The Celestial Grand Oracle could still have revived you from the Time River."
"Why would I completely fall out with the Celestial Grand Oracle over something so meaningless?"
"Besides, I have already lived for several hundred thousand additional years."
"I have benefited greatly."
"How many experts within the Endless Starfield can survive for so much longer than they were originally destined to?"
"You believe that you became stronger through your own efforts?"
"You believe that killing me today is entirely the result of your own will?"
Grand Oracle Sirius gave a bitter laugh.
"You fail to understand that all of this was already a script arranged for you by fate."
"This is the destiny of the universe."
"Even if you are unwilling to accept it, what can you possibly change?"
"Since that is the case, attack with everything you possess."
"At least allow me to die a swift and satisfying death!"
Sophis roared furiously and summoned his treasure.
He immediately unleashed his supreme Sacred Art.
The moment the Fate Tree appeared, countless streams of law power descended with a rushing sound.
The present Fate Tree had already evolved to its absolute limit.
It was completely different from what it had once been.
With the Strength of a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse supporting it, its numerous law-based killing moves had become incomparably terrifying.
In an instant, the entire Sirius Starfield was enveloped within its power.
Only a moment later, the numerous Oracle-grade servants and the treasures they carried were annihilated one after another by the Strength of the Fate Tree.
In the next instant, many more supreme treasures appeared in succession.
After hundreds of thousands of years of accumulation, Sophis possessed an enormous number of treasures.
Every one of them was also of extremely high quality.
At the same time, one Sacred Art after another manifested.
"Yin-Yang Life and Death."
"Wheel of the Great Dao!"
A massive wheel formed from black and white energy appeared directly within the void.
It enveloped the entire secret-realm world.
In terms of law comprehension, Grand Oracle Sirius was unquestionably inferior to Sophis.
In terms of Sacred Arts and direct combat ability, he was also unable to compare with Sophis.
His treasures and cultivation Rank were equally incapable of matching Sophis.
Even among T8 Oracle-grade powerhouses, Sophis belonged to the highest tier.
He was one of those extraordinarily rare existences who became practically invincible within the same Rank the moment he completed a breakthrough.
This was the result of Sophis’s exceptional talent and incomparably profound foundation.
Grand Oracle Sirius could naturally never be a match for the present Sophis.
He was completely inferior in every possible aspect.
After all, he was merely a coward who had not even dared to face the cosmic tribulation required to reach T8 Oracle-grade.
Every tribulation represented an entirely new level of existence.
Not every powerhouse possessed an unwavering determination to pursue the Great Dao.
The higher one’s cultivation Rank became, the more terrified one often became of death.
Grand Oracle Sirius had remained at T7 Oracle-grade for several hundred thousand years.
Although his combat strength surpassed that of an ordinary T8 Oracle-grade expert, he possessed almost no ability to resist Sophis.
It did not take long for him to be completely suppressed.
Sophis opened the third eye at the center of his forehead.
A beam of black light suddenly erupted from the eye and shone directly upon Grand Oracle Sirius.
Grand Oracle Sirius had already been suppressed.
After receiving such a fatal blow, his body immediately dissolved into nothingness and disappeared from the area.
Grand Oracle Sirius, a T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse, died just like that.
The entire process was as simple as a casual stroke drawn across a sheet of scrap paper.
A famous Oracle-grade powerhouse who had dominated the region for countless years had fallen without creating the slightest wave.
Daniel witnessed Sophis’s entire battle of revenge.
His gaze flickered as a look of realization appeared within his eyes.
He had seen a certain restraint wrapped around Sophis completely disappear.
It was a karmic thread.
It was also the endless connection born from hatred.
